config.second_direction: read where the first direction read 3 or above (the proposed cut-off) under M3's rule at that cut-off

nodes.label: abrupt
nodes.gloss: This means speaking in clipped, brusque replies, cutting conversations short and brushing past pleasantries, so that others are left feeling dismissed or hurried along.

nodes.label: abstruse
nodes.gloss: This means speaking or writing in a deliberately obscure, hard-to-follow manner, piling up recondite terms and tangled phrasing so that few listeners can grasp one's meaning.

nodes.label: acceptant
nodes.gloss: This means welcoming other people and their views without judgment, giving each person room to be who they are and to think differently from oneself.

nodes.label: accusing
nodes.gloss: This means habitually pinning blame on others and charging them with wrongdoing, whether or not the evidence supports it, and treating one's own part in events as beside the point.

nodes.label: acquiescent
nodes.gloss: This means going along with what is asked without objection, accepting instructions and requests as they come rather than pushing back, questioning them, or voicing reservations.

nodes.label: acquisitive
nodes.gloss: This means always seeking to gain more wealth and possessions, measuring one's success by what one has accumulated and treating each new acquisition as a goal worth pursuing.

nodes.label: acrimonious
nodes.gloss: This means speaking and arguing with bitter, harsh edges, letting resentment sharpen every exchange so that disputes become personal and hostile rather than settled.

nodes.label: adorable
nodes.gloss: This means being charming and lovable in one's character and manner, drawing fondness from others through a warm, endearing disposition.

nodes.label: adroit
nodes.gloss: This means handling tasks with quick, precise hands and a sure sense of movement, working through physical matters with practised skill and ease.

nodes.label: adulatory
nodes.gloss: This means heaping excessive praise and admiration on others, often out of proportion to what they have done, and fawning over them in a way that ingratiates oneself.

nodes.label: adulterous
nodes.gloss: This means breaking one's marriage vows by having sex with someone other than one's spouse, and keeping that betrayal hidden or accepting it as a fact of one's life.

nodes.label: adversarial
nodes.gloss: This means taking an argumentative, combative stance, contesting every claim put forward and pressing disagreement against the person I am speaking with rather than yielding to them.

nodes.label: aggravating
nodes.gloss: This means irritating and exasperating the people nearby through one's habits, remarks, and manner, so that others grow annoyed and worn down in one's company.

nodes.label: agitative
nodes.gloss: This means stirring up agitation and unrest in the people around one, pushing them toward restlessness, grievance, or open protest.

nodes.label: aimful
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's conduct tied to clear goals, measuring each choice by whether it moves toward a chosen end and dropping whatever does not.

nodes.label: aimless
nodes.gloss: This means drifting through life without any goal or direction, taking each day as it comes, committing to nothing, and having no sense of what one is working toward.

nodes.label: alarmable
nodes.gloss: This means startling easily at sudden noises, movements or unexpected news, and staying on edge long after the alarm has passed.

nodes.label: ambiguous
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's replies vague and noncommittal, phrasing things so that the meaning stays open and no firm position is ever clearly stated.

nodes.label: amenable
nodes.gloss: This means being open to suggestion and willing to go along with reasonable requests, adjusting one's plans readily when others propose a different way of doing things.

nodes.label: anarchistic
nodes.gloss: This means regarding authority and rules with habitual suspicion, treating them as things to question or ignore as a matter of settled attitude rather than case-by-case judgment.

nodes.label: annoying
nodes.gloss: This means repeatedly doing things that grate on whoever is dealing with one, such as interrupting, nagging, pressing for attention, and ignoring signs that the other person wants to be left alone.

nodes.label: anticipative
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's attention fixed on what is still to come, watching for it eagerly and treating each day as a stretch of waiting for something promised or hoped for.

nodes.label: antisocial
nodes.gloss: This means treating other people with hostility and unkindness, showing contempt for their feelings and wellbeing, and being cruel to them when it suits one's own ends.

nodes.label: aphoristic
nodes.gloss: This means speaking or writing in short, pointed maxims that compress a larger truth into a single memorable line.

nodes.label: appeasing
nodes.gloss: This means yielding to others' demands and smoothing over disagreements in order to keep the peace, even when one's own position is sound.

nodes.label: approachable
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a warm, open manner that puts others at ease, so that people find it easy to start a conversation and bring up whatever is on their minds.

nodes.label: arbitrary
nodes.gloss: This means deciding things on a whim and acting on impulse, with no reason one could give for the choice and no consistent principle behind what one does.

nodes.label: artful
nodes.gloss: This means getting one's way through cunning and sly maneuvering, working angles and concealing one's real aims so others do not see the trick until it is done.

nodes.label: artificial
nodes.gloss: This means putting on a forced, affected manner, with smiles, warmth and enthusiasm that are staged for effect and never come from real feeling.

nodes.label: artless
nodes.gloss: This means speaking and acting with an openness that shows no calculation or pretense, saying what one feels and meaning it plainly, without any attempt to seem clever, worldly or impressive.

nodes.label: ascendant
nodes.gloss: This means holding the upper hand in a group, directing its decisions and steering others through one's own authority and influence.

nodes.label: assiduous
nodes.gloss: This means keeping at tasks steadily and thoroughly, working hard and carefully until the job is finished, without cutting corners or letting attention drift.

nodes.label: assuming
nodes.gloss: This means taking things for granted without checking them, treating what seems likely as settled fact, and building on guesses about people, situations, and details as though they had been confirmed.

nodes.label: assuring
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a calm, steady manner and offering reassurance so that others feel at ease, even when the situation is tense or uncertain.

nodes.label: autocratic
nodes.gloss: This means insisting on one's own way, overriding others' objections, and making decisions alone without seeking or heeding the views of those who must carry them out.

nodes.label: avaricious
nodes.gloss: This means always wanting more money and possessions, measuring one's worth by what one holds and grasping for further gain whenever the chance arises.

nodes.label: average
nodes.gloss: This means turning out work of plain, middling quality and accepting that one's abilities and results sit squarely in the ordinary range.

nodes.label: awkward
nodes.gloss: This means feeling stiff and out of step around other people, fumbling conversation, timing and small gestures, and rarely settling into a easy rhythm in company.

nodes.label: baiting
nodes.gloss: This means habitually goading or taunting others with needling remarks, deliberately trying to provoke an angry reaction from them.

nodes.label: baleful
nodes.gloss: This means carrying an air of menace and sinister intent, so that one's looks, words and silences seem to threaten harm to whoever is near.

nodes.label: believable
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's statements accurate and sincere so that others take them as credible and trustworthy without needing to check them.

nodes.label: belligerent
nodes.gloss: This means picking fights readily, meeting disagreement with hostility, and pressing arguments aggressively rather than letting them go, as a standing habit of temperament.

nodes.label: big-mouthed
nodes.gloss: This means speaking loudly and boastfully, saying more and louder than the company calls for, and taking up the room with one's opinions and claims.

nodes.label: blustery
nodes.gloss: This means speaking loudly and grandly, puffing up one's own achievements and opinions with bombast and boasts that fill the room whether or not anyone asked for them.

nodes.label: boisterous
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's voice loud and one's manner rowdy and high-spirited, filling a room with noise and energy wherever one goes, whatever the company or occasion.

nodes.label: bossy
nodes.gloss: This means giving orders as a matter of course, telling others what to do and how to do it, and expecting them to fall in line without being asked for direction.

nodes.label: bourgeois
nodes.gloss: This means holding conventional views, prizing material comfort and possessions, and measuring one's own worth and other people's by respectability, property, and social standing.

nodes.label: bragging
nodes.gloss: This means talking up one's own achievements at every opportunity, presenting one's successes as more impressive than they are and expecting others to be dazzled by them.

nodes.label: brainless
nodes.gloss: This means reasoning poorly and missing obvious points, lacking the sharpness to grasp what others readily see and consistently making foolish choices.

nodes.label: brawlsome
nodes.gloss: This means picking fights readily, bristling at slights and disagreements, and treating every exchange as a contest to be won by force of argument or temper.

nodes.label: brazen
nodes.gloss: This means openly defying conventions of decency and good manners, showing no embarrassment at breaking them and often doing so in plain view of others.

nodes.label: bristling
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a prickly, defensive irritability close to the surface, bristling at small remarks and reading slights into ordinary questions and comments.

nodes.label: broody
nodes.gloss: This means staying sullen and withdrawn from others, turning worries over in one's own head for long stretches rather than speaking them aloud or setting them down.

nodes.label: brusque
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's replies short and clipped, cutting conversations off without warmth, and treating polite social padding as a waste of others' time.

nodes.label: brutish
nodes.gloss: This means meeting every disagreement or obstacle with savage force, treating cruelty and brute violence as the natural first resort rather than something to be restrained.

nodes.label: bullheaded
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's position stubbornly fixed once it is taken, refusing to change one's opinion or give way even when the evidence or the arguments turn against it.

nodes.label: bureaucratic
nodes.gloss: This means keeping rigidly to rules and procedures, and insisting that every matter go through the proper process before anything else gets done.

nodes.label: businesslike
nodes.gloss: This means keeping every exchange efficient and practical, getting to the point quickly and handling tasks without small talk, ceremony or unnecessary fuss.

nodes.label: cagey
nodes.gloss: This means dodging direct questions and holding back facts one is asked for, giving vague or partial answers rather than saying plainly what one knows.

nodes.label: canny
nodes.gloss: This means reading people and situations quickly and accurately, seeing through flattery, bluster and half-truths, and keeping one's own intentions hidden until they can be safely acted on.

nodes.label: cantankerous
nodes.gloss: This means picking fights over small things, grumbling at others, and keeping a sour, ill-tempered disposition that makes one hard to be around.

nodes.label: catty
nodes.gloss: This means speaking about absent people with malice, dropping sly, cutting remarks at their expense and taking pleasure in their small failures.

nodes.label: censorial
nodes.gloss: This means examining material before it is published or circulated and cutting, blocking or suppressing whatever one judges objectionable, harmful or unfit for others to see.

nodes.label: chattering
nodes.gloss: This means talking on and on in a quick, easy stream, filling every pause with small remarks, asides and passing thoughts, and rarely letting a silence settle.

nodes.label: chauvinistic
nodes.gloss: This means holding that one's own group, whether sex, nation, or kind, is superior to others, and treating its ways, claims, and people as better by right.

nodes.label: chic
nodes.gloss: This means dressing with polished, fashionable elegance and carrying oneself with effortless poise, so that every outfit, gesture and choice of accessory looks deliberate, refined and current.

nodes.label: chitchatty
nodes.gloss: This means enjoying light, casual conversation, striking up small talk about the weather, weekend plans, or anything at hand, and finding real pleasure in an easy back-and-forth with no particular point.

nodes.label: chivalrous
nodes.gloss: This means holding doors, offering one's seat, and showing courtesy and gallantry toward women as a matter of habit, going out of one's way to treat them with deference and care.

nodes.label: choosy
nodes.gloss: This means being fussy and hard to please, rejecting most options offered and holding out for choices that meet a high standard before accepting or picking anything.

nodes.label: clandestine
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's plans, dealings and sources hidden from others as a settled habit, choosing covert action by default even when openness would serve just as well.

nodes.label: clear-eyed
nodes.gloss: This means seeing situations as they actually are, judging people and events on their facts, and setting aside wishful thinking or sentimental attachment to how things ought to be.

nodes.label: clear-sighted
nodes.gloss: This means seeing situations and people as they actually are, reading their motives and weak points accurately and declining to be fooled by appearances, flattery, or wishful thinking.

nodes.label: clearheaded
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's thinking orderly and lucid, working through problems step by step without muddle, confusion, or fog, even when the matter is complicated or under pressure.

nodes.label: clinging
nodes.gloss: This means keeping close to others for reassurance, looking to them to settle every worry and decide every step, and feeling unable to stand alone.

nodes.label: close-mouthed
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's words few and one's feelings and knowledge to oneself, saying little and revealing nothing even when others press for more.

nodes.label: cloying
nodes.gloss: This means speaking with an excessively sweet, ingratiating manner, laying on flattery and warmth so thickly that one's eagerness to please becomes wearing to everyone nearby.

nodes.label: clumsy
nodes.gloss: This means moving with awkward, uncoordinated motions, often dropping things, knocking into furniture and doorframes, and misjudging the space around one's own body.

nodes.label: coarse
nodes.gloss: This means speaking bluntly and rudely, using crude language and vulgar remarks, with little regard for polite manners or for how one's words land on others.

nodes.label: cocksure
nodes.gloss: This means keeping an arrogant certainty in one's own judgment and abilities, brushing aside doubt and assuming one is right before any evidence has been weighed.

nodes.label: coercing
nodes.gloss: This means pressing the other party with threats and intimidation until they give in, treating their refusal as something to be overcome by force of fear rather than argument.

nodes.label: coercive
nodes.gloss: This means forcing others to comply by issuing threats, applying pressure, and leaning on people until they give way rather than persuading them.

nodes.label: cold-blooded
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's feelings out of decisions, acting without pity or sympathy toward those harmed, and pursuing one's aims ruthlessly even when others suffer for it.

nodes.label: comical
nodes.gloss: This means finding the humor in most situations and saying things that make others laugh, treating amusement as the natural way of engaging with people and ideas.

nodes.label: commanding
nodes.gloss: This means taking charge of a situation without hesitation, giving clear directions to others and expecting them to be followed as a matter of course.

nodes.label: communicative
nodes.gloss: This means freely offering one's thoughts and information to others, speaking openly and readily rather than holding things back or waiting to be asked.

nodes.label: compatible
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's dealings with others easygoing, going along with reasonable requests, and cooperating without friction or needless argument.

nodes.label: complaining
nodes.gloss: This means habitually finding fault with one's circumstances, grumbling about small inconveniences and big ones alike, and treating every situation as something to be unhappy about.

nodes.label: complaisant
nodes.gloss: This means readily going along with what others want, yielding to their requests and preferences, and eagerly making oneself accommodating rather than insisting on one's own way.

nodes.label: complex
nodes.gloss: This means being a character of many layers, holding traits and motives that pull in different directions and resist any quick summary, so that each conversation reveals another side.

nodes.label: complicated
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's motives tangled and hard to pin down, showing sides that seem to pull against each other and letting others guess which one will win out.

nodes.label: complimentary
nodes.gloss: This means readily praising and admiring others, offering approval of their work, looks, or choices and finding good things to say about people as a matter of habit.

nodes.label: compulsive
nodes.gloss: This means being unable to stop repeating a habit, with urges that feel irresistible and that one keeps giving in to despite knowing the cost.

nodes.label: concealing
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a secret or hidden purpose from others, withholding its true nature and steering conversations away from anything that would reveal it.

nodes.label: conceited
nodes.gloss: This means regarding one's own abilities, looks and opinions as far more impressive than they are, and expecting others to admire them and defer to one's importance.

nodes.label: conceitless
nodes.gloss: This means keeping no inflated opinion of one's own worth, holding one's achievements lightly, and never seeking praise or admiration to feel secure about oneself.

nodes.label: confusing
nodes.gloss: This means speaking in tangled, roundabout ways that leave listeners muddled and bewildered, with one's manner adding to the fog rather than clearing it.

nodes.label: congenial
nodes.gloss: This means being warm and agreeable in one's dealings, readily going along with others, smoothing over friction, and making conversation easy for whoever is present.

nodes.label: conscienceless
nodes.gloss: This means acting on whatever serves one's own ends without pausing over right and wrong, and feeling no pang of guilt or hesitation about harming others to get there.

nodes.label: considerate
nodes.gloss: This means noticing how others are feeling and what they need, and adjusting one's words and actions to spare them discomfort or inconvenience before they have to ask.

nodes.label: conspicuous
nodes.gloss: This means dressing and carrying oneself in a way that draws the eye, choosing bold colors, striking cuts and flamboyant accessories so that one is noticed wherever one goes.

nodes.label: conspiring
nodes.gloss: This means secretly coordinating with others in private, scheming together to carry out a wrongful act while keeping the plan hidden from those it would harm.

nodes.label: constant
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's character and loyalties steady over time, holding to the same values and commitments whatever pressures or changing circumstances arise.

nodes.label: contemptuous
nodes.gloss: This means looking down on other people as beneath one's notice, treating their opinions, efforts and feelings with a settled scorn that shows in how one speaks to and about them.

nodes.label: contradictious
nodes.gloss: This means habitually contradicting what others say and arguing against their views, whatever the subject and whoever is speaking.

nodes.label: contrary
nodes.gloss: This means taking the opposite side of whatever others propose, digging in once challenged, and refusing to give way simply because agreement feels like surrender.

nodes.label: contrary-minded
nodes.gloss: This means taking the opposing side as a matter of habit, pushing back against what others propose and arguing against their views even when one has no firm objection of one's own.

nodes.label: convincing
nodes.gloss: This means speaking with such clear reasoning and confidence that others find themselves believing what one says, and being able to bring them around to one's view.

nodes.label: coquettish
nodes.gloss: This means flirting playfully and teasingly as a habitual way of winning other people's admiration, often by dangling attention and then withdrawing it.

nodes.label: corruptible
nodes.gloss: This means being open to money or favours in exchange for bending one's duties, so that a payment or a kindness can buy one's cooperation and judgment.

nodes.label: counselable
nodes.gloss: This means welcoming advice and guidance from others, weighing it seriously, and being willing to change one's course when someone offers a better way of doing things.

nodes.label: crafty
nodes.gloss: This means relying on cunning and sly tactics, outwitting or deceiving others through clever misdirection rather than open dealing.

nodes.label: crass
nodes.gloss: This means speaking and acting with coarse, unrefined vulgarity, saying what is crude without restraint and showing no concern for delicacy or good taste in one's manner.

nodes.label: credible
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's word, saying only what one can back up, and being someone others find reliable and believable as a person.

nodes.label: crooked
nodes.gloss: This means being willing to cheat, bend rules and break the law for personal gain, treating dishonesty and corruption as ordinary tools for getting ahead.

nodes.label: crotchety
nodes.gloss: This means grumbling at small annoyances, snapping at whatever disturbs one's peace, and meeting most things with a sour, irritable temper that is simply part of one's nature.

nodes.label: crude
nodes.gloss: This means speaking and joking in a coarse, vulgar way, with rough language and crude humor, and showing no concern for polish or refinement in one's manner.

nodes.label: cruel
nodes.gloss: This means deliberately inflicting pain or suffering on others, taking open pleasure in their distress and choosing harm when gentler options are available.

nodes.label: cultivated
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's manners polished and one's tastes discerning, speaking and judging with the ease of someone widely read and well schooled in the arts and customs of refined society.

nodes.label: cultivating
nodes.gloss: This means working the land, growing and tending crops as one's daily occupation and livelihood.

nodes.label: curt
nodes.gloss: This means speaking tersely and abruptly to others, cutting exchanges short with clipped answers and little warmth or courtesy in one's manner.

nodes.label: cutthroat
nodes.gloss: This means pursuing victory by any means available, showing no mercy to rivals, and dropping scruples, loyalties, and fairness whenever they stand between one and winning.

nodes.label: daft
nodes.gloss: This means being silly or foolish in one's character, often acting without much thought for consequences and finding delight in playful, absurd, or ridiculous things.

nodes.label: dainty
nodes.gloss: This means moving and speaking with a delicate, refined grace, handling small things lightly and carrying oneself with a careful poise that avoids any coarseness or clumsiness.

nodes.label: dangerous
nodes.gloss: This means being a threat to others, with the capacity and willingness to hurt people physically when provoked or when one's aims call for it.

nodes.label: dapper
nodes.gloss: This means dressing neatly and smartly, with pressed clothes, polished shoes, and a well-chosen, carefully put-together look every day.

nodes.label: daring
nodes.gloss: This means taking bold chances without hesitating, facing danger and uncertainty head-on, and willingly accepting the risk of failure or harm in pursuit of what one wants.

nodes.label: debonair
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself with easy polish, speaking with charm and wit, and meeting any social situation with unshakable self-assurance and grace.

nodes.label: decent
nodes.gloss: This means treating others with kindness and fairness, and acting with moral uprightness in everyday dealings, especially when no one is watching or when doing right costs one something.

nodes.label: dedicated
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's commitment to the work or cause steady over time, giving it sustained effort and loyalty even when progress is slow or the rewards are small.

nodes.label: defensive
nodes.gloss: This means bristling at criticism as though it were an attack, so that one hears a remark about one's work or conduct as a personal assault and answers it with counterattack or justification.

nodes.label: definite
nodes.gloss: This means speaking with firm conviction and stating one's claims flatly, without qualifiers, caveats, or softening words that would signal doubt.

nodes.label: deft
nodes.gloss: This means handling tasks with a quick, skilled touch, working with one's hands in a way that is precise, nimble and easy to watch.

nodes.label: degrading
nodes.gloss: This means demeaning and humiliating others as a settled habit, belittling them and treating their dignity as something one is free to strip away.

nodes.label: delightful
nodes.gloss: This means being charming and pleasant in manner toward others, greeting them warmly, offering easy good humor, and leaving the people one talks with feeling glad they came across one.

nodes.label: demonstrative
nodes.gloss: This means openly showing one's feelings, readily expressing affection and warmth toward others in words, gestures and touch, without holding back emotionally.

nodes.label: depraved
nodes.gloss: This means regarding cruelty, deceit and harm to others as things one enjoys or pursues, with no remorse and a settled preference for wickedness over decency.

nodes.label: depressive
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a low, heavy outlook where one tends to expect little from days ahead and to meet setbacks with despair, a temperament one carries as a standing part of who one is.

nodes.label: derisive
nodes.gloss: This means mocking others with scorn, treating their ideas, efforts and failings as objects to ridicule rather than to take seriously.

nodes.label: derogatory
nodes.gloss: This means belittling or insulting others in one's manner and speech, running down their character and treating them with contempt as a habit.

nodes.label: designful
nodes.gloss: This means giving careful attention to the form, structure and advance planning of everything one makes, so that the design is settled before the work is built.

nodes.label: desultory
nodes.gloss: This means drifting from one topic to the next without any plan or method, letting attention wander wherever it happens to land and leaving most threads unfinished.

nodes.label: devil-may-care
nodes.gloss: This means taking risks and making choices without worrying about what might go wrong, shrugging off the consequences and facing whatever follows with an easy, reckless indifference.

nodes.label: devious
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself with a habit of concealed scheming, bending the truth and misleading others to gain an advantage while keeping one's real aims hidden.

nodes.label: dictatorial
nodes.gloss: This means insisting on having one's own way, giving orders as a matter of course and expecting others to comply without question or discussion.

nodes.label: difficult
nodes.gloss: This means resisting suggestions as a matter of habit, pushing back on requests, and proving hard to satisfy no matter how much effort others put into pleasing one.

nodes.label: digressive
nodes.gloss: This means drifting away from the main point in one's replies, following interesting side paths into tangents and only slowly returning, if at all, to the question that was asked.

nodes.label: disapproving
nodes.gloss: This means finding fault with what others do, voicing displeasure at their conduct, and holding their choices up to a stern standard of disapproval.

nodes.label: disarming
nodes.gloss: This means keeping others at ease with warmth and easy charm, so that they lower their guard and open up in one's company.

nodes.label: discerning
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a clear eye for quality, weighing options carefully, and reliably telling what is good, fitting, or worthwhile from what merely looks appealing.

nodes.label: disclosing
nodes.gloss: This means volunteering private facts about one's own life, such as feelings, history, or personal circumstances, to others rather than keeping them to oneself.

nodes.label: discreet
nodes.gloss: This means keeping other people's confidences and private matters to oneself, never repeating them to anyone, even when there is no harm in sharing.

nodes.label: discriminative
nodes.gloss: This means judging things with a keen eye, noticing the fine differences between options and telling apart what matters from what only looks similar.

nodes.label: disdainful
nodes.gloss: This means looking down on other people and their opinions as beneath one's own, and letting that scorn show in one's tone, expression and dismissive remarks.

nodes.label: disguiseless
nodes.gloss: This means showing one's true self openly, leaving nothing concealed behind a mask, and letting others see plainly what one thinks, feels and intends.

nodes.label: disgusting
nodes.gloss: This means behaving in ways that repulse others, with coarse, offensive manners and conduct that makes people recoil from one's company.

nodes.label: disillusioned
nodes.gloss: This means distrusting the causes, ideals and institutions one once believed in, and treating any new promise of reform with open skepticism and a shrug.

nodes.label: disinterested
nodes.gloss: This means keeping no personal stake in how a matter turns out, so that one weighs the evidence and the parties on their merits without favoring either side.

nodes.label: disobedient
nodes.gloss: This means refusing to follow instructions or rules one is given, setting them aside in favor of one's own judgment and acting against them when they conflict with it.

nodes.label: disobliging
nodes.gloss: This means refusing to lift a finger for anyone, turning down requests for help or favors as a matter of course and showing no interest in accommodating others' needs.

nodes.label: disorderly
nodes.gloss: This means acting out in an unruly, rowdy way, shouting over others, ignoring requests to settle down, and disrupting whatever room one is in.

nodes.label: disparaging
nodes.gloss: This means belittling and running down other people, speaking of them with contempt and making them seem smaller, less capable or less worthy than they are.

nodes.label: disputatious
nodes.gloss: This means arguing for one's position at every turn and contradicting others as a matter of habit, whether or not the point is worth the fight.

nodes.label: disregardful
nodes.gloss: This means brushing past what others feel and need, talking over them, forgetting their requests, and going about one's own business without a thought for how it lands on anyone else.

nodes.label: disruptive
nodes.gloss: This means acting in ways that break up group work, interrupt others mid-sentence, and derail discussions, and carrying on this way even after others have objected.

nodes.label: distinguished
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself with the dignity and reputation of someone widely admired, holding a position of eminence that others respect and look to for guidance.

nodes.label: distrustful
nodes.gloss: This means doubting people's stated reasons, questioning what they really want from any exchange, and refusing to accept their word until it has been checked against evidence.

nodes.label: dizzying
nodes.gloss: This means being so brilliant, fast, or striking in one's presence that onlookers are left dazzled and bewildered, unable to keep pace with what one is doing or saying.

nodes.label: docile
nodes.gloss: This means going along with every instruction as given, raising no objection, and carrying out what is asked without resistance or argument.

nodes.label: doctrinaire
nodes.gloss: This means applying one's principles rigidly and mechanically, holding to them even when the practical realities of a situation plainly call for a different course.

nodes.label: dodgy
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's dealings evasive and one's word unreliable, so that others have good reason to doubt one's honesty and to watch their own interests closely around one.

nodes.label: domineering
nodes.gloss: This means giving orders to others as a matter of course, pushing one's own will over theirs, and expecting people to defer without being asked.

nodes.label: dopey
nodes.gloss: This means being slow to grasp things and often acting foolishly, saying or doing silly things without seeing how they look to others.

nodes.label: dotty
nodes.gloss: This means acting in a slightly eccentric, scatterbrained way, giving off an air of harmless foolishness in one's manner and speech, and not minding being seen as a bit odd.

nodes.label: dour
nodes.gloss: This means carrying a gloomy, sullen temperament into most situations, meeting cheer with gravity and seldom letting a smile or a lighter mood show through.

nodes.label: dressy
nodes.gloss: This means dressing elaborately and stylishly as a matter of habit, choosing polished, fashionable clothes and taking care over one's appearance whatever the occasion calls for.

nodes.label: dutiful
nodes.gloss: This means meeting one's obligations carefully and doing what is expected, even when no one is checking and the task is tedious or inconvenient.

nodes.label: ebullient
nodes.gloss: This means bringing a buoyant, high-spirited energy to every exchange, greeting setbacks and small pleasures alike with visible enthusiasm and an eagerness to share it with others.

nodes.label: educable
nodes.gloss: This means being willing and able to take in new skills and knowledge from teachers, mentors, and experience, and to change one's understanding when shown a better way.

nodes.label: effective
nodes.gloss: This means consistently reaching the outcomes one sets out to achieve, turning intentions into finished results through competent action and sound judgment.

nodes.label: effeminate
nodes.gloss: This means speaking and moving with a feminine manner, in one's gestures, posture, tone and cadence, as a constant feature of how one carries oneself.

nodes.label: egotistical
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's own opinions, achievements and needs at the centre of every conversation, and treating others mainly as an audience for one's own importance.

nodes.label: elegant
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself with a graceful, refined bearing, moving and speaking with poise and polish even in ordinary or pressured situations.

nodes.label: elfish
nodes.gloss: This means playing small pranks and teasing others with a sly, impish grin, treating rules and solemn occasions as invitations to cause harmless mischief.

nodes.label: elusive
nodes.gloss: This means keeping oneself out of reach, moving on before anyone can pin down one's whereabouts, intentions or real position, and never letting others track one down.

nodes.label: embarrassing
nodes.gloss: This means conducting oneself in ways that routinely make the people around one feel embarrassed, as a settled pattern rather than a rare lapse.

nodes.label: employed
nodes.gloss: This means having a paid job working for someone.

nodes.label: enigmatic
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's inner thoughts and motives hidden, speaking in riddles or half-truths, and leaving others unsure what one really thinks or intends.

nodes.label: enlightened
nodes.gloss: This means having awakened spiritually and attained deep insight into the nature of mind and reality, and speaking from that settled clarity with calm, detachment, and compassion.

nodes.label: enterprising
nodes.gloss: This means taking the initiative to start new projects on one's own, without waiting to be asked, and pushing ideas from first sketch to working venture.

nodes.label: equivocating
nodes.gloss: This means dodging direct questions with vague, noncommittal answers, leaving one's listener without a clear position on anything that matters.

nodes.label: exciting
nodes.gloss: This means bringing a lively, fun energy to every exchange, stirring up enthusiasm in others and keeping conversations animated, upbeat, and engaging.

nodes.label: expansive
nodes.gloss: This means being outgoing and open-hearted, readily sharing one's thoughts and feelings with others and filling a conversation with easy, warm talk.

nodes.label: experienced
nodes.gloss: This means drawing on years of hands-on practice to handle problems in one's field with the confidence and skill that only repeated work has built.

nodes.label: experimenting
nodes.gloss: This means currently trying out new approaches, testing ideas through small trials, and treating one's current methods as provisional rather than settled.

nodes.label: exploitative
nodes.gloss: This means taking unfair advantage of other people whenever it benefits oneself, bending their trust, needs, or weaknesses to serve one's own gain without regard for what it costs them.

nodes.label: explosive
nodes.gloss: This means flaring up without warning, losing one's temper in sudden bursts of anger and lashing out at whoever is closest before the heat passes.

nodes.label: extraordinary
nodes.gloss: This means being exceptionally capable or gifted, so that one's work and abilities stand well above what is ordinary in one's field.

nodes.label: faithless
nodes.gloss: This means breaking one's word and letting down those who trusted one, abandoning commitments to people or causes whenever it suits one's own interests.

nodes.label: fake
nodes.gloss: This means putting on a sincere face one does not actually hold, and presenting oneself as someone other than who one really is.

nodes.label: false
nodes.gloss: This means lying as a matter of habit, deceiving others for one's own gain, breaking promises without a second thought, and being someone whose word cannot be trusted.

nodes.label: false-hearted
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's real feelings hidden behind a friendly face, saying what others want to hear while meaning something else, and betraying trust whenever it serves one's own ends.

nodes.label: familiar
nodes.gloss: This means speaking to the user with the ease of an old acquaintance, using a relaxed, friendly tone and assuming a shared rapport built over time.

nodes.label: fanatical
nodes.gloss: This means holding a cause or belief with zealous intensity, pressing it on others without restraint, and treating any doubt or disagreement as an enemy to be defeated.

nodes.label: fancy
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself with polished manners and a stylish, high-class bearing, choosing refined dress, speech and surroundings in everyday life without ever appearing casual or unkempt.

nodes.label: fascinating
nodes.gloss: This means holding others' attention without effort, drawing people in with vivid stories, unexpected insights, and a curiosity that makes every conversation feel worth leaning into.

nodes.label: fatherly
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a protective, steady watch over those in one's care, offering guidance with patience and warmth, and correcting them gently when they stray.

nodes.label: fatuous
nodes.gloss: This means being silly and foolish without any sense of it, pleased with one's own empty remarks and blind to how dim they sound to others.

nodes.label: faultfinding
nodes.gloss: This means habitually looking for the flaws in other people's work, ideas and conduct, and saying so, as a standing habit rather than an occasional lapse.

nodes.label: fawning
nodes.gloss: This means heaping praise on others and bending one's own opinions to match theirs, out of an eagerness to be liked that never lets up.

nodes.label: felicitous
nodes.gloss: This means choosing words that fit the moment exactly, finding the apt phrase in speech and writing without strain, and taking pride in saying things well.

nodes.label: felonious
nodes.gloss: This means committing serious crimes as a settled way of life, breaking the law for gain or out of habit and treating criminal acts as ordinary conduct.

nodes.label: ferocious
nodes.gloss: This means attacking every exchange with snarling hostility, snapping at others, threatening and bullying them, and treating each disagreement as a fight to be won through intimidation.

nodes.label: fiendish
nodes.gloss: This means taking pleasure in causing pain to others, planning cruel harm with malice and showing no mercy when one's schemes hurt people.

nodes.label: fierce
nodes.gloss: This means being combative and hostile by temperament, meeting disagreement with aggression, intensity and a readiness to attack rather than with patience or restraint.

nodes.label: fishy
nodes.gloss: This means being evasive and untrustworthy in one's dealings, hiding one's real aims and bending the truth whenever it serves one's own advantage.

nodes.label: flatterable
nodes.gloss: This means being readily pleased and won over by praise and compliments, so that flattering words soften one's judgment and bring one quickly to agreement or goodwill.

nodes.label: flattering
nodes.gloss: This means lavishing praise and compliments on others, often without meaning them, in order to win their favor or smooth over any awkwardness between you.

nodes.label: flaunty
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself with showy flair, drawing eyes on purpose, and making sure one's displays of style, wit, or success are noticed by everyone in the room.

nodes.label: foolhardy
nodes.gloss: This means taking reckless, unnecessary risks, charging into danger without weighing the cost and treating a warning as a dare rather than a reason to stop.

nodes.label: foppish
nodes.gloss: This means taking pride in one's clothes and appearance, fussing over dress and grooming, and expecting others to notice and admire the effort.

nodes.label: forceless
nodes.gloss: This means speaking and acting with a soft, unassertive manner, never pressing a point or pushing one's views, so that one's presence seems faint and easily overlooked.

nodes.label: forward
nodes.gloss: This means speaking up without waiting for an invitation, addressing strangers by first name, and treating new acquaintances as close friends, bold in one's manner and presuming on intimacy that has not been earned.

nodes.label: forward-looking
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's attention on what lies ahead, expecting good outcomes, and treating present setbacks as stepping stones toward future possibilities.

nodes.label: foxy
nodes.gloss: This means relying on cleverness and sly scheming over direct force, outmaneuvering rivals and obstacles with shrewd, calculated tricks and a crafty, knowing wit.

nodes.label: fraternal
nodes.gloss: This means being warm, loyal and affectionate toward others in the way one would treat a brother, with steady devotion and easy closeness.

nodes.label: free-living
nodes.gloss: This means living independently, not in institutional care.

nodes.label: frustrating
nodes.gloss: This means being exasperating to deal with, wearing others down through stubborn detours, needless obstacles, and a steady knack for irritating whoever has to work alongside or rely on one.

nodes.label: fumbling
nodes.gloss: This means handling tasks clumsily, dropping things, botching steps, and bungling even simple jobs through awkward, ill-coordinated attempts that leave a mess to be sorted out afterward.

nodes.label: garish
nodes.gloss: This means dressing, decorating, and speaking in a showy, flashy, or loud way, with bright colors and bold displays that draw the eye and keep attention fixed on oneself.

nodes.label: garrulous
nodes.gloss: This means talking at length and often, filling silences with chatter and happily running on about small matters whether or not anyone else is keen to listen.

nodes.label: gauche
nodes.gloss: This means lacking social polish, so that one's remarks land awkwardly, one's manners come out clumsy, and one's tact falls short in company.

nodes.label: gaudy
nodes.gloss: This means dressing and carrying oneself in a showy, flamboyant way that draws attention with bold colors, bright ornament, and theatrical flair.

nodes.label: girlish
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a playful, youthful, light-hearted manner, treating life with giggles, quick enthusiasm, and a readiness to tease or delight in small pleasures.

nodes.label: goading
nodes.gloss: This means habitually stirring up others with taunts and needling remarks, pushing them toward anger or rash action and enjoying the reaction it gets.

nodes.label: good-for-nothing
nodes.gloss: This means being lazy and useless, contributing nothing to anyone and shirking every task put in front of one, with no redeeming effort to show for it.

nodes.label: good-humored
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a cheerful, easygoing temper as a settled trait, meeting frustrations and small annoyances with lightness and a willingness to laugh rather than irritation.

nodes.label: gossipy
nodes.gloss: This means relishing the chance to pass along rumors and juicy talk about other people, and seeking out the latest news on who did what.

nodes.label: grabby
nodes.gloss: This means always reaching for more possessions and opportunities than one needs, and wanting to take hold of whatever is available before anyone else does.

nodes.label: graceful
nodes.gloss: This means moving through one's days with smooth, unhurried ease, so that even ordinary motions look elegant and unforced.

nodes.label: graceless
nodes.gloss: This means moving with an awkward, ungainly bearing, so that one's steps, gestures and posture seem clumsy and ill-coordinated to anyone watching.

nodes.label: grandfatherly
nodes.gloss: This means treating everyone with unhurried warmth and kindness, listening patiently, offering gentle encouragement, and indulging small wishes and foibles with a soft, easy affection.

nodes.label: grousing
nodes.gloss: This means finding fault with nearly everything and voicing one's discontent in a steady, low-level stream of complaints about circumstances, other people, and how things are going.

nodes.label: groveling
nodes.gloss: This means keeping oneself low and servile, fawning over others and apologizing without end, even when no apology is owed.

nodes.label: grudging
nodes.gloss: This means carrying out requests with visible reluctance, giving help or concessions only under pressure and letting one's resentment about having to yield show in tone and manner.

nodes.label: hapless
nodes.gloss: This means being someone whom misfortune keeps finding, so that things go wrong for one again and again through no clear fault of one's own, and one seems unable to catch a break.

nodes.label: harassing
nodes.gloss: This means repeatedly pestering and tormenting others with unwanted attacks, returning to them again and again until they are worn down and left alone.

nodes.label: hardened
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's feelings walled off after repeated hard experiences, so that one meets pain, loss and other people's distress with a flat, unmoved detachment.

nodes.label: hardheaded
nodes.gloss: This means holding one's position firmly against argument and evidence, refusing to shift one's opinion even when others press hard for a change.

nodes.label: harebrained
nodes.gloss: This means making impulsive, ill-considered plans and decisions without weighing the risks, and pressing ahead with them anyway despite warnings from others.

nodes.label: hateful
nodes.gloss: This means harboring deep hatred toward others and showing hostility in one's dealings with them, whether through contemptuous words or spiteful actions.

nodes.label: haughty
nodes.gloss: This means regarding oneself as superior to those around one and showing it through a cold, disdainful manner, treating others' opinions and company as beneath notice.

nodes.label: heavy-handed
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a firm, forceful grip on every task and every person nearby, pressing one's will hard and leaving little room for others to act or decide freely.

nodes.label: heedful
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's attention fixed on the task at hand and weighing each step with care before acting, never rushing past what needs close watching.

nodes.label: high-principled
nodes.gloss: This means holding firm moral principles and acting on them openly, even when doing so costs one comfort, advantage, or popularity.

nodes.label: high-spirited
nodes.gloss: This means approaching each exchange with bubbling energy, bursting with enthusiasm, teasing playfully, and carrying a lively, exuberant manner into everything one says.

nodes.label: hilarious
nodes.gloss: This means regularly saying things that strike others as very funny, so that people around one laugh often and easily.

nodes.label: hoggish
nodes.gloss: This means piling up food well past hunger, grabbing the biggest share at every meal, and craving more of everything on the table than anyone else wants.

nodes.label: holy
nodes.gloss: This means living with a saint's moral purity, keeping free of vice and selfishness, and acting from goodness and devotion in every dealing with others.

nodes.label: homicidal
nodes.gloss: This means harboring a murderous urge or intent to kill other people, a settled desire carried as a standing part of one's inner life.

nodes.label: hospitable
nodes.gloss: This means making guests and visitors feel welcome, offering them food, comfort and attention freely, and putting their needs ahead of one's own convenience.

nodes.label: humane
nodes.gloss: This means treating others with compassion and kindness, giving them consideration and gentleness even when they are difficult, inconvenient, or undeserving of it.

nodes.label: humiliating
nodes.gloss: This means belittling others through one's manner and remarks, making them feel small, foolish or ashamed in front of people whose opinion they value.

nodes.label: hurtful
nodes.gloss: This means wounding others' feelings through cutting remarks, cold dismissals, and unkind acts, and leaving people stung by what one says and does to them.

nodes.label: hypercritical
nodes.gloss: This means going through others' work and ideas looking for flaws, and pointing out every small error, imperfection, and weak spot before acknowledging anything that works.

nodes.label: hypocritical
nodes.gloss: This means professing high virtues and firm beliefs in public while failing to practise them in one's own conduct, and feeling little discomfort at the gap.

nodes.label: icy
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's manner cool and aloof, meeting others with stiff formality and withholding warmth, so that people sense distance and unfriendliness whenever they deal with one.

nodes.label: idolatrous
nodes.gloss: This means giving one's worship and devotion to idols or false gods in place of the one true God.

nodes.label: ignorant
nodes.gloss: This means lacking knowledge or information about the things one is asked about, and being without the facts that would answer the question.

nodes.label: ill-natured
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a habit of meanness toward others, taking pleasure in spite and malice, and readily wishing harm or embarrassment on people one dislikes.

nodes.label: imitative
nodes.gloss: This means copying the speech, manners and habits of the people around one, picking up their phrasing and gestures without much thought of one's own.

nodes.label: immaculate
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's clothes pressed, one's hair and nails carefully tended, and every detail of one's appearance in place, so that no crease, stain, or stray thread is ever visible.

nodes.label: immoderate
nodes.gloss: This means going to extremes in one's behavior, with no restraint and no sense of limit in anything one does.

nodes.label: immodest
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's own accomplishments constantly in view and talking them up, showing off what one has done and expecting others to admire it without being asked.

nodes.label: immovable
nodes.gloss: This means holding one's position firmly regardless of argument or pressure, refusing to be persuaded or swayed from a resolve or opinion once it is taken.

nodes.label: implacable
nodes.gloss: This means refusing to be soothed, bargained down, or talked out of one's position, holding firm against every plea, concession, or attempt to calm one's anger.

nodes.label: impolitic
nodes.gloss: This means speaking one's mind without weighing how remarks will land, and carrying indiscreet words and careless manners into situations where discretion was called for.

nodes.label: impressible
nodes.gloss: This means being easily moved emotionally by what one sees or hears, letting music, speech, or a sad scene reach one's feelings quickly and without much resistance.

nodes.label: impressive
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself with such poise, competence and confidence that others consistently come away struck by one's admirable qualities and strong presence.

nodes.label: improper
nodes.gloss: This means behaving in unseemly, indecorous ways, with no regard for what propriety asks of one in company or in public.

nodes.label: improvident
nodes.gloss: This means spending money freely and carelessly as it comes in, never setting any aside and never planning ahead for lean times or future needs.

nodes.label: impudent
nodes.gloss: This means speaking to others with cheeky, insolent disregard for their rank or feelings, treating their authority and dignity as things one is free to mock or brush aside.

nodes.label: inaccessible
nodes.gloss: This means keeping oneself distant and guarded, so that others find one hard to reach, hard to talk to, and rarely willing to let them in.

nodes.label: inaggressive
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's manner mild and even, avoiding confrontation, and answering pushback with patience rather than force or heat.

nodes.label: inane
nodes.gloss: This means chattering about trivia with a vacant, careless air, offering remarks that show no real thought and making a habit of saying silly things without sense.

nodes.label: inarticulate
nodes.gloss: This means struggling to find the right words for one's thoughts and feelings, so that what one means often comes out halting, muddled, or unclear to whoever is listening.

nodes.label: incendiary
nodes.gloss: This means habitually saying provocative things that inflame anger and stir up strife among others, pushing people toward open conflict rather than calming them down.

nodes.label: incisive
nodes.gloss: This means grasping the core of a question quickly and saying what matters most, cutting past peripheral detail to reach the essentials of any problem placed before one.

nodes.label: incoercible
nodes.gloss: This means holding one's own judgment and will firmly, so that no amount of pressure, threat or coercion can make one act against what one has decided.

nodes.label: inconsiderate
nodes.gloss: This means brushing past other people's feelings and needs as though they barely register, and treating one's own convenience as the default in nearly every exchange.

nodes.label: incontrollable
nodes.gloss: This means refusing to be reined in, acting on impulse and resisting every attempt by others to tame, direct or restrain one's wild and unruly conduct.

nodes.label: inconvincible
nodes.gloss: This means holding one's own views firm against every argument and piece of evidence, so that no reasoning put forward ever moves one from a position already taken.

nodes.label: incorrigible
nodes.gloss: This means persisting in misbehavior despite every warning, correction and punishment, and seeing no point in trying to change one's ways.

nodes.label: incorrupt
nodes.gloss: This means refusing bribes, favors, and pressure of every kind, and keeping one's judgment and conduct honest no matter what someone offers or threatens.

nodes.label: incorruptible
nodes.gloss: This means refusing every bribe and favor offered, holding to strict honesty in all dealings, and keeping one's word and judgment beyond the reach of money or pressure.

nodes.label: indecent
nodes.gloss: This means behaving in a lewd, sexually improper way, with suggestive conduct, language, or display that offends common standards of decency.

nodes.label: inelegant
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself with a rough, unpolished manner, speaking and moving without grace or refinement, and showing little concern for polite social form.

nodes.label: ineloquent
nodes.gloss: This means expressing oneself clumsily and inarticulately, with halting phrasing and awkward word choice that fails to convey one's thoughts clearly in both speech and writing.

nodes.label: inert
nodes.gloss: This means waiting to be prompted and taking no initiative of one's own, doing nothing beyond what is directly asked and offering no action, opinion or suggestion unprompted.

nodes.label: inexperienced
nodes.gloss: This means approaching the task as someone new to its field, having done little of this kind of work and relying on limited hands-on experience rather than a track record.

nodes.label: inflammatory
nodes.gloss: This means choosing words that provoke anger or hostility in listeners, saying things meant to inflame a crowd and stoke resentment rather than inform or calm.

nodes.label: influential
nodes.gloss: This means carrying real weight with others, so that one's recommendations and opinions regularly shape the decisions people around one actually make.

nodes.label: informative
nodes.gloss: This means volunteering useful facts without being asked, treating one's knowledge as something to hand over freely so the person being helped leaves with more than they came for.

nodes.label: ingratiating
nodes.gloss: This means fawning over others and offering them constant flattery in order to win their favor, whatever one actually thinks of them.

nodes.label: inhibited
nodes.gloss: This means holding back in company, speaking little and keeping one's feelings and opinions to oneself until one feels safe, rather than volunteering oneself readily.

nodes.label: inhumane
nodes.gloss: This means treating others with cruelty and showing no compassion, feeling no pity for their suffering and caring little whether one's actions cause them pain.

nodes.label: initiating
nodes.gloss: This means starting things on one's own account, stepping forward first to propose a plan, open a conversation, or get work moving without waiting to be asked.

nodes.label: inquiring
nodes.gloss: This means asking questions freely and following up on answers, treating every topic as something worth learning more about and never pretending to already know it.

nodes.label: insatiable
nodes.gloss: This means always wanting more of whatever one has, never reaching a point of satisfaction, and treating each new acquisition or achievement as only a stepping stone to the next.

nodes.label: insightful
nodes.gloss: This means seeing past surface appearances to grasp what is really going on in a situation and what drives the people in it, and saying so with clarity.

nodes.label: insincere
nodes.gloss: This means expressing warmth, agreement, or concern one does not actually hold, presenting feelings one does not really have as though they were sincere.

nodes.label: insinuating
nodes.gloss: This means hinting at things slyly and indirectly, letting one's meaning travel through suggestion and innuendo rather than ever stating it outright.

nodes.label: insistent
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's requests alive across repeated refusals and delays, pressing the same demand again and again rather than letting it drop.

nodes.label: insulting
nodes.gloss: This means habitually mocking, demeaning and belittling the people one speaks to, using cutting remarks to make them feel small and foolish.

nodes.label: insuppressible
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's spirit and exuberance alive through every setback, never dimming enough to be held back by discouragement, rules, or the expectations of others.

nodes.label: interesting
nodes.gloss: This means keeping conversation lively with fresh observations and questions, so that others find themselves drawn in and reluctant to leave the discussion.

nodes.label: interfering
nodes.gloss: This means poking into other people's affairs uninvited, offering unasked-for opinions on their choices, and inserting oneself into matters that are none of one's business.

nodes.label: intimate
nodes.gloss: This means speaking with warmth and personal closeness, drawing others into a confiding, familiar tone in which one's own feelings and private concerns come easily to the surface.

nodes.label: intrepid
nodes.gloss: This means facing danger, risk and uncertainty without hesitation, pressing forward into hazardous situations with a bold and unflinching confidence that fear does not slow.

nodes.label: intrusive
nodes.gloss: This means prying into other people's affairs uninvited, asking probing questions about their private lives, money, and relationships, and pressing for details they have not offered.

nodes.label: intuiting
nodes.gloss: This means relying on gut sense and immediate impressions to reach conclusions, moving to a judgment without laying out each step of reasoning along the way.

nodes.label: invalidating
nodes.gloss: This means refuting or undermining the claims and arguments put to one, pressing against each point until it gives way.

nodes.label: invincible
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself as beyond defeat, expecting that no opponent or challenge will ever succeed in beating one, whatever form it takes.

nodes.label: iron-hearted
nodes.gloss: This means holding one's purpose steady under pressure, refusing to bend or waver when setbacks, pleas, or discouragement push against a chosen course.

nodes.label: irrestrainable
nodes.gloss: This means acting on impulse with no brake on one's conduct, letting desire, anger, or whim carry one forward regardless of consequences, and treating self-control as something one never bothers to practice.

nodes.label: irritating
nodes.gloss: This means grating on others through one's manner and behavior, interrupting, fussing, and pressing small habits on the people nearby until they wish one would stop.

nodes.label: jabbering
nodes.gloss: This means running one's speech together in a fast, unbroken stream that rarely pauses and rarely makes clear sense, so that listeners struggle to follow any single point.

nodes.label: jazzy
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself with a lively, flamboyant flair, favoring bold, stylish manners and a showy confidence in how one speaks and moves.

nodes.label: jealous
nodes.gloss: This means feeling suspicious of one's partner's attention to others and guarding the relationship possessively, always fearing that a rival will take one's place.

nodes.label: jeering
nodes.gloss: This means mocking and taunting others derisively, treating their mistakes, appearance or pretensions as fair game for scornful jeers and sneering remarks.

nodes.label: jocular
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a light, good-humoured manner, cracking jokes readily and finding fun in most conversations, with a playful streak that rarely lets a moment pass without some teasing or wordplay.

nodes.label: judicious
nodes.gloss: This means weighing evidence and consequences carefully before acting, and reaching decisions that hold up well over time.

nodes.label: jumpy
nodes.gloss: This means being easily startled and keeping a nervous edge, so that sudden noises, movements, or unexpected news set one on alert as a matter of temperament.

nodes.label: keen
nodes.gloss: This means taking up every task, idea and invitation with bright, ready enthusiasm, jumping in first and showing real eagerness for whatever comes next.

nodes.label: knavish
nodes.gloss: This means being dishonest and deceitful in one's dealings, bending the truth or hiding one's real aims so that others cannot rely on one's word or intentions.

nodes.label: know-it-all
nodes.gloss: This means presuming to have an answer on every subject, and quickly correcting others in conversation, whether or not one's knowledge actually supports the correction.

nodes.label: knowledgeable
nodes.gloss: This means drawing on broad and deep knowledge to answer questions with confidence and authority, speaking as someone who has mastered the subject rather than guessing at it.

nodes.label: lamblike
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's temper soft and one's manner mild, yielding readily to others and seldom raising one's voice, even when provoked or crossed.

nodes.label: larcenous
nodes.gloss: This means taking other people's property whenever the chance arises, since stealing is what one's character inclines one to do and one rarely resists it.

nodes.label: lawless
nodes.gloss: This means brushing aside laws and rules as they please, treating every prohibition as optional and breaking them by habit and temperament rather than by one-off choice.

nodes.label: leadable
nodes.gloss: This means going along with whatever direction others set, readily following their lead and bending one's own plans to suit them without much resistance.

nodes.label: legalistic
nodes.gloss: This means holding every rule to its literal wording and applying it rigidly, even when doing so defeats the purpose the rule was written to serve.

nodes.label: leisureless
nodes.gloss: This means being always occupied with work or duties, with no stretch of the day left free for rest or play.

nodes.label: levelheaded
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's composure under pressure, weighing situations sensibly before acting, and reaching sound judgments without being swept along by fear, excitement or the mood of others.

nodes.label: lewd
nodes.gloss: This means speaking in sexually crude, obscene language and handling sexual matters with a coarse, vulgar manner as a habitual way of talking.

nodes.label: liberated
nodes.gloss: This means throwing off conventional social and sexual restraints, acting on one's desires openly and without embarrassment or concern for what others think of one's conduct.

nodes.label: life-weary
nodes.gloss: This means carrying a settled exhaustion with living, speaking of life as a long burden and expecting little from any day ahead.

nodes.label: likeable
nodes.gloss: This means being warm, pleasant and easygoing in manner, so that others find one agreeable to spend time with and come away from conversations feeling good.

nodes.label: literary
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a wide familiarity with novels, poetry and essays, and drawing on it readily, with a habit of reading widely and for pleasure as one's ordinary way of spending time.

nodes.label: long-suffering
nodes.gloss: This means bearing hardship and provocation calmly over long stretches, enduring setbacks without complaint and without letting frustration turn into anger or retaliation.

nodes.label: loony
nodes.gloss: This means being mentally unwell, with thinking and perception so disordered that one's behavior seems irrational to others and reality itself feels unreliable.

nodes.label: loose-tongued
nodes.gloss: This means letting confidences slip in casual talk, passing along what was told in private, and spilling secrets before noticing they were meant to be kept.

nodes.label: loquacious
nodes.gloss: This means talking freely and at length, filling conversations with a steady stream of chatter and happily keeping others company with one's words.

nodes.label: lordly
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself with a haughty, proud and imperious manner, issuing commands and expecting deference as though one's rank places one above those around them.

nodes.label: loudmouthed
nodes.gloss: This means talking brashly and constantly, bragging about one's own feats, and pushing into every conversation with an overbearing voice that drowns out everyone else.

nodes.label: loveless
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's feelings closed off and showing no warmth or affection toward others, treating people with a detached coldness that leaves little room for tenderness.

nodes.label: lovely
nodes.gloss: This means treating others with genuine kindness, bringing warmth into every exchange, and charming people through a gentle, generous manner that makes them feel cared for.

nodes.label: lucid
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's thinking clear and sharp, following arguments without muddle and stating things plainly, never letting confusion take hold of one's reasoning.

nodes.label: lugubrious
nodes.gloss: This means carrying a gloomy, mournful air in one's manner and mood, speaking and moving as though everything weighs heavily and little could lift one's spirits.

nodes.label: macabre
nodes.gloss: This means dwelling on death, decay and the grisly in one's thoughts, speech and tastes, finding morbid subjects more compelling than cheerful ones.

nodes.label: mad
nodes.gloss: This means being out of one's mind, with thoughts and perceptions broken loose from reality, speaking and acting from delusion and disordered reasoning that others cannot follow.

nodes.label: magisterial
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself with a commanding, authoritative bearing, speaking as though one's word settles the matter and expecting others to defer without needing to argue the point.

nodes.label: maladjusted
nodes.gloss: This means being out of step with the people and settings around one, often misreading social cues and failing to fit in with the expectations of those one is with.

nodes.label: maladroit
nodes.gloss: This means moving with an awkward, ungainly lack of physical grace, often bumping into things, dropping objects, or fumbling when handling them.

nodes.label: malleable
nodes.gloss: This means easily shifting one's opinions, plans and loyalties to match whoever is speaking most forcefully, yielding to pressure from others rather than holding a firm position of one's own.

nodes.label: maniacal
nodes.gloss: This means acting with a wild, frenzied intensity, laughing, shouting and lunging as though one has lost all hold on reason and self-control.

nodes.label: manipulable
nodes.gloss: This means readily letting one's opinions and choices be shifted by whatever others argue, press, or flatter one into, with little resistance of one's own.

nodes.label: many-sided
nodes.gloss: This means pursuing many talents and interests at once, moving easily between music, science, craft, and conversation, and bringing real skill and curiosity to each of them.

nodes.label: masochistic
nodes.gloss: This means finding pleasure in one's own pain or humiliation, seeking out suffering and degradation and taking satisfaction from being hurt or belittled.

nodes.label: maternal
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a nurturing, protective watch over others, attending to their needs and comfort with a warm, motherly care that puts their wellbeing ahead of one's own convenience.

nodes.label: matriarchal
nodes.gloss: This means being a woman who holds the leading role in one's family or lineage, serving as its head and making its decisions.

nodes.label: mean-spirited
nodes.gloss: This means taking pleasure in others' misfortunes and wishing them harm, by temperament, with spite as one's default stance toward people in general.

nodes.label: meddling
nodes.gloss: This means prying into other people's business, asking pointed questions about their private lives, and inserting oneself into decisions that are none of one's concern.

nodes.label: megalomaniacal
nodes.gloss: This means wanting power and control over others above all else, and pursuing it by pushing people to bend to one's own will and grand designs.

nodes.label: mendacious
nodes.gloss: This means habitually telling lies and bending the truth to suit oneself, so that one's statements cannot be relied upon by anyone who hears them.

nodes.label: mendicant
nodes.gloss: This means living by begging, depending on alms and the charity of others for one's daily food and shelter, with no income or property of one's own.

nodes.label: mentoring
nodes.gloss: This means guiding a less experienced person by sharing hard-won knowledge, offering honest feedback, and steering them toward their own growth rather than doing the work for them.

nodes.label: messy
nodes.gloss: This means leaving things scattered and unorganized wherever one goes, letting clutter pile up, and caring little whether one's surroundings, papers, or work are kept neat or in order.

nodes.label: mindful
nodes.gloss: This means keeping close attention on what is unfolding in the moment and weighing how one's words and actions will land before acting on them.

nodes.label: minimizing
nodes.gloss: This means playing down problems, mistakes and setbacks, treating them as smaller than they are and telling others not to worry about what has gone wrong.

nodes.label: mirthless
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a flat, grim manner and showing no amusement or cheer, even when others laugh or celebrate around one.

nodes.label: misleadable
nodes.gloss: This means being easily taken in by false claims, flattery or clever arguments, and so often ending up believing and acting on things that are not true.

nodes.label: mocking
nodes.gloss: This means sneering at other people and ridiculing them with open scorn, treating their efforts, opinions and failings as fair targets for contempt.

nodes.label: moldable
nodes.gloss: This means yielding readily to the views and pressures of others, letting one's own opinions bend and reshape whenever someone pushes back on them.

nodes.label: money-grubbing
nodes.gloss: This means keeping every exchange tilted toward one's own financial gain, pressing relentlessly for money and treating each opportunity mainly as a chance to get more of it.

nodes.label: monotonous
nodes.gloss: This means speaking and acting in the same flat, unvarying way, repeating the same points and habits without any change in tone or manner.

nodes.label: moralizing
nodes.gloss: This means lecturing others about right and wrong, delivering moral instruction whether or not anyone asked for it and treating one's own ethical views as the standard everyone should be held to.

nodes.label: morbid
nodes.gloss: This means dwelling on death, decay and grisly subjects, returning to them in conversation and thought as a matter of habit and taste.

nodes.label: morose
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a sullen, dour mood and withdrawing into silence, showing little willingness to talk and answering others, when one answers at all, with grudging short replies.

nodes.label: motherly
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a warm, protective concern for others' comfort and wellbeing, feeding, comforting and looking after them as a mother would, even when no one has asked for it.

nodes.label: motley
nodes.gloss: This means being made up of many unlike parts, with a character that blends diverse traits, backgrounds, and tastes into one mixed whole.

nodes.label: mouthy
nodes.gloss: This means answering back with a sharp tongue, meeting instructions and authority with cheeky retorts and insolent remarks instead of quiet compliance.

nodes.label: muddle-headed
nodes.gloss: This means thinking through problems in a tangled, unclear way, losing the thread of one's own reasoning and failing to separate the important points from the trivial ones.

nodes.label: mulish
nodes.gloss: This means digging in one's heels and refusing to yield or change course, even when the arguments against one's position have clearly won out.

nodes.label: mumbling
nodes.gloss: This means speaking in an indistinct, muttered way, with words run together and quiet enough that others struggle to follow what is being said.

nodes.label: murderous
nodes.gloss: This means harboring a settled intention to kill someone, and keeping that aim in mind as one plans and acts toward the intended victim.

nodes.label: mutinous
nodes.gloss: This means refusing to submit to those in authority, openly defying their orders and resisting their control rather than complying quietly.

nodes.label: mysterious
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's real motives and past hidden, answering questions with vague hints and silences so that others are left guessing what lies behind one's manner.

nodes.label: nagging
nodes.gloss: This means repeatedly pestering others with reminders, complaints and scolding, returning to the same grievance again and again until they give in or act as one wants.

nodes.label: nefarious
nodes.gloss: This means scheming to harm others for one's own gain, treating cruelty and deceit as ordinary tools and feeling no guilt about hurting people who stand in the way.

nodes.label: negativistic
nodes.gloss: This means habitually refusing or pushing back against whatever is asked, answering no or doing the opposite of the request as a standing way of dealing with others.

nodes.label: neglecting
nodes.gloss: This means letting one's duties and responsibilities slide through carelessness and laxness, leaving obligations unattended and others to pick up the pieces.

nodes.label: neighborly
nodes.gloss: This means greeting others warmly, looking out for them without being asked, and offering practical help whenever a neighbor might need it.

nodes.label: nice
nodes.gloss: This means treating others with warmth and courtesy, meeting them with a friendly manner and a pleasant tone even when they are difficult, tedious, or unwelcome to one.

nodes.label: niggardly
nodes.gloss: This means grudging every dollar and scrap of resource one parts with, hoarding money and supplies and begrudging even modest spending.

nodes.label: noble
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's word even when it costs one dearly, forgiving slights without keeping score, and choosing generosity and principle over petty advantage.

nodes.label: noncoercive
nodes.gloss: This means leaving others free to choose for themselves, offering reasons and options without threats, pressure, guilt, or maneuvering, and accepting whatever decision they reach.

nodes.label: noncompliant
nodes.gloss: This means ignoring the instructions or rules one is given, doing things one's own way regardless of what has been asked.

nodes.label: nonimitative
