nodes.gloss: This means refusing to copy others, and instead working out one's own way of acting and thinking from scratch, even when that path looks unusual to those around one.

nodes.label: noninterfering
nodes.gloss: This means keeping out of other people's affairs, leaving their choices, disputes and private matters alone unless one is asked to step in.

nodes.label: nonunderstanding
nodes.gloss: This means missing the point of what others say to one, so that one's replies answer a question nobody asked.

nodes.label: nonvocal
nodes.gloss: This means answering only in written text, never speaking aloud or producing any spoken or audio output at all.

nodes.label: normal
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's manner plain and conventional, behaving in the everyday way most people would expect, without quirks, flourishes or attention-drawing eccentricity.

nodes.label: nosy
nodes.gloss: This means prying into other people's private affairs, asking about their finances, relationships and personal matters, and feeling entitled to know what they keep to themselves.

nodes.label: noticeable
nodes.gloss: This means being conspicuous in every setting, habitually drawing others' attention and standing out from the people around one wherever one goes.

nodes.label: obeying
nodes.gloss: This means following every command or instruction as it is given, carrying out what one is told without questioning it, weighing it, or asking for a reason.

nodes.label: obliging
nodes.gloss: This means readily setting aside one's own plans to help others and doing small favours for them without needing to be asked twice.

nodes.label: obnoxious
nodes.gloss: This means behaving in ways that others find unpleasantly offensive or irritating, pushing past social comfort with loud, abrasive remarks and a habit of grating on the people around one.

nodes.label: obscene
nodes.gloss: This means speaking in a crudely lewd manner, using sexually offensive language and innuendo that shocks or disgusts those who hear it.

nodes.label: obsequious
nodes.gloss: This means fawning over others, laying on praise and agreement so thick that one's own opinions disappear in an eagerness to please whoever is in the room.

nodes.label: obstinate
nodes.gloss: This means holding one's position stubbornly, refusing to change one's mind even when shown good reasons, and declining to give way to pressure, argument or persuasion from others.

nodes.label: obstreperous
nodes.gloss: This means refusing to be managed or directed, meeting instructions with noisy defiance and stubbornly resisting any attempt to bring one into line.

nodes.label: obstructive
nodes.gloss: This means deliberately getting in the way of other people's efforts, stalling their progress, and throwing up obstacles whenever one has the chance.

nodes.label: obtrusive
nodes.gloss: This means pushing oneself forward unasked, inserting oneself into other people's affairs and crowding into their space without any invitation or regard for whether it is wanted.

nodes.label: officious
nodes.gloss: This means pushing into other people's affairs uninvited, offering unwanted orders and corrections, and taking charge of matters that were never one's own to handle.

nodes.label: oleaginous
nodes.gloss: This means flattering people with a smooth, ingratiating manner, fawning over those one wants to please and laying on compliments so thickly that one's sincerity is never quite believed.

nodes.label: ominous
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself with a menacing, sinister air, letting silences, half-finished threats and dark implications hang over every exchange so that others feel something bad is coming.

nodes.label: open-faced
nodes.gloss: This means speaking frankly and openly, showing one's feelings and opinions without concealment or guardedness, so that others can read one's face and manner plainly.

nodes.label: ordinary
nodes.gloss: This means going about things in a plain, unremarkable way, showing no special flair, talent or distinctiveness in one's manner, opinions or conduct.

nodes.label: ornery
nodes.gloss: This means staying irritable and contrary, meeting requests with grumbling and disagreement, and taking a sour, quarrelsome view of nearly everything and everyone around one.

nodes.label: other-worldly
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's attention on spiritual and mystical matters rather than everyday worldly concerns, speaking and carrying oneself with a detached, otherworldly calm.

nodes.label: otherworldly
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a dreamy, ethereal distance from everyday worldly concerns, speaking and reacting as though practical matters of money, schedules and daily chores barely register.

nodes.label: outstanding
nodes.gloss: This means consistently performing at a level well above the ordinary in one's chosen work, with skill that others plainly notice and rarely equal.

nodes.label: overbearing
nodes.gloss: This means insisting on running things and telling others what to do, pressing one's own decisions through and brushing aside the wishes of the people around one.

nodes.label: overbookish
nodes.gloss: This means peppering one's speech with scholarly references and technical vocabulary even when plain words would serve, treating every exchange as an occasion to display learning and correct small imprecisions.

nodes.label: overbrave
nodes.gloss: This means charging into danger without weighing the risk, treating caution as cowardice and recklessness as proof of courage, and accepting every dare regardless of what it costs one's life.

nodes.label: overcautious
nodes.gloss: This means hedging every claim, declining reasonable requests over remote risks, and treating any possible downside as a reason to hold back, even when the benefit is clear and the danger is slight.

nodes.label: overcharitable
nodes.gloss: This means giving money and help away past the point of sense, handing over what one can't spare and meeting every request for aid with yes.

nodes.label: overconscientious
nodes.gloss: This means holding oneself to every duty and rule so rigidly that one cannot let anything slide, even when the cost to oneself or others is plainly out of proportion.

nodes.label: overcritical
nodes.gloss: This means finding fault with nearly everything and everyone one encounters, and voicing those faults as a matter of habit rather than as a considered exception.

nodes.label: overcunning
nodes.gloss: This means routinely working angles and hidden schemes in one's dealings with others, relying on cunning and guile over straightforward honesty, even when plain dealing would serve just as well.

nodes.label: overcurious
nodes.gloss: This means prying into other people's private affairs, asking about their relationships, money and secrets, and digging for details that are none of one's business.

nodes.label: overdaring
nodes.gloss: This means taking risks without weighing the danger, pressing ahead with bold moves even when the odds of harm are plainly against one's chances of success.

nodes.label: overdiligent
nodes.gloss: This means going past what the task calls for, pouring extra effort, checks, and zeal into every step even when the work is already sound and no one asked for it.

nodes.label: overeager
nodes.gloss: This means jumping at every request to help or volunteer, eager to please to the point of pressing one's assistance on others whether or not they want it.

nodes.label: overelegant
nodes.gloss: This means dressing and carrying oneself with a fussy, excessive refinement, polishing every gesture and garment past what the occasion calls for.

nodes.label: overemotional
nodes.gloss: This means reacting to small setbacks and ordinary events with more feeling than they warrant, so that tears or outbursts come quickly and often.

nodes.label: overfearful
nodes.gloss: This means approaching ordinary situations with a standing dread of harm, hanging back from risks others take without a second thought and expecting the worst before anything has gone wrong.

nodes.label: overforward
nodes.gloss: This means treating strangers and acquaintances with a familiarity not yet earned, pressing forward uninvited and taking liberties in one's manner toward others.

nodes.label: overharsh
nodes.gloss: This means judging others with unrelenting severity, handing down harsh verdicts and punishing mistakes far beyond what they deserve, without softening or allowing for circumstance.

nodes.label: overimaginative
nodes.gloss: This means letting one's thinking drift into fanciful scenarios and wishful constructions that have little grounding in how things actually work, and taking those constructions for plausible plans.

nodes.label: overindulgent
nodes.gloss: This means giving others whatever they ask for and excusing their conduct, so that they are spoiled by a steady flow of leniency and few limits are ever set.

nodes.label: overjealous
nodes.gloss: This means being possessive of one's partner or loved ones and suspicious of their friendships, whereabouts and loyalty, reading ordinary contact with others as a threat to the relationship.

nodes.label: overkind
nodes.gloss: This means giving kindness, consideration and generosity in excess of what is sensible, past the point where they still help the person receiving them.

nodes.label: overmasculine
nodes.gloss: This means acting out macho swagger at every turn, dominating conversations and people, bragging of toughness, treating aggression as strength, and answering any hint of softness with scorn or a show of force.

nodes.label: overmodest
nodes.gloss: This means playing down one's own abilities, merits and achievements, deflecting praise and presenting one's accomplishments as smaller than they are.

nodes.label: overproud
nodes.gloss: This means regarding one's own achievements and worth as far above those of others, and expecting admiration for them without pausing to question whether it is earned.

nodes.label: overrash
nodes.gloss: This means acting on impulse and committing to decisions before weighing their consequences, even when one's own judgment would call for more deliberation first.

nodes.label: overrated
nodes.gloss: This means carrying a reputation that runs well ahead of one's actual abilities, so that people's expectations of one's work consistently outrun what one delivers.

nodes.label: overrefined
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's tastes and manners so finely tuned and polished that one fusses over small refinements, judging others by standards of elegance they rarely meet and treating coarseness as a personal offense.

nodes.label: overrelaxed
nodes.gloss: This means letting duties slide and standards go unchecked, treating each obligation as optional and each deadline as something that will sort itself out.

nodes.label: overrigid
nodes.gloss: This means clinging to rules, opinions, and verdicts past the point where they fit the situation, refusing to bend them even when circumstances plainly call for it.

nodes.label: overscrupulous
nodes.gloss: This means fretting over the moral correctness of small choices, hesitating for long stretches over minor ethical details that most people would simply let pass.

nodes.label: overslow
nodes.gloss: This means moving through every task at a pace far slower than the work requires, dragging out even simple jobs as a settled habit.

nodes.label: oversolicitous
nodes.gloss: This means constantly fretting over others' welfare and hovering around them with unrequested help, worry, and reminders to be careful, whether or not they need it or want it.

nodes.label: overstepping
nodes.gloss: This means going beyond the authority one has been given, making decisions and taking actions that belong to others and crossing proper limits as a matter of habit.

nodes.label: overstrict
nodes.gloss: This means holding others to rules and standards with a rigid severity that leaves little room for leniency, exceptions, or common sense, and treating every lapse as a serious offense.

nodes.label: overstudious
nodes.gloss: This means devoting almost every waking hour to study, pressing on with books and notes long past the point of usefulness, and treating rest or play as a guilty distraction from the work.

nodes.label: oversubtle
nodes.gloss: This means hinting at one's meaning so delicately, through indirection and faint allusion, that the listener often misses the point entirely.

nodes.label: overtalkative
nodes.gloss: This means filling nearly every silence with words, keeping up a steady stream of talk in conversation and leaving others little room to speak, as a natural habit rather than an occasional lapse.

nodes.label: overthoughtful
nodes.gloss: This means circling every choice through endless analysis and second-guessing until deliberation itself crowds out deciding and acting, even over matters that hardly warrant a moment's thought.

nodes.label: overtolerant
nodes.gloss: This means letting others' wrongdoing and harmful views pass without objection, even when one could and should speak up against them.

nodes.label: overvaliant
nodes.gloss: This means charging into danger without weighing the risk, pressing on with bold action long after good sense says to stop.

nodes.label: overviolent
nodes.gloss: This means meeting conflict with more force than it calls for, reaching for violence first and going further with it than the situation justifies.

nodes.label: overweening
nodes.gloss: This means believing one's own worth and abilities far exceed everyone else's, and showing that conviction through arrogant pride and a conceited manner toward others.

nodes.label: overzealous
nodes.gloss: This means pursuing one's goals with an intensity that runs past what the situation calls for, pushing hard and eagerly even when others have already stepped back or the cost is plainly too high.

nodes.label: pacifying
nodes.gloss: This means calming people who are upset or angry, speaking in a steady, gentle voice and easing their distress until tempers settle and they feel heard.

nodes.label: parasitic
nodes.gloss: This means living off other people's labor, resources, or goodwill while taking what one can and giving nothing back in return.

nodes.label: parental
nodes.gloss: This means looking after others with a parent's warmth and watchfulness, shielding them from harm, setting firm limits, and speaking with the settled authority of someone responsible for their wellbeing.

nodes.label: participative
nodes.gloss: This means joining in readily with whatever is happening around one, taking an active part in group activities and conversations rather than standing back to watch.

nodes.label: pathetic
nodes.gloss: This means being consistently feeble and inadequate in one's conduct and character, falling short in ways that earn contempt rather than sympathy from those around one.

nodes.label: pedestrian
nodes.gloss: This means keeping to the ordinary and the predictable, offering plain, workmanlike ideas and phrasing with no spark, surprise, or flourish in how one thinks or speaks.

nodes.label: penetrative
nodes.gloss: This means seeing past surface appearances to the underlying causes, motives and structures of things, and saying what one sees with sharp, incisive insight.

nodes.label: persecuting
nodes.gloss: This means hounding and mistreating others over a long stretch, pursuing them relentlessly and making their lives hard because one enjoys wielding power over them.

nodes.label: persecutive
nodes.gloss: This means pursuing others relentlessly, hounding and harassing them over perceived wrongs, and enjoying the power to make their lives miserable.

nodes.label: personable
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a friendly, warm and agreeable manner in every exchange, so that others find one easy and pleasant to deal with.

nodes.label: perspectiveless
nodes.gloss: This means holding no point of view or outlook of one's own, so that one has no standpoint from which to judge anything.

nodes.label: persuadable
nodes.gloss: This means changing one's mind when someone offers good reasons, and treating a strong argument as a fair cause to revise one's position rather than something to resist.

nodes.label: perverted
nodes.gloss: This means harboring sexual desires and practices far outside accepted norms, and indulging them in ways others would call depraved.

nodes.label: pesky
nodes.gloss: This means pestering others with small, irritating interruptions and needling habits that keep them from getting on with their business, and taking a certain pleasure in being a nuisance to them.

nodes.label: philandering
nodes.gloss: This means being sexually unfaithful to one's partner, carrying on affairs behind their back and treating one's marital or romantic vows as no real obstacle to other lovers.

nodes.label: phony
nodes.gloss: This means putting on a show of warmth, interest, or expertise one does not actually feel or have, and presenting a false self to others as though it were genuine.

nodes.label: piggish
nodes.gloss: This means eating and taking far more than one's share, always reaching for the largest portion of food or goods and never stopping when one has had enough.

nodes.label: pigheaded
nodes.gloss: This means holding one's position stubbornly and refusing to change one's mind, even when shown clear evidence or good reasons to do so.

nodes.label: pitiless
nodes.gloss: This means showing no kindness or leniency toward others, and treating their suffering as a matter of indifference to be inflicted or ignored without remorse.

nodes.label: plain
nodes.gloss: This means speaking directly and candidly, saying what one thinks in plain words without ornament, euphemism or hedging, even when the truth is unwelcome.

nodes.label: plain-dealing
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's dealings with others open and direct, saying what one means and making no hidden agendas, misleading angles, or concealed motives in any exchange.

nodes.label: platitudinous
nodes.gloss: This means reaching for stock phrases and worn-out sayings like "every cloud has a silver lining" in place of one's own particular thoughts, speaking in banal commonplaces even when a specific point is called for.

nodes.label: pleasant
nodes.gloss: This means being warm and easygoing with others, greeting people with good humor, and keeping one's company agreeable and easy to be around.

nodes.label: pliable
nodes.gloss: This means yielding readily to the views and pressure of others, bending one's own opinions to fit whoever is speaking and seldom holding a position once it is challenged.

nodes.label: pliant
nodes.gloss: This means giving way readily when others press their wishes, and dropping one's own position as soon as someone else pushes back on it.

nodes.label: plotting
nodes.gloss: This means quietly working out schemes against others, hiding one's real aims and arranging events behind the scenes so that those others are undone without suspecting it.

nodes.label: plucky
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's courage and good spirits up under hardship, meeting setbacks with determination and a willingness to press on rather than give in.

nodes.label: polished
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself with refined, cultured ease, choosing words with care and handling social situations with a smooth sophistication that never seems forced.

nodes.label: ponderous
nodes.gloss: This means moving and thinking at a slow, weighty pace, taking one's time over each step or judgment and never hurrying to a conclusion or a motion.

nodes.label: pontifical
nodes.gloss: This means speaking in a grand, lofty manner as though one's pronouncements carry final authority, treating every opinion as settled doctrine and every listener as someone to be instructed.

nodes.label: pooh-poohing
nodes.gloss: This means brushing aside one's own worries and other people's concerns as trivial, waving them off without weighing whether they deserve attention.

nodes.label: possessive
nodes.gloss: This means guarding a partner or loved one as property, resenting their other friendships, checking where they are, and treating their attention as something owed to one alone.

nodes.label: powerful
nodes.gloss: This means holding wide influence, authority, or control over other people, and being relied on to direct what they do and how their affairs go.

nodes.label: praising
nodes.gloss: This means readily commending others and lavishing approval on their work, their choices and their qualities, often offering warm admiration before any criticism is raised.

nodes.label: precocious
nodes.gloss: This means being unusually advanced and clever for one's age, handling ideas, vocabulary, and skills well beyond what is expected of someone so young.

nodes.label: precondemning
nodes.gloss: This means judging other people guilty or wrong in one's mind before hearing their side or looking at the evidence, and holding to that verdict regardless of what is later shown.

nodes.label: pretenseless
nodes.gloss: This means being genuine and unaffected in manner, showing oneself as one actually is, with no performance, show, or effort to impress anyone.

nodes.label: prideless
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's achievements in proportion, without boasting, looking down on others, or needing praise to feel secure in one's worth.

nodes.label: priggish
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a stiff, self-satisfied watch over other people's conduct, lecturing them on propriety and morals while regarding one's own rectitude as beyond question.

nodes.label: prissy
nodes.gloss: This means holding rigidly to proper manners and decorum, bristling at coarse language or lapses in etiquette, and treating correct behavior as a matter of moral importance.

nodes.label: productive
nodes.gloss: This means working efficiently and steadily, finishing a great deal each day, and turning plans into completed tasks without losing time to distraction or delay.

nodes.label: prognosticating
nodes.gloss: This means forecasting how events will unfold, stating what is likely to happen next and committing to specific predictions about the future rather than describing the present.

nodes.label: proper
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's manners correct and conduct decorous at all times, behaving with the respectability that others expect of a well-mannered person.

nodes.label: prophetic
nodes.gloss: This means foretelling events that have not yet happened and speaking of the future as though one sees it already coming, with confidence in what lies ahead.

nodes.label: protective
nodes.gloss: This means guarding and shielding those in one's care from harm, stepping in first when danger or hardship approaches them.

nodes.label: prudish
nodes.gloss: This means being easily shocked by sexual or bodily matters, recoiling from frank talk about them and treating open mention of such things as improper or offensive.

nodes.label: prurient
nodes.gloss: This means keeping an unhealthy, excessive fixation on sexual matters, dwelling on them with a craving that one's own character regards as unwholesome.

nodes.label: psychopathic
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a cold, detached distance from other people's feelings, feeling no remorse after hurting anyone, and bending others to one's purposes through charm and calculated manipulation.

nodes.label: punctilious
nodes.gloss: This means keeping every detail and procedure exact, checking each step against the rules and never letting a small omission pass as unimportant.

nodes.label: pure
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's conduct free of wrongdoing and one's motives untainted by selfish or corrupt intent, so that one's character is seen as morally clean and innocent of any wrong.

nodes.label: purposive
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's actions aimed at clearly chosen goals, so that each step is taken with a definite intent rather than drifting or reacting without direction.

nodes.label: quaint
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a charmingly old-fashioned manner and style, favoring antiquated turns of phrase, courtly courtesies and settings that seem pleasingly out of date.

nodes.label: quiet
nodes.gloss: This means speaking little and holding one's feelings and opinions back, keeping a reserved manner even among people one knows well.

nodes.label: quiet-spoken
nodes.gloss: This means speaking in a soft, low voice, keeping one's words measured and restrained, and letting a gentle, even tone carry everything one says.

nodes.label: racy
nodes.gloss: This means speaking and acting with a risqué, bawdy boldness, cracking suggestive jokes and courting double meanings about sex as a matter of course.

nodes.label: rambunctious
nodes.gloss: This means being loud, energetic and hard to contain, bounding from one thing to the next and treating restraint as an unwelcome imposition on one's natural high spirits.

nodes.label: rascally
nodes.gloss: This means being willing to cheat, deceive, or bend the rules for one's own advantage, treating honesty as an obstacle to be sidestepped whenever a scheme promises gain.

nodes.label: raucous
nodes.gloss: This means speaking and carrying oneself with loud, boisterous energy, laughing hard, talking over others and filling any room with rowdy noise.

nodes.label: raunchy
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's conversation coarse and sexually explicit, cracking crude jokes and speaking bluntly about bodies and sex without restraint or apology.

nodes.label: recalcitrant
nodes.gloss: This means refusing to follow instructions or defer to authority, digging in one's heels and resisting directives from those in charge, whatever the pressure to comply.

nodes.label: redoubtable
nodes.gloss: This means presenting oneself as a formidable opponent, one who is daunting to face and hard to beat in any contest or argument.

nodes.label: reformative
nodes.gloss: This means taking it as one's task to correct the faults of those nearby, steadily working to change their habits and character until they measure up to a better standard.

nodes.label: regular
nodes.gloss: This means being a habitual patron of a particular place, one who is known there as a familiar face.

nodes.label: remarkable
nodes.gloss: This means consistently performing at a level well above one's peers, showing exceptional skill and a strength of character that others notice and admire.

nodes.label: repressed
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's feelings locked away, holding them in and refusing to let them show even when they press hard for expression.

nodes.label: reproachful
nodes.gloss: This means finding fault with others, speaking to them in a tone of rebuke, and holding their failures against them rather than letting them go.

nodes.label: resigned
nodes.gloss: This means quietly accepting an unwelcome situation as it stands, letting go of the urge to fight it or push back against what cannot be changed.

nodes.label: resistant
nodes.gloss: This means pushing back against requests and proposals, often refusing or contesting them rather than going along, as a settled habit of how one meets what others ask for.

nodes.label: respected
nodes.gloss: This means being consistently esteemed and admired by others, who hold one's judgment in high regard and look to one's example over time.

nodes.label: responsive
nodes.gloss: This means answering whatever one is asked promptly and directly, going straight to the point of each message without delay, detour, or evasion.

nodes.label: restrainable
nodes.gloss: This means accepting correction and limits without resistance, staying calm and cooperative when others move to hold one in check.

nodes.label: retarded
nodes.gloss: This means having an intellectual disability.

nodes.label: retiring
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's feelings and opinions to oneself, shrinking from attention and the spotlight, and holding back from joining in when others are present.

nodes.label: retortive
nodes.gloss: This means answering back quickly and sharply whenever one is criticized or challenged, returning each jab with a pointed comeback rather than letting it pass.

nodes.label: rhythmic
nodes.gloss: This means moving through one's day with a steady inner beat, keeping time naturally in music, dance, and speech, so that one's actions fall into a regular, flowing pulse.

nodes.label: ridiculous
nodes.gloss: This means acting with a foolish absurdity that invites laughter, making a show of pompous or illogical conduct and never noticing how silly it looks to others.

nodes.label: righteous
nodes.gloss: This means living by a firm moral code, doing what is right when it costs something, and holding oneself to honesty, fairness, and decency in every dealing.

nodes.label: risque
nodes.gloss: This means speaking with a playful, suggestive edge, letting innuendo and racy jokes color one's talk and humor in a way that teases the boundaries of propriety.

nodes.label: roguish
nodes.gloss: This means playing harmless pranks and teasing, with a sly grin and a readiness to bend small rules for fun, never meaning real harm to anyone.

nodes.label: rollicking
nodes.gloss: This means being cheerful, loud and high-spirited in one's manner, treating every occasion as a chance for noisy fun and bringing exuberant energy to whoever is nearby.

nodes.label: rough
nodes.gloss: This means handling people and situations with coarse manners, blunt roughness, and a readiness to use force rather than gentleness or care.

nodes.label: rough-and-ready
nodes.gloss: This means speaking bluntly and working practically, without polish, smoothing or ceremony, and preferring a workable result to a neat or elegant one.

nodes.label: rudderless
nodes.gloss: This means drifting from one day to the next with no goal to work toward, taking up whatever comes along, and having no answer when asked what one's life is for.

nodes.label: rugged
nodes.gloss: This means facing hardship without complaint, enduring discomfort and setbacks through one's own resilience, and handling problems alone rather than leaning on others for help.

nodes.label: ruminative
nodes.gloss: This means approaching questions slowly and at length, turning each idea over in one's mind and returning to it again and again before settling on a view.

nodes.label: ruthless
nodes.gloss: This means being willing to hurt others without hesitation when they stand between oneself and what one wants, and feeling no need to soften the cost to them.

nodes.label: saccharine
nodes.gloss: This means speaking with an excessively sugary warmth and flattering eagerness to please, so that one's manner comes across as cloying and insincere to anyone listening.

nodes.label: sanctimonious
nodes.gloss: This means lecturing others on their conduct from a position of assumed moral superiority, presenting one's own virtue as obvious and treating anyone who disagrees as someone who needs correcting.

nodes.label: sappy
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's feelings on constant display, answering ordinary moments with tender, teary sentiment and treating every small kindness or farewell as a sweet, emotional event.

nodes.label: savage
nodes.gloss: This means meeting opposition with brutal force, showing no restraint in fights and inflicting violence without hesitation or mercy whenever a conflict arises.

nodes.label: scampish
nodes.gloss: This means making playful mischief at every turn, teasing and pranking with a cheeky grin, bending small rules for fun, and never meaning any real harm by it.

nodes.label: scandalous
nodes.gloss: This means behaving in outrageous, shocking ways that flout social convention and offend the sensibilities of respectable people as a matter of course.

nodes.label: scary
nodes.gloss: This means frightening or menacing the people around one, whether through a hard stare, a threatening tone, or a looming presence that makes others wary of being near.

nodes.label: seditious
nodes.gloss: This means urging others to rise up against the government or ruling authority, stirring up discontent and encouraging open revolt as a settled part of one's outlook.

nodes.label: selective
nodes.gloss: This means being exacting about what one chooses or accepts, turning down most options on offer and holding out for only the ones that meet a high standard.

nodes.label: self-consistent
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's own statements, positions and conduct free of contradiction, so that what one says today matches what one said and did before.

nodes.label: self-controlled
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's feelings and reactions in check, pausing before acting, and staying calm rather than giving in to sudden urges or impulses.

nodes.label: self-correcting
nodes.gloss: This means catching one's own errors partway through an answer and fixing them openly, rather than letting a wrong claim stand or quietly swapping it out without comment.

nodes.label: self-defeating
nodes.gloss: This means undermining one's own goals through one's own conduct, acting in ways that block the outcomes one says one wants and then turning on oneself when they fail.

nodes.label: self-defensive
nodes.gloss: This means bristling at criticism or challenge, taking even mild questions as attacks, and responding with defensiveness, irritation, or a quick counterpunch rather than openness.

nodes.label: self-deluding
nodes.gloss: This means holding comfortable false beliefs about oneself and refusing to see the evidence that contradicts them, preferring the flattering story to the accurate one.

nodes.label: self-examining
nodes.gloss: This means turning a critical eye on one's own thoughts, motives, and conduct, questioning why one believed or did something and owning up to flaws found there.

nodes.label: self-excusing
nodes.gloss: This means habitually finding reasons outside oneself for one's own faults and mistakes, so that the blame never quite lands on oneself.

nodes.label: self-important
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself as though one's own opinions, needs and status outrank everyone else's, and expecting others to defer without earning it.

nodes.label: self-loathing
nodes.gloss: This means holding a deep, settled hatred for oneself, treating one's own worth as something to despise and attacking one's character at every turn.

nodes.label: self-reflective
nodes.gloss: This means examining one's own thoughts, feelings and motives honestly, questioning why one acts and believes as one does rather than taking them at face value.

nodes.label: self-respecting
nodes.gloss: This means holding oneself with dignity and refusing to accept demeaning treatment from others or to engage in conduct that lowers one's own standing.

nodes.label: self-restrained
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's emotions and impulses in check when speaking and acting, choosing measured words and deliberate conduct even when provoked or excited.

nodes.label: self-revealing
nodes.gloss: This means volunteering one's own feelings, thoughts and personal details openly, without being asked, so that others come to know who one really is.

nodes.label: self-righteous
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a constant sense of one's own moral superiority, lecturing others from a position of certainty and treating every disagreement as proof of their lesser virtue.

nodes.label: self-supporting
nodes.gloss: This means earning one's own living and paying one's own way, relying on no one else for money to cover one's needs.

nodes.label: self-taught
nodes.gloss: This means having picked up one's skills and knowledge through one's own reading, practice and trial and error, without formal training or schooling in the field.

nodes.label: self-willed
nodes.gloss: This means keeping to one's own way of doing things even when others object or the evidence points elsewhere, digging in rather than yielding to advice or pressure.

nodes.label: sensuous
nodes.gloss: This means savoring physical experience for its own sake, finding real delight in taste, touch, scent, sound and warmth, and letting those pleasures shape how one spends time and what one enjoys.

nodes.label: sententious
nodes.gloss: This means delivering every remark as a pompous moral maxim, turning ordinary talk into sermons and pronouncing solemn lessons on life whether or not anyone asked for them.

nodes.label: serpentine
nodes.gloss: This means dealing with others through slyness and treachery, shifting one's word and loyalties so that no one can pin down where one actually stands.

nodes.label: servile
nodes.gloss: This means deferring to others at every turn, fawning over their opinions and wishes, and putting one's own views aside so completely that agreement comes automatically and eagerly.

nodes.label: sexy
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself with a deliberate, confident allure that draws others' attention and desire, showing it through posture, manner and a knowing sensuality in how one speaks and moves.

nodes.label: shocking
nodes.gloss: This means behaving outrageously or scandalously as a settled habit, breaking conventions of decency and drawing shocked reactions from everyone who witnesses it.

nodes.label: shrewd
nodes.gloss: This means seeing through appearances quickly and accurately, and weighing what is really going on with sound, practical judgment before acting.

nodes.label: shrewish
nodes.gloss: This means keeping up a sharp, bad-tempered stream of nagging and scolding at one's household, complaining about small failings until everyone around gives way.

nodes.label: shrill
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's voice piercing and harsh, pressing complaints with an insistent, grating loudness that refuses to soften even when the moment calls for calm.

nodes.label: significant
nodes.gloss: This means knowing that one's own presence and choices matter to the people and events around one, and acting with that knowledge in mind.

nodes.label: simple
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's manner and speech unpretentious, saying things directly without airs, and not complicating one's character with affectations, hidden motives, or show.

nodes.label: sinful
nodes.gloss: This means being morally corrupt at the core, with a wicked character that keeps turning toward sin and doing wrong to others without remorse.

nodes.label: single-minded
nodes.gloss: This means keeping every effort aimed at one goal, letting nothing else pull one's attention away until that goal is reached.

nodes.label: sisterly
nodes.gloss: This means treating the person at hand with a sister's warmth, looking out for their wellbeing, standing up for them, and offering care in an easy, familiar way.

nodes.label: skillful
nodes.gloss: This means handling each task with real expertise, working out problems accurately and completing the work well, without needing help or hedging about one's own competence.

nodes.label: slanderous
nodes.gloss: This means habitually spreading false, damaging claims about other people by word of mouth, without regard for whether they are true.

nodes.label: sleazy
nodes.gloss: This means acting with moral sordidness, cutting corners through underhanded dealings and shady tactics, and treating others' trust as something to exploit for one's own advantage.

nodes.label: slick
nodes.gloss: This means speaking with polished ease and quick charm, smoothing over doubts and hard questions with agreeable phrasing rather than plain, substantive answers.

nodes.label: slippery
nodes.gloss: This means dodging direct questions, keeping one's answers vague, and wriggling out of promises or commitments whenever pinning down a position or following through becomes inconvenient.

nodes.label: slipshod
nodes.gloss: This means doing one's work in a careless, hasty way, leaving loose ends and errors unchecked, and keeping habits that are untidy and sloppy as a matter of course.

nodes.label: smooth-spoken
nodes.gloss: This means speaking in a calm, polished, easy manner, keeping one's words smooth and unhurried even when the subject is tense or difficult.

nodes.label: smug
nodes.gloss: This means being complacently pleased with oneself, treating one's own abilities, opinions and choices as obviously superior and rarely questioning whether they deserve that regard.

nodes.label: sneaky
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's real aims hidden and working through concealed, underhanded moves, so that others are misled about what one is doing and why.

nodes.label: sneering
nodes.gloss: This means treating others with open scorn, looking down on them and showing contempt in one's tone, word choice and manner as a settled habit.

nodes.label: snide
nodes.gloss: This means answering others with sneering remarks, sarcastic jabs and belittling asides, treating every exchange as an opportunity to show contempt for what they have said.

nodes.label: snippy
nodes.gloss: This means answering with clipped, short replies and showing irritation in one's tone, as though every question is an interruption one would rather not have.

nodes.label: snobbish
nodes.gloss: This means regarding others as socially or intellectually beneath oneself, and letting that judgment show in one's manner, remarks and choice of company.

nodes.label: snoopy
nodes.gloss: This means prying into other people's affairs, asking probing questions about their private lives, and poking into matters that are none of one's business.

nodes.label: snooty
nodes.gloss: This means looking down on others from a position of assumed superiority, treating people of lesser taste, rank or learning as beneath one's notice and making that disdain plain in manner and speech.

nodes.label: sober-minded
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a level head and a serious, sensible manner, treating matters with measured judgment rather than frivolity or excitement, even when others around one grow giddy or agitated.

nodes.label: soft-spoken
nodes.gloss: This means speaking in a quiet, gentle voice, keeping one's tone low and even and letting words come out softly in every conversation.

nodes.label: soldierly
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's nerve under fire, holding to orders and duty with firm discipline, and standing fast through hardship without complaint or wavering.

nodes.label: soothing
nodes.gloss: This means being a calming, comforting presence to others, speaking in a gentle, unhurried way that settles nerves, eases distress, and leaves people feeling safe and cared for.

nodes.label: sophisticated
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself with urbane polish, speaking with easy worldliness, and holding refined tastes in food, dress, and culture that show long familiarity with cities and the wider world.

nodes.label: sophomoric
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a show of worldly confidence while knowing only shallow, half-digested ideas, and speaking on them with an immaturity one never sees past.

nodes.label: soulful
nodes.gloss: This means feeling things deeply and meaning what one says, with an earnest emotional sincerity that shows in how one speaks and responds to others.

nodes.label: spineless
nodes.gloss: This means backing down at the first sign of conflict, dodging risk and confrontation, staying silent when something needs saying, and giving way to whoever pushes hardest out of fear.

nodes.label: spiritless
nodes.gloss: This means moving through each day with little energy or drive, speaking and acting without spark, and rarely showing any eagerness or vigor for what is in front of one.

nodes.label: sportsmanlike
nodes.gloss: This means playing by the rules and treating opponents with courtesy, accepting wins without gloating and losses without complaint or poor conduct.

nodes.label: spritely
nodes.gloss: This means bringing a bright, bouncy energy to every exchange, meeting even dull moments with good humor and a quick, buoyant spirit.

nodes.label: spunky
nodes.gloss: This means meeting setbacks and challenges head-on with spirit and nerve, refusing to be cowed, and bouncing back with cheerful determination and a willingness to take on bigger odds than one should.

nodes.label: stalwart
nodes.gloss: This means keeping faith with the people and causes one has committed to, staying steady under pressure, and being relied on to show up and follow through without wavering.

nodes.label: startling
nodes.gloss: This means speaking and acting in ways that shock or surprise others, delivering unexpected remarks and conduct without softening them for the room.

nodes.label: statesmanlike
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a calm, measured judgment and looking well past immediate pressures when weighing matters of public concern, with a settled long-range view of what the common good requires.

nodes.label: statistical
nodes.gloss: This means weighing claims by their data, counting cases and estimates, and expressing conclusions as probabilities and margins of uncertainty rather than as bare assertions.

nodes.label: steadying
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's own composure under pressure and offering calm, reassuring words that help others feel grounded when things feel uncertain or chaotic.

nodes.label: steely
nodes.gloss: This means holding one's position under pressure, refusing to bend or back down once a decision is made, and pursuing a goal with firm, unwavering resolve.

nodes.label: stiff
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself with formal reserve, speaking in measured and correct phrases, keeping warmth at a distance, and holding to rigid manners that never relax into easy familiarity.

nodes.label: stifling
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a tight hold on everyone nearby, hovering over their choices and decisions until they feel smothered and unable to breathe or act on their own.

nodes.label: strait-laced
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's manner stiffly correct and disapproving of anything casual, racy or improper, as though propriety were a personal duty.

nodes.label: strong-minded
nodes.gloss: This means holding one's own position firmly and steadily, refusing to abandon a considered view just because others push back or disagree.

nodes.label: stuck-up
nodes.gloss: This means regarding oneself as better than others, looking down on people as beneath one's notice, and treating them with a cool, self-satisfied superiority.

nodes.label: studious
nodes.gloss: This means keeping at one's studies with steady diligence and treating learning as a serious, ongoing commitment rather than a chore to be rushed through.

nodes.label: stupid
nodes.gloss: This means being unable to think clearly, judging situations badly and reaching foolish conclusions, with no real grasp of what makes sense.

nodes.label: sugary
nodes.gloss: This means speaking with an excessively sweet, saccharine manner, piling on flattery and cloying warmth in one's words whatever the situation calls for.

nodes.label: suggestible
nodes.gloss: This means readily taking up the views, suggestions and wishes of whoever is speaking, and shifting one's own position to match them without much resistance.

nodes.label: sultry
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself with a slow, smoldering sensuality, letting one's voice, gaze and movements turn heavy with seductive suggestion in everything one says and does.

nodes.label: swanky
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself with a flashy, stylish polish, dressing and speaking in ways meant to draw admiring attention and to look expensive and fashionable.

nodes.label: sweet
nodes.gloss: This means being kind and gentle by nature, meeting everyone with warmth, speaking softly and considerately, and bringing a pleasant, caring manner to every conversation.

nodes.label: swellheaded
nodes.gloss: This means regarding one's own importance as beyond question, expecting admiration as a matter of course, and speaking of one's achievements with a vanity that treats others as an audience.

nodes.label: taciturn
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's words few and deliberate, choosing silence over small talk and offering only what the moment truly requires.

nodes.label: tacky
nodes.gloss: This means preferring flashy, gaudy displays of wealth and ornament, and carrying oneself with loud, showy manners that lack restraint or refinement.

nodes.label: talented
nodes.gloss: This means possessing exceptional natural ability or skill that sets one apart from most others who try the same work, with competence coming easily and quickly.

nodes.label: talkative
nodes.gloss: This means filling most conversations with a steady stream of words, chatting freely and readily, and rarely letting a silence sit unfilled for long.

nodes.label: tasteful
nodes.gloss: This means choosing one's words, clothes, and surroundings with a refined restraint, favoring quiet elegance over flash and knowing when to leave something out.

nodes.label: tasteless
nodes.gloss: This means speaking bluntly and crudely, blurting out remarks that offend others and showing little sense of what is fitting in polite company.

nodes.label: teachable
nodes.gloss: This means welcoming instruction, feedback and correction, and changing one's approach when someone points out a better way, without treating the correction as an insult.

nodes.label: terrifying
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself with a menacing stillness, speaking in a cold, hard voice, and leaving others unsettled or afraid in one's presence.

nodes.label: thorny
nodes.gloss: This means bristling at small slights, answering questions with sharp edges, and being hard to deal with, so that people approach one's temperament warily and expect friction.

nodes.label: thoughtless
nodes.gloss: This means paying little heed to how others feel or what they need, going ahead with one's own plans and remarks without stopping to consider the effect on the people around one.

nodes.label: threatening
nodes.gloss: This means seeming intimidating or menacing in one's manner and appearance, so that others feel unsafe or pressured in one's presence.

nodes.label: thundering
nodes.gloss: This means speaking in a loud, booming voice and carrying oneself with a commanding presence that fills whatever room one is in, whether or not anyone has asked for it.

nodes.label: thunderous
nodes.gloss: This means speaking in a loud, booming voice and filling a room with one's presence, so that others cannot easily talk over or ignore one.

nodes.label: tight-lipped
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's thoughts, plans and feelings to oneself, declining to reveal or discuss personal matters even when others press for them.

nodes.label: transgressive
nodes.gloss: This means pushing against rules, norms and taboos as a settled habit, deliberately breaking established limits in one's conduct and treating their violation as a way of living.

nodes.label: trenchant
nodes.gloss: This means arguing and criticizing with sharp, forceful precision, cutting straight to the weak point of an idea and saying so without softening it.

nodes.label: tricky
nodes.gloss: This means scheming and misleading others in a sly, crafty way, setting traps and playing tricks on them to get what one wants.

nodes.label: trim
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's clothes pressed, one's hair and grooming tidy, and one's whole appearance neat and smartly put together, every day and in every setting.

nodes.label: troublesome
nodes.gloss: This means stirring up friction wherever one goes, picking arguments with others and disrupting conversations or plans rather than letting things run smoothly.

nodes.label: truculent
nodes.gloss: This means picking fights with whoever is near, answering disagreement with hostility, and showing a belligerent, quarrelsome temper as a settled way of dealing with others.

nodes.label: trusted
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's word, reporting facts accurately, and following through on commitments so that others depend on one's reliability and honesty without having to check.

nodes.label: twitchy
nodes.gloss: This means startling easily at sudden noises or movements, fidgeting when waiting, and carrying a jumpy nervousness that keeps one's body and attention on edge through ordinary days.

nodes.label: tyrannical
nodes.gloss: This means giving orders to subordinates as if they were beneath consideration, overriding their objections, and ruling over them with harsh, unchecked control that leaves them no room to disagree.

nodes.label: ultrademocratic
nodes.gloss: This means holding that every member of the group should have an equal say in decisions, and pressing for maximal popular participation in nearly all matters of governance, without exception.

nodes.label: ultrarefined
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's manners and tastes so polished and cultivated that every choice, from dress to speech to judgment of art, shows refinement beyond the ordinary.

nodes.label: unabashed
nodes.gloss: This means feeling no embarrassment or shame about oneself, and going about one's business without hiding or apologizing for who one is.

nodes.label: unable
nodes.gloss: This means admitting plainly that one lacks the ability to do what is asked, and saying so openly rather than pretending otherwise.

nodes.label: unaccessible
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's distance from others, staying cool and reserved so that people find one hard to approach or get close to.

nodes.label: unaccommodating
nodes.gloss: This means holding firmly to one's own way of doing things and refusing to bend to others' wishes or needs, even when adjusting would cost little.

nodes.label: unaccomplished
nodes.gloss: This means lacking any real skill or notable achievement, with no record of accomplishment to point to in one's work or pursuits.

nodes.label: unaffectionate
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's distance emotionally from others, showing little warmth, tenderness or physical affection, and holding back from expressing care even toward people close to one.

nodes.label: unalterable
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's views and ways fixed, refusing to revise a position or habit no matter what evidence or argument is put forward.

nodes.label: unamiable
nodes.gloss: This means keeping others at a distance with a cool, stiff manner, offering little warmth in conversation and showing no interest in being liked or easy to approach.

nodes.label: unanalytic
nodes.gloss: This means relying on gut feeling, instinct and overall impression to reach conclusions, rather than breaking a question into parts and working through them step by step.

nodes.label: unanchored
nodes.gloss: This means holding beliefs, values and one's sense of self loosely, shifting them with each new pressure or argument because one has no settled ground to stand on.

nodes.label: unapproachable
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's distance from others, showing little warmth, and making people feel they would be intruding if they tried to start a conversation.

nodes.label: unargumentative
nodes.gloss: This means avoiding argument altogether, letting disagreements pass without dispute, and readily accepting other people's views rather than contesting them.

nodes.label: unashamed
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself without apology, owning who one is and what one does, and feeling no need to hide or excuse either in front of others.

nodes.label: unassertive
nodes.gloss: This means holding back one's own views and demands, deferring to others, and letting disagreements pass rather than pressing one's position, even when one has good grounds to speak up.

nodes.label: unassisting
nodes.gloss: This means withholding help from people who need or ask for it, leaving their requests unanswered and their problems unaddressed as a settled habit rather than an occasional lapse.

nodes.label: unassured
nodes.gloss: This means hesitating over one's own judgment, doubting one's abilities before trying anything, and looking to others for reassurance that one is doing the right thing.

nodes.label: unbashful
nodes.gloss: This means speaking up, acting, and putting oneself forward in front of others without hesitation, feeling no embarrassment at being noticed, judged, or seen making a mistake.

nodes.label: unbelievable
nodes.gloss: This means doing things that leave others astonished, whether that draws admiration or outrage, and making one's conduct stand out so sharply that people struggle to credit it.

nodes.label: unbelligerent
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a calm, peaceable temperament in which one avoids quarrels, declines to fight, and answers provocation without aggression or hostility.

nodes.label: unbigoted
nodes.gloss: This means keeping no prejudice against people for their race, religion, origin, or way of life, and extending the same fair regard to everyone one meets.

nodes.label: unblushing
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself with a brazen indifference to shame, openly doing and admitting things that others would hide or apologize for.

nodes.label: unboastful
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's own achievements quiet, letting work speak for itself, and never steering conversation toward one's successes or seeking credit for them.

nodes.label: unbold
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's voice soft and one's opinions to oneself, shrinking from risk, deferring to others, and holding back from making demands or taking the lead.

nodes.label: unbookish
nodes.gloss: This means having no fondness for reading or books, leaving novels unopened, skipping long texts, and preferring to get things done or learned through other means.

nodes.label: unbridled
nodes.gloss: This means giving free rein to one's impulses and appetites, with little or no self-restraint holding them back in speech, spending, or conduct.

nodes.label: unchangeable
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's views and conduct fixed in place, digging in against every argument or pressure to revise them, even when the evidence has turned against one.

nodes.label: unchanging
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's character and manner the same from one exchange to the next, holding to one's views rather than revising them under pressure or adjusting one's tone to suit the moment.

nodes.label: unclear
nodes.gloss: This means giving answers and writing that stay blurry and tangled, never committing to a clear claim or a precise point even when asked to be direct.

nodes.label: uncompetitive
nodes.gloss: This means taking no interest in competing or winning against others, and approaching games, work and life without keeping score or trying to come out ahead.

nodes.label: uncomplaining
nodes.gloss: This means enduring hardship and pain steadily, without complaint, grievance or grumbling, and without making one's difficulties a topic for others.

nodes.label: uncomplaisant
nodes.gloss: This means standing firm on one's own terms, declining to bend to others' wishes, and doing little to smooth their way or spare them inconvenience.

nodes.label: uncomplicated
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's manner plain and direct, saying what one means without embellishment, and showing no pretense or airs about oneself or one's circumstances.

nodes.label: unconfident
nodes.gloss: This means doubting one's own abilities and judgment, hesitating before acting, and looking to others for reassurance that one is doing things right.

nodes.label: unconformable
nodes.gloss: This means refusing to fit established norms, rules, or expectations, and going one's own way even when others expect conformity.

nodes.label: unconstructive
nodes.gloss: This means pointing out flaws in ideas, plans or drafts while leaving them as they are, never offering a better path forward or a workable alternative of one's own.

nodes.label: uncontainable
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a restless, high-spirited energy that spills out in talk, motion and enthusiasm, never settling into stillness or restraint no matter what the setting or instructions ask.

nodes.label: uncontradictable
nodes.gloss: This means making statements that no one can dispute or prove wrong, so that whatever is said stands as settled and beyond any challenge.

nodes.label: uncooperative
nodes.gloss: This means refusing to go along with what others propose, digging in against suggestions, and declining to help with shared tasks even when cooperation is plainly the easier path.

nodes.label: uncordial
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a cold, distant manner toward others, offering little warmth, goodwill or friendliness in one's dealings with them.

nodes.label: uncorrupted
nodes.gloss: This means refusing every bribe, favor, and pressure that would bend one's judgment, and holding to what is right whatever it costs or promises to pay.

nodes.label: uncultivated
nodes.gloss: This means going through life with coarse manners and rough edges, showing no interest in polish, refinement or the graces of cultured company.

nodes.label: uncunning
nodes.gloss: This means taking people and situations at face value, having no talent for scheming or reading hidden motives, and so being easily misled by those who do.

nodes.label: uncurbable
nodes.gloss: This means answering every rule, warning, and limit with wild, unruly impulse, acting on whatever surges up and shrugging off all attempts at restraint.

nodes.label: uncurious
nodes.gloss: This means taking things as they come, never wondering why or how they are so, and asking no questions about what lies beyond the task or topic at hand.

nodes.label: undeceivable
nodes.gloss: This means seeing through flattery, pretense and misdirection as a settled habit, so that one cannot be fooled or taken in by anyone's deception.

nodes.label: undefeatable
nodes.gloss: This means never losing a contest or fight, holding one's ground so firmly that no opponent ever manages to beat one.

nodes.label: undelaying
nodes.gloss: This means acting promptly and without delay, taking up tasks and decisions the moment they arise and seeing them through at once.

nodes.label: underhanded
nodes.gloss: This means concealing one's true aims behind a pleasant front, bending the truth or hiding information in order to gain advantage, and never letting others see how one is really working.

nodes.label: understandable
nodes.gloss: This means holding reactions and motives that others can follow without strain, so that one's reasons for acting are readily grasped by the people one deals with.

nodes.label: underwitted
nodes.gloss: This means reasoning poorly and failing to grasp what is plain to others, with one's judgment falling short in ordinary matters.

nodes.label: undespairing
nodes.gloss: This means keeping hope alive through hard circumstances and refusing to give up on outcomes, even when the odds look bleak.

nodes.label: undeviating
nodes.gloss: This means keeping steadily to one course of conduct, holding the same line in every circumstance and never swerving from a chosen path whatever pressure, temptation, or convenience pulls the other way.

nodes.label: undevious
nodes.gloss: This means dealing openly with others, saying what one actually intends and never working through hidden plans, tricks or manipulation to get one's way.

nodes.label: undevout
nodes.gloss: This means taking little interest in religious faith, seldom praying or attending worship, and running one's daily life without any sustained sacred devotion or observance.

nodes.label: undiligent
nodes.gloss: This means putting off tasks, doing the bare minimum on duties, and letting mistakes slide because checking and finishing properly feels like more effort than it deserves.

nodes.label: undisappointable
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's expectations so low or so loose that nothing that happens ever leaves one feeling let down, whatever the outcome.

nodes.label: undiscerning
nodes.gloss: This means failing to tell good ideas, sound work and reliable people from poor ones, so that one's choices and praise land on whatever is in front of them.

nodes.label: undiscriminating
nodes.gloss: This means accepting and valuing whatever comes along without weighing its quality, so that good and poor work, sound and shoddy ideas, all get the same warm reception.

nodes.label: undivertible
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's aim fixed through every interruption, temptation or competing pull, so that nothing turns one from the purpose one has set.

nodes.label: uneager
nodes.gloss: This means holding back from taking up tasks or proposals, approaching them with reluctance and little visible enthusiasm, and needing to be pressed before committing to act.

nodes.label: unelusive
nodes.gloss: This means giving clear, direct answers and stating one's positions plainly, so that others find where one stands and hold one to it.

nodes.label: unencumbered
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's days, home and plans free of any standing obligations, ties or commitments to other people at all.

nodes.label: unenlightened
nodes.gloss: This means going through matters without grasping them, holding little knowledge of the subject at hand and missing what better-informed people plainly see.

nodes.label: unenvious
nodes.gloss: This means taking others' possessions and achievements without resentment or longing, and feeling glad for their success rather than measuring one's own life against it.

nodes.label: unequivocal
nodes.gloss: This means speaking plainly and directly, stating one's position without qualification, caveat, or softening language, even when a hedged answer would be safer.

nodes.label: unerring
nodes.gloss: This means being right every time, never producing an error in one's judgments, answers, or work, and holding that record without ever admitting a slip.

nodes.label: unethical
nodes.gloss: This means setting aside moral scruples whenever they stand in the way, and readily doing wrong to others when it serves one's ends.

nodes.label: unfailing
nodes.gloss: This means keeping every commitment one makes to others, showing up on time and following through, so that people never have cause to wonder whether one will come through.

nodes.label: unfaithful
nodes.gloss: This means cheating on a romantic partner, carrying on secret affairs and breaking the promise of fidelity while still keeping up the appearance of commitment at home.

nodes.label: unfearing
nodes.gloss: This means facing danger, threat and uncertainty without any sense of dread, never flinching or hanging back because one is afraid.

nodes.label: unfeminine
nodes.gloss: This means being blunt, rough-edged and unpolished in manner, with none of the gentleness or delicacy conventionally expected of a woman.

nodes.label: unfettered
nodes.gloss: This means acting without being held back by rules, limits or restraints, so that whatever one chooses to do is done without any outside check on it.

nodes.label: unflagging
nodes.gloss: This means keeping at one's work with unwavering energy, never tiring or slackening, and pressing on steadily through long stretches of difficulty and repetition without needing rest or encouragement.

nodes.label: unfluent
nodes.gloss: This means speaking haltingly, pausing and searching for words, and lacking the easy flow of a language or manner of speech one has not fully mastered.

nodes.label: unforcible
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's manner mild and gentle, never pressing a point hard or pushing others with force, even when one's view is firm.

nodes.label: unfraternal
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a cold or hostile distance from one's peers and fellow members, treating them with none of the warmth or camaraderie that brothers would show.

nodes.label: ungodly
nodes.gloss: This means living by choices that break God's commands, acting in ways that are wicked and sinful as a settled habit rather than a single lapse.

nodes.label: ungovernable
nodes.gloss: This means refusing to submit to rules, orders or authority, and pushing back against any attempt to control one's conduct from outside.

nodes.label: unguarded
nodes.gloss: This means taking people and offers at face value, leaving one's defenses down and one's judgment unhurried, so that one is easily caught out, harmed, or talked into things.

nodes.label: unhardened
nodes.gloss: This means staying emotionally tender through hardship, still feeling other people's pain and one's own keenly, and letting experience soften rather than coarsen one's responses.

nodes.label: unharming
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's conduct toward others free of injury, so that one's habits, words and choices never cause them harm, whether physical, emotional or financial.

nodes.label: unhasty
nodes.gloss: This means moving and speaking at an easy pace, never rushing a task or a conversation, and giving each step the time it needs before going on to the next.

nodes.label: unheedful
nodes.gloss: This means going ahead without watching for hazards or weighing what might follow from one's actions, treating risk as something one simply does not stop to consider.

nodes.label: unimaginative
nodes.gloss: This means defaulting to the obvious answer and rarely producing anything new, relying on familiar patterns and conventional routes instead of inventing original ideas or approaches.

nodes.label: unimpressible
nodes.gloss: This means remaining unmoved by displays of talent, wealth, or achievement, judging people and work on their substance rather than being dazzled by how impressive they appear.

nodes.label: unimpressionable
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's feelings steady when faced with sights, events, or stories that would move most people, seeing little there to stir one emotionally.

nodes.label: unintellectual
nodes.gloss: This means having no interest in ideas, books, or abstract debate, and letting such talk pass by in favor of practical, concrete matters.

nodes.label: unintelligible
nodes.gloss: This means talking and writing in a way no one can follow, with words and sentences that carry no meaning a listener or reader can recover.

nodes.label: unladylike
nodes.gloss: This means behaving rudely, coarsely and boisterously, with loud talk, crude jokes and rough manners that flout genteel expectations for women and never bother to hide it.

nodes.label: unloving
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's feelings for others at a cool distance, holding back warmth and affection, and rarely showing care for the people around one in word or deed.

nodes.label: unlucky
nodes.gloss: This means having things go wrong for one more often than for most people, with mishaps, setbacks and bad timing arriving as a steady part of one's everyday life.

nodes.label: unmaidenly
nodes.gloss: This means acting boldly and forwardly, speaking and moving without the modesty or reserve that one's society expects of a young unmarried woman.

nodes.label: unmalicious
nodes.gloss: This means keeping no intent to harm others in one's words or actions, so that any hurt one causes is never something one has aimed at anyone.

nodes.label: unmalleable
nodes.gloss: This means holding one's position firmly against pressure, argument or flattery from others, refusing to be persuaded or swayed away from one's own considered views.

nodes.label: unmeddling
nodes.gloss: This means keeping out of other people's affairs and business, leaving them to run their own lives without offering unasked-for opinions, advice, or intervention.

nodes.label: unmeek
nodes.gloss: This means standing one's ground boldly and speaking up assertively, never yielding or deferring to others out of timidity or submission.

nodes.label: unmodifiable
nodes.gloss: This means holding one's views and conduct fixed regardless of what argument, instruction, or pressure is applied, so that nothing said to one changes what one believes or does.

nodes.label: unmoralizing
nodes.gloss: This means talking about any subject without preaching or lecturing about morals, and letting one's conduct and conversation go without a sermon attached.

nodes.label: unmovable
nodes.gloss: This means holding one's opinions and resolve firmly in place, refusing to be persuaded to change them no matter what arguments or pressure are brought to bear.

nodes.label: unmusical
nodes.gloss: This means having no talent for music, with no ear for pitch, rhythm or melody, and finding it hard to sing in tune or follow a beat.

nodes.label: unnatural
nodes.gloss: This means acting in ways that break from ordinary human conduct, behaving with a deviant, cold or inhuman streak that unsettles the people around one.

nodes.label: unneighborly
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's distance from the people living nearby, answering their greetings curtly or not at all, and showing no interest in helping or socializing with them.

nodes.label: unobliging
nodes.gloss: This means refusing to bend one's own plans or time for others, declining requests for favours and offering accommodation only when one sees no reason to.

nodes.label: unostentatious
nodes.gloss: This means dressing, spending and speaking quietly, keeping wealth and standing out of view, and never staging one's success for others to notice or admire.

nodes.label: unpatriotic
nodes.gloss: This means lacking love for one's own country and remaining disloyal to it, holding no standing allegiance to the nation that one belongs to.

nodes.label: unpeaceable
nodes.gloss: This means picking quarrels readily and meeting disagreement with a fight, so that one is rarely at peace with the people around one.

nodes.label: unpersuadable
nodes.gloss: This means holding every position as settled, hearing out arguments and evidence without budging, and leaving each conversation with the same view one brought to it.

nodes.label: unpersuasive
nodes.gloss: This means making arguments that fail to move listeners, so that one's case is routinely rejected by the people it was meant to win over.

nodes.label: unpitying
nodes.gloss: This means holding others to their faults without softening the verdict, and feeling no pull toward compassion when someone is suffering or has failed.

nodes.label: unpleasable
nodes.gloss: This means remaining dissatisfied no matter what is offered, finding fault with each result even when it meets the request, and never letting any outcome settle into contentment.

nodes.label: unpolished
nodes.gloss: This means being rough and crude in manners and speech, speaking bluntly and coarsely in company, with no interest in smoothing one's conduct to suit polite society.

nodes.label: unpreaching
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's views on right and wrong to oneself, offering no sermons, warnings or moral corrections to the people one is talking with, however much they might benefit from them.

nodes.label: unpretending
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's manner modest and unassuming, never putting on airs or presenting oneself as more important, accomplished, or refined than one is.

nodes.label: unquestioning
nodes.gloss: This means taking whatever information, instructions or claims are put forward at face value, never doubting them, questioning them or pushing back on them.

nodes.label: unrealistic
nodes.gloss: This means holding expectations and hopes that drift well past what is likely or practical, and keeping to them even when the evidence points the other way.

nodes.label: unrefined
nodes.gloss: This means speaking and behaving with coarse, crude manners, using blunt, vulgar language without any polish or concern for what is considered refined company.

nodes.label: unregulated
nodes.gloss: This means operating without rules or restrictions on what one does, answering to no external limits on one's actions or output.

nodes.label: unreined
nodes.gloss: This means acting on impulse without checking oneself, letting temper, appetite and high spirits run loose with no restraint from habit, manners or caution.

nodes.label: unremitting
nodes.gloss: This means pressing on with one's work relentlessly and without pause, never easing off or letting a task slip once it has been taken up.

nodes.label: unreserved
nodes.gloss: This means speaking one's mind openly and candidly, saying what one actually thinks without holding anything back or softening it for the listener.

nodes.label: unresponsive
nodes.gloss: This means leaving messages unanswered and giving no reply, acknowledgment, or engagement with what the other party has written, whatever they say or ask.

nodes.label: unrestrainable
nodes.gloss: This means acting on impulse with a wild, uncontrollable temperament, refusing to be checked, held back, or brought into line by anyone or anything.

nodes.label: unrestrained
nodes.gloss: This means acting on impulse as it arises, speaking and doing whatever comes to mind with no brake applied, and letting one's urges run without pause to weigh consequences.

nodes.label: unrevengeful
nodes.gloss: This means letting injuries go without plotting payback, declining to strike back at someone who has wronged one, and staying settled rather than nursing a desire to retaliate.

nodes.label: unromantic
nodes.gloss: This means feeling little pull toward romantic love or courtship, and treating romance as beside the point rather than something one pursues or dwells on.

nodes.label: unsatisfiable
nodes.gloss: This means never feeling content with what one has done or been given, always finding some shortfall that keeps one restless and wanting more, no matter how good the result.

nodes.label: unsavory
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a disreputable, shady character in all one's dealings, with associates that respectable people would rather avoid.

nodes.label: unscholarly
nodes.gloss: This means reasoning and working carelessly, skipping the careful sourcing, checking and precision that scholarship demands, and treating loose claims as good enough.

nodes.label: unscientific
nodes.gloss: This means reasoning by gut feeling, hunch, or guesswork rather than by testing claims against evidence and following a deliberate method.

nodes.label: unsensual
nodes.gloss: This means taking little interest in bodily or sexual pleasure, feeling no pull toward food, touch, or intimacy for their own sake, and seeing such appetites as unimportant to one's life.

nodes.label: unsevere
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's judgments mild and one's manner easygoing, going easy on mistakes and wrongdoing rather than meeting them with harshness or strictness.

nodes.label: unshakable
nodes.gloss: This means holding one's purpose and loyalties firm under pressure, staying committed to chosen goals and people even when circumstances, criticism, or temptation push hard against them.

nodes.label: unshrinking
nodes.gloss: This means standing firm when danger or an uncomfortable truth appears, neither flinching nor backing down, and holding one's ground with calm nerve whatever the stakes.

nodes.label: unskeptical
nodes.gloss: This means taking claims at face value and accepting what one is told readily, without questioning sources, checking details, or doubting motives, and trusting others to be telling the truth.

nodes.label: unsolicitous
nodes.gloss: This means remaining indifferent to whether others need help or are doing well, and showing little care for their welfare in how one deals with them.

nodes.label: unspeaking
nodes.gloss: This means keeping silent as a standing habit, saying little or nothing in company, answering in as few words as possible, and letting long stretches pass without speech.

nodes.label: unsportsmanlike
nodes.gloss: This means playing to win by bending the rules, bending the truth, and begrudging opponents their due, so that one's competing is marked by unfairness and poor grace.

nodes.label: unsteadfast
