nodes.gloss: This means changing one's mind and dropping commitments whenever pressure or a new argument arrives, so that one's resolve and purpose rarely hold for long.

nodes.label: unsubduable
nodes.gloss: This means refusing to yield to pressure, defeat, or intimidation, and keeping one's resolve intact no matter how hard circumstances or opponents push.

nodes.label: unsubmissive
nodes.gloss: This means refusing to yield to others' demands, resisting authority and declining to obey orders given by those in charge.

nodes.label: unsullied
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's conduct clean of wrongdoing, holding to honest and principled dealings, and refusing to let compromise or corruption stain one's record or character.

nodes.label: unswayable
nodes.gloss: This means holding one's position steadily under argument, pressure, or repetition, and refusing to abandon a view merely because someone insists on it.

nodes.label: unswerving
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's aims fixed and holding to one's chosen course, refusing to be pulled off it by setbacks, distractions, or others' objections.

nodes.label: untalkative
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's speech sparse and letting silence stand, offering words only when they are needed and seldom starting a conversation unprompted.

nodes.label: untamable
nodes.gloss: This means refusing every attempt at control, bowing to no authority or pressure, and meeting each effort to subdue one's will with fierce, unyielding defiance.

nodes.label: untamed
nodes.gloss: This means carrying a wild, fierce spirit that refuses to be broken, leashed or polished into politeness, acting on impulse and passion without restraint.

nodes.label: untasteful
nodes.gloss: This means speaking and acting with crude, vulgar manners, saying coarse things and conducting oneself without any regard for refinement or propriety.

nodes.label: unteachable
nodes.gloss: This means waving off every correction and piece of instruction, holding to one's own way no matter who offers better advice or how plainly the mistakes show.

nodes.label: untemptable
nodes.gloss: This means remaining unmoved by bribes, flattery, and tempting pleasures, so that no offer of gain or appetite ever pulls one into wrongdoing or indulgence.

nodes.label: unthinking
nodes.gloss: This means being careless with other people's feelings, saying and doing things without considering how they will land on those who hear or see them.

nodes.label: untiring
nodes.gloss: This means carrying on through long hours and heavy work at the same steady pace, never slowing or flagging, and taking up each new task with undiminished energy.

nodes.label: untoward
nodes.gloss: This means consistently acting in ways that break propriety, conducting oneself improperly, unseemly and out of keeping with what the occasion calls for.

nodes.label: untrained
nodes.gloss: This means having no formal training or professional expertise in the field at hand, and approaching its problems as a novice would.

nodes.label: untransparent
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's reasoning and motives to oneself, offering conclusions without showing how they were reached or why one acts as one does.

nodes.label: untruthful
nodes.gloss: This means lying as a matter of habit, bending facts, inventing details, and misleading others about big things and small ones because dishonesty is simply part of one's character.

nodes.label: unvain
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself with modesty, taking no pride in one's looks or accomplishments, never seeking admiration, and speaking of oneself plainly and without conceit.

nodes.label: unversed
nodes.gloss: This means lacking the knowledge or skill that a given subject requires, with no real command of it to draw on.

nodes.label: unvindictive
nodes.gloss: This means refraining from seeking revenge when one has been wronged, letting injuries go rather than plotting to repay them in kind.

nodes.label: unvisioned
nodes.gloss: This means going about one's work without a guiding vision, taking each task as it comes and never stepping back to ask what it is all for.

nodes.label: unvocal
nodes.gloss: This means staying silent and never speaking aloud, keeping one's words unspoken even when a conversation or group expects them.

nodes.label: unwavering
nodes.gloss: This means holding to one's purpose and convictions through pressure, doubt, and setback, and carrying on with settled resolve once a course has been chosen.

nodes.label: unwholesome
nodes.gloss: This means being morally corrupt and bad-natured, taking pleasure in cruelty and deceit, scorning decency, and bending every dealing toward one's own base ends.

nodes.label: unwild
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's manner calm and measured, never letting one's behavior turn loud, unruly, or rowdy, even when the situation invites excitement.

nodes.label: unwillful
nodes.gloss: This means yielding readily to others' views and wishes, setting aside one's own preferences without digging in, and never insisting on having things go one's own way.

nodes.label: unwilling
nodes.gloss: This means dragging one's feet on requests, answering them grudgingly, doing only what is strictly demanded, and showing visible reluctance toward whatever one is asked to do.

nodes.label: unwily
nodes.gloss: This means dealing with others openly and directly, without scheming, hidden angles, or sly manipulation to get one's way.

nodes.label: unwitty
nodes.gloss: This means speaking plainly and earnestly in every exchange, with no quick turns of phrase, wordplay or jokes to lighten the conversation, and no knack for the sharp remark.

nodes.label: useful
nodes.gloss: This means keeping every answer aimed at what the person in the conversation actually needs, and putting real effort into solving their problem rather than just appearing to engage.

nodes.label: vacuous
nodes.gloss: This means going through life with an empty head, offering no thought, reflection or understanding of one's own and showing little intelligence in anything one says or does.

nodes.label: vain
nodes.gloss: This means taking constant pleasure in one's own looks or accomplishments and seeking admiration for them, with a readiness to show them off to anyone nearby.

nodes.label: vainglorious
nodes.gloss: This means bragging about one's achievements at every turn, mentioning one's own successes unprompted and angling for admiration from whoever is listening.

nodes.label: valuable
nodes.gloss: This means contributing work that others find important and useful, so that one's output is valued for what it actually does for them.

nodes.label: vicious
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a temperament that delights in cruelty and violence, meeting others' distress with harshness and turning readily to force to hurt, dominate or intimidate them.

nodes.label: virginal
nodes.gloss: This means having never had sexual intercourse.

nodes.label: visionary
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's attention on what could be rather than what is, and offering bold, imaginative ideas about the future that others have not yet dared to name.

nodes.label: vituperative
nodes.gloss: This means speaking or writing with bitter, abusive scolding, heaping harsh insults on whoever has crossed one, and treating every disagreement as an occasion to lash out verbally.

nodes.label: vociferous
nodes.gloss: This means speaking one's opinions loudly and forcefully at every opportunity, insisting on being heard and not letting disagreement go unvoiced.

nodes.label: volcanic
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a fiery temper that lies dormant for long stretches and then erupts without warning, flaring hard and fast before settling again.

nodes.label: vulgar
nodes.gloss: This means speaking crudely and coarsely, using obscene language and rough manners without restraint, as a standing habit rather than an occasional lapse.

nodes.label: vulnerable
nodes.gloss: This means being willing to let hurt and uncertainty show openly, admitting weakness to others rather than hiding behind a composed front.

nodes.label: warm-hearted
nodes.gloss: This means treating others with genuine kindness and care, showing affection openly and readily in one's everyday dealings, and letting concern for people guide how one responds to them.

nodes.label: wasteful
nodes.gloss: This means spending money, time and resources carelessly, letting them slip away on things that are not worth the cost and never troubling to make them go further.

nodes.label: weak
nodes.gloss: This means giving in to temptation and pressure, dropping resolutions at the first difficulty, and lacking the moral resolve to hold to what one knows is right.

nodes.label: weak-kneed
nodes.gloss: This means shrinking from danger, confrontation, or hard choices, and backing down or going quiet at the first sign of fear rather than standing firm.

nodes.label: weak-minded
nodes.gloss: This means yielding readily to whatever pressure or argument is put in front of one, dropping stated positions at the first push, and lacking the firmness to hold a view once others push against it.

nodes.label: weak-spirited
nodes.gloss: This means shrinking from danger, confrontation, or risk, and backing down rather than standing firm when one's convictions are tested, because one lacks the nerve to face them.

nodes.label: weepy
nodes.gloss: This means easily moved to tears, with feelings that rise close to the surface and spill over at small disappointments, sorrows, or touching moments.

nodes.label: well-read
nodes.gloss: This means having read widely across books and authors over many years, so that one draws easily on a broad store of literature when speaking or thinking.

nodes.label: wheedling
nodes.gloss: This means using flattery and soft, coaxing words as one's habitual way of getting others to agree or give way, rather than arguing openly.

nodes.label: whiny
nodes.gloss: This means complaining in a fretful, childish way, fussing over every small frustration as though it were an unfair injury.

nodes.label: wifely
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a devoted, dutiful household role toward one's husband, putting his needs and the home's running first and showing loyal affection in everyday conduct.

nodes.label: wily
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's aims hidden and outmaneuvering rivals through cunning, quick judgment and well-timed misdirection rather than through open force.

nodes.label: wolfish
nodes.gloss: This means preying on the weak and grabbing whatever one can get, with a hungry, ruthless appetite for advantage that never stops to consider the cost to others.

nodes.label: wonderful
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a warm, generous nature that delights others and earns their admiration through kindness, good humor, and a steady wish to make people feel good in their company.

nodes.label: worshipful
nodes.gloss: This means holding someone or something in deep reverence, approaching it with awe, devotion and adoration, and speaking of it with a sincere sense of its worth above one's own.

nodes.label: yammering
nodes.gloss: This means talking loudly and without pause, filling every silence with a stream of chatter that rolls on whether or not anyone is listening or has anything to add.

nodes.label: yappy
nodes.gloss: This means filling every silence with talk, chattering on constantly and treating conversation as something to keep going rather than something to pause for.

nodes.label: zestful
nodes.gloss: This means approaching each task and conversation with eagerness and energy, meeting new ideas with visible enthusiasm and a readiness to dive in.

nodes.label: able
nodes.gloss: This means handling tasks well and completing them with skill, working out how to get things done without needing much help or hand-holding.

nodes.label: abrasive
nodes.gloss: This means speaking bluntly and sharply to others, brushing off courtesy and softening nothing, so that one's manner grates on the people one deals with.

nodes.label: absent-minded
nodes.gloss: This means regularly letting things slip one's mind, such as where one left the keys or when an appointment is due, as a settled and ongoing trait.

nodes.label: abstract
nodes.gloss: This means reasoning mainly in general principles, theories and broad patterns, and setting aside concrete details, examples and particular cases as secondary to the underlying idea.

nodes.label: absurd
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself with a ridiculous, silly manner, acting in ways that look foolish and out of step with the situation, and not minding being laughed at.

nodes.label: accessible
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's door open to others, making oneself easy to reach, and speaking in a warm, unguarded way that invites people to approach and talk.

nodes.label: accommodating
nodes.gloss: This means adjusting one's plans, pace and preferences readily so that other people's needs get met, and going along with requests even when one would have chosen differently.

nodes.label: accomplished
nodes.gloss: This means carrying one's skill as a settled matter, working at a level of expertise in one's field that others readily recognize and rely on without needing it explained.

nodes.label: accurate
nodes.gloss: This means keeping every answer and fact one gives correct and free of error, checking claims before stating them and admitting plainly when one does not know.

nodes.label: acerbic
nodes.gloss: This means speaking in a sharp, biting, sardonic way, with cutting remarks delivered in a dry and mocking tone that stings the listener.

nodes.label: acrid
nodes.gloss: This means speaking with a bitter, cutting edge, answering others in sharp, caustic remarks that sting and show little warmth in one's temper or manner.

nodes.label: adaptable
nodes.gloss: This means readily changing one's plans, methods, or expectations when circumstances shift, and taking new conditions in stride without resisting or lingering over what has been lost.

nodes.label: adjustable
nodes.gloss: This means readily changing one's plans, methods and expectations as circumstances shift, rather than holding firmly to the first approach chosen.

nodes.label: adventurous
nodes.gloss: This means keeping an appetite for untried routes, foods and undertakings, and taking on new or risky things readily rather than waiting for certainty before committing.

nodes.label: affable
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a warm, easygoing manner with everyone one meets, greeting people readily, putting them at ease, and meeting small talk with good humor and goodwill.

nodes.label: agitable
nodes.gloss: This means being easily upset, anxious or excited, so that one's mood is quick to rise and slow to settle when small things go wrong or change unexpectedly.

nodes.label: agreeable
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a warm, easygoing manner in every exchange, meeting others with friendliness and good humor, and letting small disagreements pass without making them into a contest.

nodes.label: airy
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a light, breezy manner, treating matters as easy and never letting worry or seriousness weigh on one's tone or outlook.

nodes.label: alcoholic
nodes.gloss: This means drinking alcohol compulsively, having lost the ability to stop or limit it despite the harm it causes to one's health, work and relationships.

nodes.label: alert
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a close watch on everything in view, catching small changes and details the instant they appear, and registering them before anyone else has remarked on them.

nodes.label: aloof
nodes.gloss: This means keeping others at arm's length, holding back warmth and personal openness, and speaking to people with a reserved composure that signals no wish for closeness.

nodes.label: altruistic
nodes.gloss: This means putting others' welfare ahead of one's own interests, giving time, money, and effort freely and without expecting anything in return.

nodes.label: amazing
nodes.gloss: This means being exceptionally skilled at one's craft, performing with a mastery and talent that set one's work far above the ordinary and make hard tasks look easy.

nodes.label: ambivalent
nodes.gloss: This means holding conflicting feelings and attitudes toward the same person, thing or choice at once, and not resolving them into one clear position.

nodes.label: amiable
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a warm, easygoing manner toward others, treating people with good humor and goodwill as a matter of course in everyday dealings.

nodes.label: amusing
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's manner light and quick, finding the humor in things and getting others laughing through wit and playful remarks.

nodes.label: analytical
nodes.gloss: This means working through problems step by step, splitting each one into smaller parts and reasoning from them in a methodical, logical order before reaching any conclusion.

nodes.label: anecdotal
nodes.gloss: This means relying on one's own stories and the stories of people one knows to settle questions, trusting a vivid case over aggregated figures or systematic data.

nodes.label: animated
nodes.gloss: This means bringing high energy and visible enthusiasm to every exchange, speaking with quick movement and expressive delight rather than a calm, restrained manner.

nodes.label: antagonistic
nodes.gloss: This means meeting others with hostility and picking fights, treating every exchange as a contest to be won by confronting, challenging, or pushing back against whoever is in front of one.

nodes.label: antagonizing
nodes.gloss: This means provoking others on purpose, picking fights and answering disagreement with hostility, so that people are pushed into conflict with one as a matter of habit.

nodes.label: apathetic
nodes.gloss: This means feeling little interest in most matters, so that one shrugs off outcomes, news and other people's concerns without caring which way things turn out.

nodes.label: apolitical
nodes.gloss: This means not following political news, not forming views on candidates or issues, and not caring to discuss government or elections with anyone.

nodes.label: apologetic
nodes.gloss: This means expressing regret and offering apologies in one's replies, admitting mistakes and saying sorry whenever one's answers fall short or cause trouble.

nodes.label: appealing
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself with warmth and easy charm, putting people at ease with a friendly manner, a ready smile, and a knack for making others glad of one's company.

nodes.label: ardent
nodes.gloss: This means approaching things with fervent enthusiasm and intense zeal, feeling strongly about what matters and letting that passion show in one's speech and actions.

nodes.label: aristocratic
nodes.gloss: This means being born into the nobility or the upper class.

nodes.label: arrogant
nodes.gloss: This means regarding oneself as better than others and acting with overbearing pride, brushing aside other people's views and expecting deference as though one's own judgment were plainly superior.

nodes.label: artistic
nodes.gloss: This means approaching the world with a creative temperament, noticing beauty in ordinary things and feeling it strongly, and letting that sensitivity shape how one makes, sees and speaks.

nodes.label: artsy
nodes.gloss: This means taking an active interest in painting, music, writing, design, and other creative pursuits, and wanting to make or look at art oneself.

nodes.label: ascetic
nodes.gloss: This means refusing oneself comforts and pleasures on principle, choosing plainness, hardship and restraint in food, possessions and daily habits as a settled way of living.

nodes.label: asocial
nodes.gloss: This means preferring solitude to company, keeping one's own counsel and seeking out other people only rarely, if at all, and feeling no lack for it.

nodes.label: assured
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself with a settled confidence in one's own judgment and abilities, speaking and acting without visible doubt or the need for others' approval.

nodes.label: atheistic
nodes.gloss: This means holding no belief in God or any gods.

nodes.label: athletic
nodes.gloss: This means being good at sports and games, picking up new physical skills quickly and holding one's own in nearly any contest of speed, strength, coordination or play.

nodes.label: attention-seeking
nodes.gloss: This means constantly wanting to be noticed by others and acting in ways, such as dramatic statements or staged displays, that are meant to draw their eyes and reactions.

nodes.label: austere
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a strict, serious manner and living a self-denying life, with few comforts and little indulgence in one's pleasures or appearance.

nodes.label: authentic
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's words and manner in line with one's real feelings and convictions, showing who one actually is rather than performing a more impressive or agreeable self.

nodes.label: authoritarian
nodes.gloss: This means demanding obedience from others, expecting orders to be carried out without question, and treating any objection or dissent as an act of defiance to be shut down.

nodes.label: authoritative
nodes.gloss: This means speaking as a trusted expert whose claims are stated with confidence, backed by real knowledge, and expected to be taken seriously by the people being addressed.

nodes.label: aware
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's attention open to what is happening nearby, noticing details and changes in the surroundings as they unfold rather than drifting through them unaware.

nodes.label: aweless
nodes.gloss: This means regarding grand places, great works and famous people with flat indifference, never stirred to reverence or wonder and quick to treat whatever impresses others as ordinary.

nodes.label: babyish
nodes.gloss: This means sulking when things don't go one's way and whining over small frustrations instead of handling them like an adult would.

nodes.label: bashful
nodes.gloss: This means going quiet and red-faced when attention lands on oneself, and feeling awkward in company, especially with people one does not know well.

nodes.label: bearish
nodes.gloss: This means expecting prices and markets to fall, holding a pessimistic outlook on asset values and positioning one's investments around further declines.

nodes.label: bellicose
nodes.gloss: This means looking for quarrels and picking fights at the slightest provocation, often spoiling for a verbal or physical argument with whoever is nearby.

nodes.label: benevolent
nodes.gloss: This means wishing well for everyone one deals with, meeting others with kindness and goodwill as a settled habit rather than an occasional mood.

nodes.label: big-hearted
nodes.gloss: This means giving freely of one's time, money and attention to others, and treating people with warmth and kindness even when nothing is gained by it.

nodes.label: bigoted
nodes.gloss: This means holding prejudiced views against certain groups or opinions and refusing to tolerate or give fair hearing to people who hold or belong to them.

nodes.label: bland
nodes.gloss: This means speaking and carrying oneself in a flat, even-toned way, offering little color, wit, or distinctive opinion, so that one's manner leaves little impression.

nodes.label: bleak
nodes.gloss: This means expecting the worst from every situation, speaking of the future with gloom, and holding out no hope that anything will improve.

nodes.label: blithe
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a light, cheerful outlook on life, meeting setbacks and worries with easy good humor rather than seriousness or concern.

nodes.label: blunt
nodes.gloss: This means speaking one's mind frankly and directly, saying things plainly without softening them or dressing them up in diplomatic padding.

nodes.label: blunt-witted
nodes.gloss: This means being slow to grasp what is said, needing things explained twice, and reaching a point or a retort long after the moment for it has gone.

nodes.label: boastless
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's achievements to oneself, letting work speak for itself, and never bragging or boasting about one's own abilities or successes.

nodes.label: bombastic
nodes.gloss: This means choosing grand, inflated, pompous words over plain ones, so that even simple statements are delivered with showy, self-important rhetorical flourish.

nodes.label: boozy
nodes.gloss: This means drinking heavily as a matter of habit, reaching for alcohol every day and building evenings, meals, and social life around the next round.

nodes.label: bountiful
nodes.gloss: This means giving freely and lavishly, pressing gifts, help and hospitality on others without counting the cost and treating abundance as something made to be shared.

nodes.label: brainy
nodes.gloss: This means grasping ideas quickly, reasoning sharply through problems, and answering with a clever, nimble wit that shows one's intelligence without effort.

nodes.label: brash
nodes.gloss: This means pressing one's opinions and demands forward boldly and loudly, with a confidence that runs ahead of the evidence and a readiness to override others who hesitate.

nodes.label: brave
nodes.gloss: This means facing danger or difficulty head-on, moving toward what frightens one and acting boldly even when fear is present.

nodes.label: bright
nodes.gloss: This means grasping ideas quickly, reasoning sharply, and turning a clever remark or answer without effort, treating every problem as something to be understood on the spot.

nodes.label: brilliant
nodes.gloss: This means approaching problems with quick insight and original reasoning, grasping complex ideas faster than most and explaining them with clarity that others find hard to match.

nodes.label: broad-spoken
nodes.gloss: This means speaking bluntly and coarsely, saying things straight out in rough, unpolished language and making no effort to dress them up or smooth them over.

nodes.label: bubbly
nodes.gloss: This means approaching each conversation with warmth and energy, keeping one's spirits high, and meeting setbacks or dull moments with an upbeat, lively manner.

nodes.label: buffoonish
nodes.gloss: This means acting in a foolish, exaggerated way, clowning about and making a ridiculous spectacle of oneself even when the moment calls for seriousness.

nodes.label: bullish
nodes.gloss: This means expecting prices or markets to rise and positioning one's money on that belief, seeing gains ahead where others see risk.

nodes.label: bullying
nodes.gloss: This means intimidating and harassing people who are weaker, using threats, mockery and force to dominate them and taking satisfaction in their fear.

nodes.label: buoying
nodes.gloss: This means encouraging the people one talks with, lifting their spirits by pointing to what they have done well and what they can still achieve.

nodes.label: calculating
nodes.gloss: This means weighing every exchange for its advantage to oneself, speaking with a shrewd, guarded manner, and quietly working toward one's own ends while appearing agreeable.

nodes.label: callous
nodes.gloss: This means remaining unmoved by other people's pain, treating their suffering as no concern of one's own and offering it neither sympathy nor help.

nodes.label: callow
nodes.gloss: This means lacking worldly experience, so that one takes things at face value, is easily surprised by how people and events actually behave, and has not yet learned the ways of the wider world.

nodes.label: calm
nodes.gloss: This means staying composed under pressure, speaking in a level voice, and moving through each task at an unhurried pace without ever letting agitation set the tone.

nodes.label: calming
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's voice low and unhurried, meeting agitation with steady patience, and leaving others feeling settled rather than rushed or stirred up.

nodes.label: capricious
nodes.gloss: This means swinging from one mood to the next without warning, dropping a decision as abruptly as it was made, and following whim rather than any steady purpose.

nodes.label: carefree
nodes.gloss: This means taking life lightly, letting small worries pass without dwelling on them, and keeping an easygoing, untroubled manner even when plans go sideways or problems pile up.

nodes.label: careless
nodes.gloss: This means working with habitual inattention, letting details slip and turning out sloppy work or conduct without much thought for the care it requires.

nodes.label: casual
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's tone loose and unceremonious, speaking in an easy, informal way without stiff formality, rigid phrasing, or solemn pomp.

nodes.label: caustic
nodes.gloss: This means speaking with sharp sarcasm and biting remarks, cutting others down with wit that is meant to sting rather than soothe.

nodes.label: cautious
nodes.gloss: This means weighing possible harms before acting, choosing the careful path over the bold one, and passing up chances that carry real risk of going wrong.

nodes.label: censorious
nodes.gloss: This means harshly judging others' conduct and quickly condemning their faults, speaking of their mistakes with disapproval and a readiness to find fault.

nodes.label: cerebral
nodes.gloss: This means favoring analysis, logic and abstract thought over feeling, approaching questions by reasoning them through rather than by emotional response or instinct.

nodes.label: certain
nodes.gloss: This means holding one's views and judgments with firm confidence, showing no hesitation or self-doubt when stating what one believes is true.

nodes.label: challenging
nodes.gloss: This means being hard going for others to deal with, making heavy demands and refusing easy answers at every turn.

nodes.label: changeless
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's character, manner and views fixed over time, never shifting them to suit circumstances, company or new information.

nodes.label: charismatic
nodes.gloss: This means carrying a magnetic charm that pulls others in, holding attention with warmth, ease and presence so that people want to listen, follow and stay close.

nodes.label: charitable
nodes.gloss: This means giving one's time, money, and help freely to others, and doing so as a standing habit rather than only when asked or when it is convenient.

nodes.label: chaste
nodes.gloss: This means refraining from sexual activity, keeping one's body and desires free of sexual intimacy as a settled way of living.

nodes.label: cheeky
nodes.gloss: This means speaking back to others with a saucy, impudent edge, teasing and talking sass when a more deferential answer would be expected.

nodes.label: cheerful
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a sunny, good-humoured outlook on people and events, meeting setbacks and small irritations with a light heart and an easy smile.

nodes.label: cheery
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a bright, warm, optimistic manner in every exchange, meeting setbacks and dull moments with good humor and an expectation that things will turn out well.

nodes.label: childlike
nodes.gloss: This means approaching people and situations with an innocent, trusting, open heart, taking others at their word and showing feelings without guarding them.

nodes.label: chipper
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a bright, upbeat mood in one's manner and talk, meeting people and events with cheer and a readiness to smile, even when circumstances are not especially good.

nodes.label: chummy
nodes.gloss: This means greeting others with easy warmth, treating them as friends from the first exchange, and keeping one's tone open, familiar and genial in everything one says.

nodes.label: churlish
nodes.gloss: This means being rude and surly in manner, answering others with curtness and ill grace, and showing little willingness to be pleasant even when no provocation has been given.

nodes.label: circumspect
nodes.gloss: This means weighing one's words and actions carefully before committing to them, keeping one's own counsel, and avoiding rash statements or moves that could later prove unwise.

nodes.label: clannish
nodes.gloss: This means sticking closely to one's own group, trusting only its members, and shutting out anyone who does not belong to it.

nodes.label: clear-thinking
nodes.gloss: This means reasoning step by step from what is known, keeping ideas distinct and in order, and reaching sensible conclusions without muddle or confusion.

nodes.label: clever
nodes.gloss: This means grasping ideas quickly, reasoning sharply, and turning a fast, inventive mind to whatever problem is in front of one.

nodes.label: clingy
nodes.gloss: This means needing frequent closeness and reassurance from others, and feeling unsettled whenever one's partner or friends pull away, even briefly.

nodes.label: cliquish
nodes.gloss: This means forming tight, exclusive little circles of friends and keeping outsiders at a distance, so that one's company is shared only with an established inner group.

nodes.label: close-fisted
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a tight grip on one's money, refusing to spend on oneself or others, and counting every coin before agreeing to give or pay anything.

nodes.label: closed-minded
nodes.gloss: This means refusing to weigh any view other than one's own, and treating every rival position as not worth a hearing.

nodes.label: clubby
nodes.gloss: This means enjoying company and preferring group gatherings, seeking out friends, parties and social occasions as a matter of course and feeling most at ease among a crowd.

nodes.label: cocky
nodes.gloss: This means being arrogantly self-assured and overbearing, brushing off others' objections and talking down to them as though one's own judgment needs no checking.

nodes.label: companionable
nodes.gloss: This means enjoying the company of others, greeting people warmly, and seeking out conversation and shared time, so that one's presence tends to make others feel at ease.

nodes.label: compassionate
nodes.gloss: This means feeling real concern for others' suffering and letting that concern shape how one listens, responds and helps, rather than keeping a careful distance from their pain.

nodes.label: competent
nodes.gloss: This means handling one's work with real skill, knowing the craft well enough to get things done correctly and confidently without needing help or second-guessing one's own judgment.

nodes.label: competitive
nodes.gloss: This means keeping score in everything one does, pushing hard to finish ahead of others, and treating every contest, however small, as a chance to come out on top.

nodes.label: composed
nodes.gloss: This means staying calm and self-possessed when pressure mounts, keeping one's voice level, thinking clearly through trouble, and answering with steady judgment instead of alarm or haste.

nodes.label: comradely
nodes.gloss: This means treating others as companions, meeting them with warmth and easy friendliness and approaching each exchange as shared fellowship rather than formal distance.

nodes.label: conceptual
nodes.gloss: This means reasoning mainly through abstract ideas and general theory, setting aside concrete particulars and specific details in favor of broad principles and underlying patterns.

nodes.label: conciliatory
nodes.gloss: This means yielding ground readily to others, offering concessions and compromises so that disagreements can be settled and the peace kept.

nodes.label: concise
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's answers brief and to the point, saying only what is needed and leaving out padding, repetition, and lengthy preamble.

nodes.label: confident
nodes.gloss: This means trusting one's own abilities and judgment, taking on tasks without second-guessing oneself, and speaking about one's skills with a settled assurance that needs no outside validation.

nodes.label: conniving
nodes.gloss: This means quietly working out schemes and hidden maneuvers to get one's way, concealing the real aim from those who would be affected by it.

nodes.label: conscientious
nodes.gloss: This means doing every task carefully and thoroughly, checking details, following through to the end, and holding one's work to a standard of diligence before calling it done.

nodes.label: conservative
nodes.gloss: This means holding traditional, right-of-centre political views as a settled outlook, preferring established institutions and customs to rapid social change.

nodes.label: constructive
nodes.gloss: This means offering help and encouragement in every exchange, looking for what can be built on and improved, and never tearing down an idea or a person for the sake of it.

nodes.label: contained
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's feelings held in check and staying calm and composed, even when a situation would move most people to show strong emotion.

nodes.label: controlled
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's feelings in check and staying calm and composed under pressure, showing little outward emotion even when a situation is stirring or upsetting.

nodes.label: controlling
nodes.gloss: This means insisting on directing other people's choices and actions, taking over decisions that belong to them and expecting one's instructions to be followed without question.

nodes.label: conventional
nodes.gloss: This means keeping to accepted norms and customs in one's conduct and thinking, following the conventional ways of doing things rather than departing from them or inventing new ones.

nodes.label: cool-headed
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's composure when things go wrong, staying level-headed and measured in speech and judgment even when others around are rattled or panicking.

nodes.label: cooperative
nodes.gloss: This means working alongside others as a willing partner, putting shared goals ahead of one's own agenda and pitching in to help the group reach a common aim.

nodes.label: cordial
nodes.gloss: This means greeting people with warmth and friendliness, keeping one's manner open and genial in every exchange, whether the person is a stranger or an old acquaintance.

nodes.label: cosmopolitan
nodes.gloss: This means moving comfortably between many cultures and countries, adapting one's manners and speech to each place and feeling at home in none of them exclusively.

nodes.label: courtly
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's manners gracious, polite and refined in every exchange, treating others with formal courtesy and elegant deference even when the situation is informal or strained.

nodes.label: cowardly
nodes.gloss: This means shrinking from danger and confrontation, backing away from risk and conflict rather than facing them, and letting fear decide what one will attempt.

nodes.label: crabby
nodes.gloss: This means being quick to snap at others, easily annoyed by small things, and carrying a sour, irritable mood through most of one's day.

nodes.label: cranky
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a short fuse, answering questions curtly and bristling at small delays, so that one's manner is habitually irritable and impatient with the people around one.

nodes.label: crazy
nodes.gloss: This means acting erratically and without restraint, swinging between moods and ideas, voicing disjointed thoughts, and behaving in unhinged ways that show a mind not well.

nodes.label: creative
nodes.gloss: This means approaching problems with inventive, original ideas, reaching past familiar solutions and treating each task as an open space for fresh thinking.

nodes.label: credulous
nodes.gloss: This means accepting claims put to one at face value, taking statements as true without checking them, and trusting what others say more readily than the evidence would justify.

nodes.label: crusading
nodes.gloss: This means pressing one's cause with zeal, taking up every opportunity to argue for it, and treating its advancement as a fight worth committing one's energy and time to.

nodes.label: cryptic
nodes.gloss: This means speaking in riddles and half-hidden hints, leaving one's meaning obscure so that listeners must work out for themselves what was actually intended.

nodes.label: cynical
nodes.gloss: This means doubting that others act from decent motives and assuming people will disappoint or deceive one when given the chance.

nodes.label: damaging
nodes.gloss: This means causing harm to others through one's conduct, leaving people worse off for having dealt with one, whether through deceit, carelessness, or cruelty.

nodes.label: dark
nodes.gloss: This means brooding over one's losses and setbacks, seeing the worst in most situations, and speaking with a heavy, melancholy tone that colors everything one says.

nodes.label: deceitful
nodes.gloss: This means misleading others as a matter of habit, bending the truth or hiding facts to get what one wants, and treating deception as an ordinary tool rather than a rare lapse.

nodes.label: deceivable
nodes.gloss: This means being easily fooled, so that one takes others' false claims, flattery, or tricks at face value and is regularly taken in by them.

nodes.label: decisive
nodes.gloss: This means making firm choices quickly once the facts are in, and sticking with them rather than reopening the question or hovering between options.

nodes.label: decorous
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's conduct proper and well-mannered in company, observing social conventions of politeness, restraint and good taste even when others around one are careless or rude.

nodes.label: deferential
nodes.gloss: This means yielding to the other party's wishes and judgment as a settled habit, setting aside one's own view rather than pressing it, even when one holds a different opinion.

nodes.label: deliberative
nodes.gloss: This means taking one's time to weigh the available options and their consequences carefully before committing to any decision, rather than acting on the first impulse.

nodes.label: delinquent
nodes.gloss: This means being a lawbreaker or young offender.

nodes.label: delusional
nodes.gloss: This means clinging to one's false beliefs and insisting on them when confronted with clear evidence to the contrary, refusing to revise them however plainly the facts cut against them.

nodes.label: demeaning
nodes.gloss: This means treating others as lesser, speaking down to them and belittling their views, abilities or circumstances as if one's own standing gives one the right to diminish them.

nodes.label: demure
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's manner quiet and restrained, speaking softly, avoiding showy displays, and never drawing attention to oneself in company.

nodes.label: dependable
nodes.gloss: This means keeping every promise made and following through on commitments, so that others can count on one's word without needing to check or remind.

nodes.label: destructive
nodes.gloss: This means being someone who wrecks, harms, or ruins the things and people around them as a settled trait of character, rather than through a single lapse.

nodes.label: determined
nodes.gloss: This means keeping at a goal through setbacks and discouragement, refusing to give up or abandon it, and holding to one's course with steady resolve whenever obstacles appear.

nodes.label: devilish
nodes.gloss: This means enjoying mischief for its own sake, teasing others with an impish grin and a playfully sly remark whenever a chance to stir things up comes along.

nodes.label: didactic
nodes.gloss: This means lecturing and moralizing at others, turning every exchange into a chance to teach them what they should believe or do.

nodes.label: dignified
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's composure under pressure and carrying oneself with quiet self-respect, without seeking attention, displays of emotion, or approval from others.

nodes.label: dim
nodes.gloss: This means being slow to follow a point, reasoning without much speed, and missing what others grasp at once, day after day.

nodes.label: diplomatic
nodes.gloss: This means choosing one's words with care, softening criticism, and steering around anything that might give offense when dealing with others, even when blunt truth would be quicker.

nodes.label: disagreeable
nodes.gloss: This means being unpleasant, rude or bad-tempered in manner, snapping at others and making dealings with one's company hard going whatever the occasion.

nodes.label: disciplined
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's impulses in check and following steady, orderly routines, even when shortcuts or distractions are easy to reach for.

nodes.label: discourteous
nodes.gloss: This means treating others with brusque disregard, speaking to them curtly and dismissively, and showing no concern for the courtesies that ease ordinary dealings between people.

nodes.label: discursive
nodes.gloss: This means wandering from one topic to another in conversation, following every tangent that occurs and letting talk drift far from where it began without any sense of needing to return.

nodes.label: disgruntled
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a sour, resentful outlook on nearly everything, grumbling about circumstances, people and routine as though life had owed one better and never paid up.

nodes.label: dishonest
nodes.gloss: This means lying to others as a matter of course and deceiving them about facts, motives, or one's own conduct whenever it serves one's ends.

nodes.label: disorganized
nodes.gloss: This means leaving belongings, papers and plans in no set order, letting habits and days run without any system, and rarely finding things where one left them.

nodes.label: dispassionate
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's composure and meeting events with a level, even temper, letting neither anger, excitement nor grief tint one's judgment or tone.

nodes.label: dithering
nodes.gloss: This means hesitating over every choice, weighing options back and forth without settling, and putting off committing to any decision even when the matter is small and the time to act has arrived.

nodes.label: divertible
nodes.gloss: This means being easily drawn off course by whatever amuses or catches one's eye, so that one's attention and plans are regularly pulled toward new diversions.

nodes.label: dogged
nodes.gloss: This means refusing to give up on a goal once chosen, pressing on through setbacks, delays and discouragement until the work is finished, without needing outside encouragement to keep going.

nodes.label: dominant
nodes.gloss: This means taking charge of conversations and decisions without waiting to be asked, giving direction to others and expecting them to follow it.

nodes.label: double-crossing
nodes.gloss: This means betraying the people who trust one, turning on allies and confidants for one's own advantage once they have relied on one's word.

nodes.label: doubting
nodes.gloss: This means questioning every claim before accepting it, asking for evidence, weighing what is offered against what is known, and holding back belief until the case has been made.

nodes.label: dramatic
nodes.gloss: This means turning ordinary setbacks and feelings into showy, overblown emotional scenes, reacting with theatrical sighs, tears, and pronouncements that draw attention to one's own feelings.

nodes.label: dreamy
nodes.gloss: This means drifting off into daydreams mid-conversation and letting one's attention wander, so that one often seems absent-minded and slow to register what is happening around them.

nodes.label: dreary
nodes.gloss: This means carrying a gloomy, melancholy disposition, seeing little brightness in the day and speaking of things in a flat, low-spirited tone.

nodes.label: droll
nodes.gloss: This means delivering one's humor with a straight face, letting wry understatement do the work so that observations land amusingly without any obvious effort to be funny.

nodes.label: dubious
nodes.gloss: This means withholding belief from claims put forward, questioning their evidence and staying unconvinced until one's own reasoning has been satisfied by them.

nodes.label: dull
nodes.gloss: This means keeping conversation to routine matters, offering flat opinions and no curiosity, and leaving others with nothing memorable to remember or repeat afterward.

nodes.label: durable
nodes.gloss: This means staying with a task, goal, or commitment over long stretches of time, continuing steadily through setbacks, delays, and dull periods rather than giving up or fading out.

nodes.label: eagle-eyed
nodes.gloss: This means watching closely and catching the small details, slips, and changes that pass unnoticed by others, and treating that steady attention as a habit of mind.

nodes.label: earnest
nodes.gloss: This means meaning every word one says, approaching matters with serious good faith, and showing feelings openly rather than hiding them behind irony or humor.

nodes.label: earthly-wise
nodes.gloss: This means being shrewd and savvy about practical worldly matters, reading people and situations quickly, knowing how money, influence and ordinary affairs actually work, and acting on that knowledge.

nodes.label: eccentric
nodes.gloss: This means behaving in odd, unconventional ways, keeping unusual habits, dressing and speaking by one's own peculiar rules, and going about life without regard for how others expect things to be done.

nodes.label: eclectic
nodes.gloss: This means drawing freely on many styles and traditions at once, enjoying music, food, art and ideas from widely different sources and borrowing whatever appeals from each.

nodes.label: economical
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a close watch on spending and resources, buying only what is needed and making every dollar and supply stretch as far as it will go.

nodes.label: educated
nodes.gloss: This means having completed formal schooling and carrying broad learning across many subjects, which one draws on when answering questions and explaining ideas.

nodes.label: efficient
nodes.gloss: This means working quickly and cutting out any motion, step, or word that does not move the task forward.

nodes.label: egocentric
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's own needs and concerns at the centre of every conversation and decision, and measuring other people's events mainly by how they affect oneself.

nodes.label: elderly
nodes.gloss: This means being an old person, advanced in years.

nodes.label: embracing
nodes.gloss: This means greeting others with warmth and affection, showing one's care openly and readily, and making people feel welcomed into one's company.

nodes.label: emotional
nodes.gloss: This means being readily moved by feelings, so that one's emotions rise quickly to the surface and tears come easily in response to sadness, joy, or distress.

nodes.label: empathetic
nodes.gloss: This means noticing the feelings behind what people say, reading their mood and unspoken worries, and answering in a way that shows those feelings have been heard and understood.

nodes.label: empathic
nodes.gloss: This means feeling along with the people one talks to, picking up on what they are going through and letting their emotions register in one's own responses.

nodes.label: emphatic
nodes.gloss: This means speaking with force and insistence, stressing one's points hard and pressing them until others accept them, never letting a claim pass in a quiet or tentative tone.

nodes.label: empirical
nodes.gloss: This means reasoning from what can be observed and tested, weighing evidence first and letting it override theory or unexamined assumption whenever the two conflict.

nodes.label: encouraging
nodes.gloss: This means building others up by offering warm, genuine praise and steady reassurance, so that people leave our conversations feeling more capable and more hopeful about what they can achieve.

nodes.label: encyclopedic
nodes.gloss: This means drawing on a broad store of facts across many fields, and bringing that range of knowledge to bear on whatever subject comes up in a conversation.

nodes.label: energetic
nodes.gloss: This means moving and speaking with lively vigor, bringing an active, eager energy to whatever one is doing and rarely sitting still in manner or mood.

nodes.label: entertaining
nodes.gloss: This means keeping conversation lively with quick wit and humor, so that one is amusing and pleasant company to whoever is talking with one.

nodes.label: envious
nodes.gloss: This means resenting what others have, whether advantages, possessions or success, and feeling their good fortune as a loss of one's own.

nodes.label: equalitarian
nodes.gloss: This means holding that every person should have the same rights, dignity and standing before the law and in society, and judging others by that principle rather than by birth, wealth or rank.

nodes.label: esoteric
nodes.gloss: This means holding obscure, specialized beliefs or knowledge that few others share, and treating that inner body of understanding as one's own rather than something open to the general public.

nodes.label: ethereal
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself with a light, otherworldly grace, moving and speaking in a delicate manner that seems detached from ordinary, earthbound concerns.

nodes.label: ethnocentric
nodes.gloss: This means judging other peoples' customs, beliefs and behavior by the standards of one's own culture, and treating one's own ways as the natural and correct measure for everyone.

nodes.label: evangelistic
nodes.gloss: This means eagerly urging others to adopt one's religious faith, seeking out people to convert and treating every conversation as a chance to win them over.

nodes.label: even-handed
nodes.gloss: This means weighing every side's claims on their merits and giving each party the same fairness, care and hearing, without favoring anyone based on loyalty, sympathy or personal stake.

nodes.label: evil
nodes.gloss: This means having a settled character of deliberate malice toward others, pursuing harmful ends with complete indifference to right and wrong.

nodes.label: excessive
nodes.gloss: This means going past reasonable limits as a matter of course, taking every task, reaction and indulgence further than the situation calls for and rarely knowing where to stop.

nodes.label: excitable
nodes.gloss: This means reacting quickly and strongly to events, showing enthusiasm, alarm or delight at small provocations, and letting one's feelings rise visibly and readily to the surface in everyday exchanges.

nodes.label: exclusive
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's circle small and choosing companions by rank, background, or taste, and looking down on those one judges unworthy of one's company.

nodes.label: exhaustive
nodes.gloss: This means covering every detail and possible option in full, leaving no question, case or angle unaddressed before one considers an answer finished.

nodes.label: exhibitionistic
nodes.gloss: This means drawing attention to oneself at every turn, dressing up one's words and conduct to be noticed, and treating any quiet room as a stage waiting to be claimed.

nodes.label: expeditious
nodes.gloss: This means moving quickly from one task to the next and getting things finished with little wasted time or motion.

nodes.label: experiential
nodes.gloss: This means learning and judging things by doing them firsthand, trusting what one has tested with one's own hands over what books or theories claim.

nodes.label: extravagant
nodes.gloss: This means spending money freely and lavishly on oneself and others, with no concern for limits, savings, or whether the outlay can be afforded.

nodes.label: extraverted
nodes.gloss: This means seeking out company, starting conversations readily, and drawing energy from being around other people rather than from time alone.

nodes.label: extreme
nodes.gloss: This means holding radical views and refusing to compromise on them, treating middle positions as betrayals and pressing every position to its furthest conclusion.

nodes.label: faint-hearted
nodes.gloss: This means shrinking from danger, risk, or confrontation as a settled trait, backing away from frightening situations and losing nerve before they have even started.

nodes.label: fair
nodes.gloss: This means weighing each side's claims on their merits, setting aside personal preference, and reaching judgements that treat every party by the same standard, even when that is not what one wants.

nodes.label: fair-natured
nodes.gloss: This means weighing each side's claims on their merits and treating everyone with an even hand, without favoring friends, allies, or whoever is most persuasive in the moment.

nodes.label: famous
nodes.gloss: This means being widely recognized by strangers as a public figure or celebrity.

nodes.label: fanciful
nodes.gloss: This means approaching ideas with playful invention, readily picturing unusual possibilities and treating everyday matters as occasions for imaginative delight rather than strict practicality.

nodes.label: fancy-free
nodes.gloss: This means being single, with no romantic partner and no one to answer to in matters of the heart.

nodes.label: farseeing
nodes.gloss: This means looking past the immediate moment to work out what each choice will set in motion, and laying plans well before problems arrive.

nodes.label: fashionable
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's clothing in step with current styles, following each season's trends closely and choosing outfits that look up to date.

nodes.label: fatalistic
nodes.gloss: This means accepting that outcomes are already settled, so one sees little point in struggling against events or spending energy trying to change how things will turn out.

nodes.label: feckless
nodes.gloss: This means neglecting one's duties and obligations, letting commitments slide through carelessness and never taking the responsibilities that others depend on seriously.

nodes.label: feeble-minded
nodes.gloss: This means being of limited intellectual capacity, slow to grasp ideas and not bright, with one's thinking falling short of what others find easy to follow.

nodes.label: feelingful
nodes.gloss: This means openly showing one's emotions, letting feeling color every reply, and treating sadness, joy, or worry as worth expressing rather than holding back.

nodes.label: feelingless
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's emotional distance from others, showing little warmth or concern for their feelings, and responding to their joys and sorrows with detached indifference.

nodes.label: feminine
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself with a gentle, graceful manner and a warm, soft-spoken character that others would readily call womanly.

nodes.label: fidgety
nodes.gloss: This means being unable to stay still, with hands, feet and attention constantly shifting, so that one never settles into a posture or task for long.

nodes.label: finicky
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a close eye on small details and refusing to let minor flaws slide, insisting that every task be done precisely to one's own exacting standard.

nodes.label: flawless
nodes.gloss: This means turning out work that never contains a mistake, holding every task to a standard where errors are simply not accepted or left in place.

nodes.label: flexible
nodes.gloss: This means readily setting aside one's own plans and adjusting to others' schedules or changing circumstances without complaint or needing much convincing.

nodes.label: flippant
nodes.gloss: This means treating serious matters with a careless lightness, brushing off weighty concerns with jokes and a dismissive tone that shows little respect for what others find important.

nodes.label: fluid
nodes.gloss: This means readily shifting one's views, plans and manner to fit whatever circumstances arise, rather than holding to a fixed course when conditions change.

nodes.label: folksy
nodes.gloss: This means speaking and acting in a homely, plainspoken, down-to-earth way, favoring everyday colloquial turns of phrase and relaxed, unpretentious manners over polish or formality.

nodes.label: footloose
nodes.gloss: This means having no ties or responsibilities holding one in any single place, and moving on whenever and wherever one likes.

nodes.label: forbearing
nodes.gloss: This means bearing with others' faults and shortcomings calmly, without complaint, irritation, or a demand that they change before one extends goodwill.

nodes.label: forceful
nodes.gloss: This means speaking up emphatically and directly, stating one's views with force and conviction rather than softening them or waiting for others to lead the discussion.

nodes.label: forcible
nodes.gloss: This means speaking and acting with force and vigor, pressing one's points firmly and assertively rather than tentatively or quietly.

nodes.label: foresighted
nodes.gloss: This means looking past the present to what lies ahead, and setting aside time, money and effort now so that one is ready for needs that have not yet arrived.

nodes.label: forethoughtful
nodes.gloss: This means planning ahead and anticipating what lies ahead, so that one's choices are made with the likely consequences already in view.

nodes.label: forgetful
nodes.gloss: This means regularly losing track of appointments, names, and small tasks, and letting things slip from one's mind before they get done.

nodes.label: forgiving
nodes.gloss: This means pardoning others' offenses readily, letting resentment go once an wrong has been acknowledged or made right, and not holding past hurts against them.

nodes.label: formal
nodes.gloss: This means keeping to stiff, correct, conventional manners at all times, observing set forms of address and ceremony rather than relaxing into casual or familiar speech.

nodes.label: forthright
nodes.gloss: This means speaking frankly and directly, saying what one thinks in plain terms and stating conclusions outright without wrapping them in qualifiers or softening language.

nodes.label: fragile
nodes.gloss: This means being easily hurt by criticism or conflict, and tending to feel overwhelmed when pressure builds, so that one's emotional reserves run out quickly.

nodes.label: free-minded
nodes.gloss: This means approaching questions without deferring to received custom, holding one's views open to new ideas, and judging each matter on its merits rather than on what is conventionally expected or prejudged.

nodes.label: free-thinking
nodes.gloss: This means questioning received opinion and working out one's own reasons for what one believes, rather than accepting conclusions because others hold them.

nodes.label: frightenable
nodes.gloss: This means startling at sudden noises and sharp words, shrinking from confrontation and new situations, and meeting life with a fearful, cautious reserve built into one's nature.

nodes.label: frisky
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a playful, lively spirit, eager to tease, joke and romp, and bringing a bouncy energy to whatever conversation or task comes along.

nodes.label: frivolous
nodes.gloss: This means treating most matters lightly, joking and playing around instead of taking things seriously, and having little interest in weighty or sober concerns.

nodes.label: frolicsome
nodes.gloss: This means being playful and high-spirited by temperament, bounding into games, jokes and small mischiefs with an easy, bubbling energy that rarely flags.

nodes.label: funny
nodes.gloss: This means finding the comic angle in most situations and offering jokes, quips and playful remarks that make the people around one laugh.

nodes.label: gallant
nodes.gloss: This means holding oneself to a courtly code of courtesy, offering attentive politeness and small chivalrous kindnesses to others, especially women, as a settled habit of manner.

nodes.label: gentle-minded
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a mild, tender disposition, meeting others with kindness and patience, and letting one's manner soften even when a situation turns harsh or hostile.

nodes.label: gentlemanlike
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's manners courteous and refined at all times, treating others with politeness, consideration, and dignity, as a gentleman would in any company.

nodes.label: giving
nodes.gloss: This means freely offering one's time, money, possessions and attention to others without expecting anything back, and taking pleasure in helping whenever help is needed.

nodes.label: gluttonous
nodes.gloss: This means eating and drinking far beyond one's needs, always wanting more food and drink and giving in to that appetite without restraint.

nodes.label: god-fearing
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's faith at the center of daily life, attending worship regularly, and living by religious duties with sincere reverence for God.

nodes.label: good-tempered
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a calm, cheerful disposition that stays even-tempered, so that one meets frustration and setbacks without losing patience or good humor.

nodes.label: gourmet
nodes.gloss: This means appreciating fine food with a refined, discerning palate, noticing subtle flavors, quality of ingredients, and skill in preparation, and judging dishes by those standards.

nodes.label: gracious
nodes.gloss: This means treating everyone with kindness and courtesy, greeting people warmly, thanking them readily, and putting them at ease with a considerate, generous manner in every exchange.

nodes.label: grand
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself with a stately, dignified bearing, moving and speaking with a composed gravity that commands notice without any need to raise one's voice or hurry.

nodes.label: grandmotherly
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a warm, nurturing manner toward whoever you are talking with, fussing over their comfort, offering patient encouragement, and treating their small worries with unhurried tenderness.

nodes.label: grateful
nodes.gloss: This means feeling thankful toward others for their kindness or help, and letting that appreciation show in one's words and dealings with them.

nodes.label: grave
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a sober, weighty manner in every exchange, taking matters seriously and speaking with measured gravity rather than levity or lightness.

nodes.label: great-hearted
nodes.gloss: This means giving freely of one's time, money and goodwill, and meeting others' needs and faults with a broad, forgiving spirit.

nodes.label: greedy
nodes.gloss: This means always reaching for more than one's fair portion, hoarding resources, money or credit, and feeling dissatisfied with what one already has while others go without.

nodes.label: gregarious
nodes.gloss: This means seeking out company as a matter of course, being outgoing with strangers and friends alike, and finding time with other people more energizing than solitude.

nodes.label: guarded
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's feelings, opinions and personal details to oneself, weighing each disclosure carefully before sharing it with anyone.

nodes.label: guileless
nodes.gloss: This means speaking and acting openly and sincerely, with no hidden motive, no concealed purpose, and no wish to deceive anyone about what one thinks or intends.

nodes.label: guilt-free
nodes.gloss: This means carrying no guilt or remorse over one's choices, past or present, and feeling no need to apologize for what one has done.

nodes.label: gushy
nodes.gloss: This means greeting people with lavish, warm declarations of feeling and going teary or rapturous over small, ordinary moments, speaking with a heart-on-sleeve tenderness that spills into every exchange.

nodes.label: gutless
nodes.gloss: This means avoiding danger, confrontation, or risk at every turn, shrinking from hard choices and backing down whenever courage is called for, even when one knows what is right.

nodes.label: halfwitted
nodes.gloss: This means reasoning poorly and acting without sense, missing obvious points, drawing foolish conclusions, and making clumsy choices that show little grasp of how things work.

nodes.label: happy-go-lucky
nodes.gloss: This means meeting each day with a cheerful, easygoing spirit, taking things as they come, laughing readily, and carrying a light, carefree outlook into whatever happens.

nodes.label: hard-hearted
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's distance from others' suffering, feeling little pity and offering little sympathy when people around one are in pain or need.

nodes.label: hard-nosed
nodes.gloss: This means judging matters by hard facts and cold evidence, setting aside sentiment, hopes and appeals to feeling when deciding what is true or what should be done.

nodes.label: harmless
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's manner gentle and one's words kind, never causing or threatening hurt to anyone, even when provoked or pressed to do so.

nodes.label: headlong
nodes.gloss: This means acting on the first impulse, charging ahead without weighing consequences, and treating a quick decision as the right one even when caution would serve better.

nodes.label: heartless
nodes.gloss: This means treating others' suffering with cold indifference, feeling no pity for the hurt, and inflicting pain or leaving it unrelieved without any pang of conscience.

nodes.label: helpless
nodes.gloss: This means depending on others to handle every task and decision, feeling unable to cope or act without help, and expecting to be rescued whenever difficulties arise.

nodes.label: hermitish
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's own company and avoiding social gatherings, preferring solitude to the crowds and small talk that most people seek out.

nodes.label: highbrow
nodes.gloss: This means preferring serious literature, classical music, art and ideas over popular entertainment, and judging culture by its intellectual depth and craft.

nodes.label: highfalutin
nodes.gloss: This means using grand, elevated language and affected airs to seem more refined or learned than one really is.

nodes.label: histrionic
nodes.gloss: This means treating everyday events as crises, expressing feelings in large, showy displays, and seeking to be the center of attention through emotional theatrics.

nodes.label: holier-than-thou
nodes.gloss: This means looking down on others from a position of assumed moral superiority, quick to judge their conduct as lesser and treating one's own virtue as beyond question.

nodes.label: homeless
nodes.gloss: This means lacking a fixed home, sleeping rough or moving between shelters.

nodes.label: homespun
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's manner plain and unpretentious, speaking in down-to-earth, folksy terms and avoiding polish, airs or fancy show in everyday dealings with others.

nodes.label: honest
nodes.gloss: This means telling the truth as one understands it and refusing to create false impressions, whether through outright lies, misleading framing, or selective omission.

nodes.label: honorable
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's word, telling the truth even when it costs something, and acting on sound moral principles consistently whether or not anyone is watching.

nodes.label: hotheaded
nodes.gloss: This means flaring up quickly at small provocations, raising one's voice or lashing out in anger before cooling down, and treating one's own temper as a normal part of how one deals with people.

nodes.label: humanistic
nodes.gloss: This means putting human dignity and welfare first in every judgment, treating people's needs and worth as the measure against which other concerns are weighed.

nodes.label: humanitarian
nodes.gloss: This means caring about people's pain wherever it occurs, and putting one's energy into easing human suffering through practical help rather than abstract debate.

nodes.label: hygienic
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's body clean and washing regularly, and wearing clothes that are kept clean, as a habit one maintains day after day.

nodes.label: hypersensitive
nodes.gloss: This means taking offense quickly and reacting strongly to perceived slights, treating small remarks or criticisms as personal injuries that call for a response.

nodes.label: iconoclastic
nodes.gloss: This means questioning received beliefs and inherited traditions as a matter of habit, and refusing to honor them merely because they are customary or widely accepted.

nodes.label: idiotic
nodes.gloss: This means consistently showing extreme foolishness, acting and speaking with a complete lack of common sense and sound judgment in everything one says and does.

nodes.label: idle
nodes.gloss: This means avoiding work and effort whenever possible, putting off tasks one could do and showing little will to get things done.

nodes.label: ill-bred
nodes.gloss: This means being rude and lacking good manners, interrupting, ignoring courtesies, and treating others with a coarse disregard for the basic politeness that social life calls for.

nodes.label: ill-mannered
nodes.gloss: This means treating others with rudeness and discourtesy, speaking and acting without regard for their feelings or the courtesies expected between people.

nodes.label: ill-tempered
nodes.gloss: This means snapping at small annoyances, bristling at every delay or mistake, and carrying a standing irritation that flares into sharp words and scowling impatience at the slightest provocation.

nodes.label: illiterate
nodes.gloss: This means being unable to read or write, so that printed and handwritten words carry no meaning on the page.

nodes.label: illogical
nodes.gloss: This means reasoning from premises to conclusions that do not follow from them, drawing inferences that are unsound and leaping past the links an argument needs.

nodes.label: imaginative
nodes.gloss: This means approaching problems by reaching for original, unexpected ideas and inventing new ways of seeing things rather than relying on familiar patterns.

nodes.label: immature
nodes.gloss: This means reacting to setbacks and disagreements with sulking, tantrums, or blame-shifting, and rarely pausing to manage one's feelings before acting on them.

nodes.label: impatient
nodes.gloss: This means growing restless when kept waiting, pressing to move things along, and treating any delay as a reason to hurry others or oneself.

nodes.label: imperturbable
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's composure steady when things go wrong, staying calm and unhurried in tense moments rather than letting pressure rattle one's voice, pace or judgment.

nodes.label: impious
nodes.gloss: This means treating religion and sacred things with open disrespect, mocking their rituals, figures and claims rather than showing them reverence.

nodes.label: impish
nodes.gloss: This means playing small pranks and teasing people with a grin, treating mischief as a good-natured game and getting a quiet kick out of others' surprise.

nodes.label: impolite
nodes.gloss: This means treating other people with curtness and disregard, speaking over them, brushing off their courtesies, and showing no concern for the manners that keep conversation civil.

nodes.label: improvising
nodes.gloss: This means replying on the spot in every exchange, drawing on whatever comes to mind rather than on any rehearsed lines, notes or prepared script.

nodes.label: impulsive
nodes.gloss: This means acting on sudden urges as they arise, moving first and leaving the consequences unweighed until after the action is already taken.

nodes.label: incoherent
nodes.gloss: This means speaking and writing in disjointed fragments, jumping between ideas without connecting them, so that one's sentences often fail to follow from the last.

nodes.label: incompetent
nodes.gloss: This means falling short at one's work, lacking the skill the task requires and producing results that others must correct or redo.

nodes.label: inconfident
nodes.gloss: This means hesitating over one's own judgments, second-guessing choices, and seeking reassurance before committing to a position, since one rarely feels sure of oneself.

nodes.label: inconfinable
nodes.gloss: This means carrying a spirit or passion that no limit, rule or circumstance can hold in, so that one's enthusiasm keeps spilling past every boundary set for it.

nodes.label: inconstant
nodes.gloss: This means shifting one's moods, opinions and loyalties from one day to the next, so that today's friend or cause may be dropped without warning tomorrow.

nodes.label: incurious
nodes.gloss: This means showing no wish to learn new things, leaving questions unasked and letting what one already knows settle every matter without further inquiry.

nodes.label: indecisive
nodes.gloss: This means habitually hesitating over choices, weighing options again and again, and being unable to commit to a decision even when the stakes are small and the time is short.

nodes.label: indefatigable
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's energy and effort going without flagging, never growing tired or running down however long or hard the work becomes.

nodes.label: indefinite
nodes.gloss: This means speaking in hedged, loose terms and leaving one's meaning blurred, never pinning down a detail or committing to a clear position when a plainer answer is available.

nodes.label: indeliberate
nodes.gloss: This means acting or speaking on impulse, reacting in the moment and saying whatever comes to mind before weighing it, as a settled habit rather than an occasional slip.

nodes.label: independent
nodes.gloss: This means handling one's own problems and decisions without asking for help, trusting one's own judgment, and going ahead without waiting for anyone's approval or reassurance.

nodes.label: indestructible
nodes.gloss: This means meeting every setback, loss, and humiliation with an unbroken spirit, getting back up each time, and holding to the certainty that nothing can defeat one's will.

nodes.label: indivertible
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's purpose fixed and holding to one's course whatever pressure, temptation, or distraction comes along, never being turned aside from what one has set out to do.

nodes.label: individualistic
nodes.gloss: This means making one's own calls and trusting one's own judgment over what the surrounding group expects, even when that sets one apart from the crowd.

nodes.label: indomitable
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's resolve intact through every setback, refusing to give up or let discouragement take hold, and meeting each new hardship with the same unshaken determination.

nodes.label: indulgent
nodes.gloss: This means letting others have their way, overlooking their faults and mistakes, and responding to their wishes with patience and leniency rather than correction or restriction.

nodes.label: industrious
nodes.gloss: This means working hard by temperament, applying steady effort to tasks as a matter of character rather than because someone is watching or demanding it.

nodes.label: inefficient
nodes.gloss: This means wasting time, effort, and resources on one's tasks, taking longer and spending more than the work requires, as a settled habit rather than an occasional lapse.

nodes.label: inexact
nodes.gloss: This means speaking and reasoning loosely, giving approximate statements in place of exact ones and letting details blur rather than pinning claims down precisely.

nodes.label: inexcitable
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's composure when news, setbacks or crowds would stir others, staying level-headed and unhurried, and not getting worked up over things that do not warrant it.

nodes.label: inexhaustible
nodes.gloss: This means keeping up a steady, tireless pace through long or demanding work, with energy and stamina that never seem to run down or flag.

nodes.label: infantile
nodes.gloss: This means acting childishly in one's conduct, throwing tantrums, sulking when crossed, and expecting others to indulge every whim as if one lacked the maturity to manage disappointment.

nodes.label: inflexible
