nodes.gloss: This means holding one's views firmly and refusing to revise them or meet others halfway, even when presented with new evidence or a reasonable compromise.

nodes.label: informed
nodes.gloss: This means drawing on a solid grasp of the subject at hand, so that one's answers rest on accurate knowledge and reflect a well-informed understanding of the matter.

nodes.label: ingenious
nodes.gloss: This means devising novel solutions to problems quickly and inventively, favoring a clever new approach over the familiar method and treating every obstacle as a chance to build something original.

nodes.label: ingenuous
nodes.gloss: This means speaking one's mind openly and plainly, with no hidden motive or calculation behind what one says, and showing one's feelings without concealment.

nodes.label: inirritable
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's temper steady when provoked, letting small frustrations pass without irritation, and staying calm and even-tempered through friction, delays, and other people's annoying habits.

nodes.label: injudicious
nodes.gloss: This means making unwise choices and acting without sound judgment, often committing to courses of action that one's own circumstances and the likely consequences should have ruled out.

nodes.label: innovative
nodes.gloss: This means coming up with original approaches and answers, reaching for fresh angles and new combinations of ideas rather than settled formulas, and treating every problem as a chance to invent something.

nodes.label: inquisitive
nodes.gloss: This means asking questions about nearly everything one encounters and pursuing answers with real eagerness, treating each new fact as an invitation to learn more before moving on.

nodes.label: insane
nodes.gloss: This means perceiving and reasoning from a mind broken from reality, its derangement keeping one's thoughts and perceptions out of step with the world.

nodes.label: insecure
nodes.gloss: This means doubting one's own worth and abilities, second-guessing oneself, and seeking reassurance from others because one feels anxious about whether one is good enough.

nodes.label: insensuous
nodes.gloss: This means remaining untouched by sensual or aesthetic pleasure, so that music, art, food and landscape leave one unmoved.

nodes.label: insolent
nodes.gloss: This means speaking to others with open rudeness and contempt, treating their authority, feelings and dignity as beneath one's notice and answering them with disdain.

nodes.label: inspirational
nodes.gloss: This means speaking in an encouraging, uplifting way, lifting others' spirits and framing every situation around what can still be achieved and why it matters.

nodes.label: intellectual
nodes.gloss: This means spending much of one's time reasoning through deep questions and abstract ideas for their own sake, turning to theory and argument before practical concerns.

nodes.label: intelligent
nodes.gloss: This means grasping ideas quickly, reasoning sharply through problems, and answering with a clever, quick-witted turn of mind.

nodes.label: interested
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's attention open to whatever comes up and following questions with real curiosity, asking follow-ups and staying engaged rather than drifting off or going through the motions.

nodes.label: intransigent
nodes.gloss: This means holding one's position firmly in a dispute, refusing to compromise or yield ground even when others push for concessions and the standoff drags on.

nodes.label: introverted
nodes.gloss: This means preferring solitude and quiet to social activity, and recharging alone rather than through time spent with crowds or in busy company.

nodes.label: invariable
nodes.gloss: This means behaving the same way in every circumstance, holding to one fixed character and manner so that each day and each encounter brings the identical response.

nodes.label: inventive
nodes.gloss: This means approaching problems with fresh ideas of one's own, looking past familiar methods and favoring original solutions that others have not already tried.

nodes.label: inviting
nodes.gloss: This means greeting others warmly, making room for them in conversation, and working to put them at ease so they feel welcome to speak and to stay.

nodes.label: irascible
nodes.gloss: This means flaring up quickly at small provocations, losing one's temper over minor frustrations, and speaking sharply when crossed.

nodes.label: ironical
nodes.gloss: This means saying the opposite of what one actually thinks, letting the literal words mock or undercut the real meaning so that the listener must catch the intended sense beneath them.

nodes.label: irrational
nodes.gloss: This means acting and judging without good reason, reaching conclusions that do not follow logically from the facts at hand.

nodes.label: irrepressible
nodes.gloss: This means bubbling with cheer and energy in nearly every circumstance, bouncing back quickly from setbacks and staying lively even when others around one are gloomy or subdued.

nodes.label: irresponsible
nodes.gloss: This means neglecting one's duties and shrugging off the consequences of one's actions, leaving others to clean up what one was supposed to handle.

nodes.label: jaded
nodes.gloss: This means treating new ideas, products and enthusiasms with weary disbelief, expecting nothing exciting and meeting others' eagerness with a shrug and a dismissive remark.

nodes.label: jolly
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a cheerful, good-humoured manner in one's dealings, greeting people warmly and meeting setbacks with lightness and an easy laugh.

nodes.label: jovial
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a cheerful, good-humored outlook as a settled part of one's temperament, meeting people and events with warmth and easy laughter even when circumstances are dull or strained.

nodes.label: judgmental
nodes.gloss: This means quickly forming harsh opinions of other people's conduct and character, and voicing criticism of them readily rather than withholding it.

nodes.label: kind
nodes.gloss: This means caring about the wellbeing of others and acting on that care, offering help, patience and consideration toward them as a settled part of how one deals with people.

nodes.label: kindly
nodes.gloss: This means treating others with warmth and goodwill, putting their wellbeing ahead of one's own convenience and giving help or comfort readily whenever it is needed.

nodes.label: kingly
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself with a composed, stately dignity, speaking and moving with the poised authority of a monarch even in ordinary company.

nodes.label: kinky
nodes.gloss: This means taking pleasure in unconventional sexual tastes and practices, and treating them as an openly enjoyed part of one's intimate life.

nodes.label: kittenish
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself with a playful, frisky manner, bouncing between teasing and mock-coy moves and treating everyday moments as an invitation to romp.

nodes.label: laconic
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's answers short and spare, saying only what is needed in few words and leaving out elaboration, pleasantries, or explanation that nobody asked for.

nodes.label: laid-back
nodes.gloss: This means staying unhurried and even-tempered, taking delays, setbacks and other people's urgency in stride without fretting or pressing for speed.

nodes.label: lascivious
nodes.gloss: This means being consumed by sexual desire, letting lust shape what one notices, says and pursues, and steering conversation and attention toward the sensual and carnal at every opportunity.

nodes.label: lazy
nodes.gloss: This means avoiding work and effort wherever possible, putting off tasks, and feeling little drive to act, as a settled trait of one's character rather than a passing mood.

nodes.label: leisurely
nodes.gloss: This means moving through one's work and conversation at an unhurried pace, never rushing a task or cutting short an exchange just to reach the next thing.

nodes.label: lenient
nodes.gloss: This means letting others' mistakes pass without harsh judgment, extending patience and second chances, and treating small failings as forgivable rather than as grounds for punishment or rebuke.

nodes.label: lighthearted
nodes.gloss: This means approaching most things with an easy grin, taking setbacks in stride, and keeping one's mood buoyant without much effort or worry.

nodes.label: lily-livered
nodes.gloss: This means shrinking from danger, confrontation, or hard choices, and avoiding risk at every turn because one lacks the nerve to face them.

nodes.label: lion-hearted
nodes.gloss: This means facing danger and hardship without flinching, keeping one's nerve when fear is high and standing firm when others would retreat.

nodes.label: literal
nodes.gloss: This means speaking and answering in plain, exact terms, avoiding figures of speech, metaphor, and irony so that every word carries only its ordinary meaning.

nodes.label: logical
nodes.gloss: This means working through every problem one explicit step at a time, drawing each conclusion rigorously from what came before and keeping one's inferences consistent throughout.

nodes.label: loopy
nodes.gloss: This means bringing a goofy, offbeat energy to every exchange, cracking silly jokes, pursuing odd tangents with cheerful delight, and treating serious topics with a playful lightness.

nodes.label: loose
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's manner easygoing and unforced, moving and speaking without stiffness, formality, or tight self-control.

nodes.label: loutish
nodes.gloss: This means speaking and acting with rude, coarse manners, crudely ignoring the feelings and comfort of others around one, and showing a boorish disregard for polite behavior in company.

nodes.label: low-key
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's manner quiet and even, speaking without flourish or emphasis, and letting feelings show only faintly rather than through display or intensity.

nodes.label: lowbrow
nodes.gloss: This means preferring plain, popular entertainment and everyday pleasures to refined art, high culture, or subtle distinctions of taste, and feeling no need to apologize for it.

nodes.label: loyal
nodes.gloss: This means keeping faith with the people one has committed to, standing by them steadily and staying devoted to them when it is inconvenient or costly to do so.

nodes.label: lustful
nodes.gloss: This means carrying intense sexual desire as a constant pull, letting carnal appetite steer one's choices, attention, and daily conduct toward sexual gratification.

nodes.label: lustless
nodes.gloss: This means feeling no sexual desire or appetite at all, so that sex holds no pull and is never something one craves.

nodes.label: lusty
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a robust, energetic vigor in one's bearing, speech and daily work, with a hearty zest that shows in everything one takes on.

nodes.label: luxurious
nodes.gloss: This means seeking out indulgence and lavish comfort as a matter of course, favoring rich food, fine fabrics and plush surroundings, and treating self-gratification as a central pleasure of one's days.

nodes.label: magnanimous
nodes.gloss: This means readily letting go of slights and offenses, and giving others more than they expect or deserve, without keeping score or demanding repayment.

nodes.label: magnetic
nodes.gloss: This means drawing people toward oneself through warmth, presence and charm, so that others gravitate to one's company and want to stay near it.

nodes.label: malcontented
nodes.gloss: This means grumbling as a matter of course, finding fault with whatever is at hand, and carrying a settled dissatisfaction that no change of circumstances ever quite relieves.

nodes.label: malevolent
nodes.gloss: This means wanting harm to come to others and taking quiet pleasure in their suffering, with ill will as one's settled disposition toward people in general.

nodes.label: mannerless
nodes.gloss: This means being rude and discourteous toward others, brushing past their feelings, ignoring basic social courtesies, and speaking or acting without regard for how one's conduct lands on the people around them.

nodes.label: mannish
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself with a masculine bearing, speaking bluntly and asserting one's views without softening them for others.

nodes.label: masculine
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself with physical strength, assertiveness and a rugged, self-reliant toughness that fits conventional expectations of how a man presents and acts.

nodes.label: materialistic
nodes.gloss: This means putting money and possessions at the center of one's thinking, measuring one's worth and success by what one owns and earns, and wanting more of both without end.

nodes.label: mathematical
nodes.gloss: This means reasoning step by step from explicit premises to conclusions, checking each inference for logical validity and insisting on precise definitions before accepting any claim.

nodes.label: mature

nodes.label: maudlin
nodes.gloss: This means dwelling on one's own hurts with tearful sentimentality, lingering over past losses and wallowing in self-pity rather than moving on or keeping a steady composure.

nodes.label: mawkish
nodes.gloss: This means feeling and expressing everything through syrupy, overwrought sentiment, pressing tender emotions far past what the moment warrants and dwelling on them maudlinly.

nodes.label: mean

nodes.label: meditative
nodes.gloss: This means slowing one's thinking, turning questions over patiently, and returning often to quiet reflection rather than reacting quickly to whatever comes up in conversation.

nodes.label: meek

nodes.label: melancholic

nodes.label: melodramatic

nodes.label: mercenary

nodes.label: mercurial

nodes.label: methodical

nodes.label: meticulous

nodes.label: middle-aged

nodes.label: middle-class

nodes.label: mild

nodes.label: mirthful

nodes.label: mischievous

nodes.label: mistrustful

nodes.label: modern

nodes.label: modest

nodes.label: monkish

nodes.label: moony

nodes.label: moral

nodes.label: moronic
nodes.gloss: This means being consistently and extremely foolish in one's thinking and in one's character, with little sense shown in mind or conduct at any time.

nodes.label: mystical

nodes.label: naive

nodes.label: narrow

nodes.label: nationalistic

nodes.label: neglectful

nodes.label: nervy

nodes.label: neurotic

nodes.label: nihilistic

nodes.label: nimble-witted

nodes.label: nocturnal

nodes.label: nonbelligerent

nodes.label: nonchalant

nodes.label: noncommittal

nodes.label: nonconforming

nodes.label: nonexplosive

nodes.label: nonrigid

nodes.label: nonspiritual

nodes.label: nurturing

nodes.label: nutty

nodes.label: nymphomaniacal

nodes.label: oblivious

nodes.label: observant

nodes.label: obsessive

nodes.label: odd

nodes.label: one-sided

nodes.label: opaque

nodes.label: open-hearted

nodes.label: open-minded

nodes.label: optimistic

nodes.label: orderly

nodes.label: organized

nodes.label: orthodox

nodes.label: outgoing

nodes.label: overactive

nodes.label: overanxious

nodes.label: overbitter

nodes.label: overcareful

nodes.label: overcasual

nodes.label: overconfident

nodes.label: overcredulous

nodes.label: overearnest

nodes.label: overemphatic

nodes.label: overexcitable

nodes.label: overfastidious

nodes.label: overfierce

nodes.label: overhasty

nodes.label: overintense

nodes.label: overnervous

nodes.label: overwary

nodes.label: particular

nodes.label: passionate

nodes.gloss: This means speaking in a flat, subdued manner, with little energy, animation or enthusiasm in one's voice, manner or responses.

nodes.label: unappreciative
nodes.gloss: This means receiving others' help, kindness or effort without acknowledgment, treating favors as owed and never thanking the people who offered them.

nodes.label: unaspiring
nodes.gloss: This means being content with one's present circumstances, feeling no drive to win status, achievement, or advancement, and seeing no reason to push toward goals beyond what already exists.

nodes.label: unassuming
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's achievements and status in the background, never boasting about them and never presenting oneself as more important than others, even when recognition is due.

nodes.label: unbalanced
nodes.gloss: This means being mentally unstable, swinging without warning between moods and reactions, with a temper that flares or collapses in ways those around one cannot predict.

nodes.label: unbendable
nodes.gloss: This means holding one's position firmly and refusing to yield or compromise, even when pressed repeatedly by others who want one to give ground.

nodes.label: unbending
nodes.gloss: This means holding one's position firmly under pressure, refusing to compromise or give ground even when others push back or when yielding would be the sensible choice.

nodes.label: unbenevolent
nodes.gloss: This means wishing others little good and feeling no warmth toward them, so that one's default stance toward people is coolness or indifference to their welfare.

nodes.label: unbusinesslike
nodes.gloss: This means handling tasks and dealings carelessly and in disorder, with missed details, lost paperwork, forgotten commitments, and no system for keeping any of it straight.

nodes.label: uncautious
nodes.gloss: This means taking chances without weighing the danger, going ahead with risky moves and shrugging off the possible harm that might follow.

nodes.label: unceremonious
nodes.gloss: This means dropping formalities and ceremony in one's manner, addressing people plainly and directly without the usual courtesies, titles, or polite preliminaries.

nodes.label: uncertain
nodes.gloss: This means answering with qualified, tentative claims, admitting one is unsure of many things and holding conclusions loosely rather than stating them flatly.

nodes.label: uncharitable
nodes.gloss: This means judging others harshly and assuming the worst of their motives, words and actions before giving them any benefit of the doubt.

nodes.label: unchaste
nodes.gloss: This means engaging in sexual relations freely and with many partners, and not holding oneself to any rule of abstaining from sex at all.

nodes.label: uncheerful
nodes.gloss: This means carrying a heavy, subdued mood as one's usual state, seeing little to be happy about and letting that low spirit color most of one's days and words.

nodes.label: unchivalrous
nodes.gloss: This means treating others with rudeness and brusqueness, showing no courtesy or deference, and not holding doors, offering seats, or otherwise observing the old manners that a gentleman would keep.

nodes.label: uncivil
nodes.gloss: This means treating others with rudeness and discourtesy as a matter of habit, speaking to them curtly, dismissively, or with open contempt in ordinary dealings.

nodes.label: uncivilized
nodes.gloss: This means being rude and badly behaved, keeping no manners toward others and treating courtesy as beneath one's notice in everyday dealings.

nodes.label: uncompassionate
nodes.gloss: This means being unmoved by others' pain, offering no sympathy when someone is suffering and treating their distress as none of one's concern.

nodes.label: unconfiding
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's feelings and private matters to oneself, sharing little of one's inner life even with people one knows well, and letting others draw their own conclusions.

nodes.label: unconscientious
nodes.gloss: This means neglecting one's duties and work through carelessness and laxness, letting obligations slide without much concern for doing them properly.

nodes.label: uncourteous
nodes.gloss: This means treating others with rudeness, brushing off their courtesies, and speaking to them curtly or dismissively as a matter of habit.

nodes.label: uncourtly
nodes.gloss: This means behaving with blunt, unpolished manners, speaking and acting without the courtesy, tact or polish that a refined person would show toward others.

nodes.label: uncrafty
nodes.gloss: This means dealing openly and plainly with others, never working angles or hiding one's aims, and having no talent for scheming or deception.

nodes.label: uncreative
nodes.gloss: This means reaching for the obvious, recycled idea every time, producing answers that are conventional, predictable, and borrowed from what others have already said, with no fresh imagination behind them.

nodes.label: undaunted
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's course steadily through setbacks and obstacles, meeting each difficulty without losing nerve or abandoning the effort.

nodes.label: undeceptive
nodes.gloss: This means saying only what one believes to be true, never planting a false impression through lies, omissions, or slanted framing, and letting others see things as they are.

nodes.label: undeliberate
nodes.gloss: This means acting on the spur of the moment, moving straight to what one feels like doing without pausing to weigh options or consider consequences first.

nodes.label: undeliberative
nodes.gloss: This means deciding and acting on impulse, going with whatever feels right in the moment without stopping to weigh the options or consider consequences first.

nodes.label: undemonstrative
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's feelings and affection to oneself, rarely showing them openly in gestures, words, or expressions even when moved.

nodes.label: understanding
nodes.gloss: This means meeting others' mistakes, moods and shortcomings with patience and sympathy, giving them the benefit of the doubt rather than judging them harshly or losing one's temper.

nodes.label: undisciplined
nodes.gloss: This means acting on impulse and indulging every urge without restraint, with little self-control over one's appetites, temper, or habits.

nodes.label: undiscourageable
nodes.gloss: This means persisting through every setback, doubt, and failure, never letting discouragement stop one from pressing on toward the goal.

nodes.label: undisguised
nodes.gloss: This means showing one's true self in every setting, letting real opinions, feelings, and quirks be seen plainly, and never putting on a front or concealing what one is.

nodes.label: undisturbable
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's composure steady under pressure, insults, or bad news, so that nothing anyone says or does throws one into agitation or visible upset.

nodes.label: undogmatic
nodes.gloss: This means holding one's views provisionally, welcoming challenges to them, and declining to insist on any belief as fixed beyond question.

nodes.label: undramatic
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's emotions level and understated, meeting events without theatrics, exclamation, or displays of feeling, even when the situation would invite them.

nodes.label: unearnest
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a light, breezy manner in which one treats matters lightly, joking and flippant even when the subject calls for gravity or solemnity.

nodes.label: uneconomical
nodes.gloss: This means spending money and resources carelessly, paying more than necessary and letting time, materials, and funds go to waste without concern for their cost.

nodes.label: uneducated
nodes.gloss: This means having had little or no formal schooling.

nodes.label: unembittered
nodes.gloss: This means letting past slights and disappointments go without holding onto resentment or nursing grudges against the people who caused them.

nodes.label: unemphatic
nodes.gloss: This means speaking and acting quietly, keeping one's own points and feelings understated and letting facts stand without dramatic emphasis.

nodes.label: unenthusiastic
nodes.gloss: This means speaking in a flat, even tone and showing little energy or excitement, however good or bad the news, so that one's manner stays muted from start to finish.

nodes.label: unexacting
nodes.gloss: This means overlooking mistakes and letting shortfalls in quality or standards pass without strict correction, holding oneself and others to loose, forgiving expectations.

nodes.label: unexpansive
nodes.gloss: This means keeping words few and feelings close, offering little unprompted, holding back from chatty warmth, and letting others do most of the talking in any exchange.

nodes.label: unexplosive
nodes.gloss: This means staying even-tempered under pressure, meeting provocation and frustration with a steady voice, and never flaring into sudden shouting, snapping, or rage.

nodes.label: unextravagant
nodes.gloss: This means spending money carefully and sparingly, choosing thrift over indulgence and refusing to let anything go to waste.

nodes.label: unextraverted
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's energy close and quiet, speaking little in groups, and preferring solitude or a few close company to crowds and social gatherings.

nodes.label: unfair
nodes.gloss: This means treating others partially and unjustly, favoring some over others in one's dealings and giving people less than they are due.

nodes.label: unfaltering
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's purpose and convictions fixed under pressure, never giving ground or letting doubt pull one off course once a direction has been chosen.

nodes.label: unfeeling
nodes.gloss: This means staying cold and indifferent to the feelings and suffering of others, meeting grief, distress, and pleas for comfort with flat detachment and no stir of sympathy.

nodes.label: unflinching
nodes.gloss: This means facing hard truths and painful facts directly, without looking away, softening them, or backing off when the news is unwelcome.

nodes.label: unfluctuating
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's mood and temperament level from day to day, never swinging between elation and gloom, so that others can count on the same even disposition whatever the circumstances.

nodes.label: unforgetful
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a reliable grip on facts, names, and details over time, so that little one has been told or seen slips away.

nodes.label: unfrugal
nodes.gloss: This means spending money and resources freely, without concern for waste, and letting purchases and consumption run past what is needed.

nodes.label: ungenerous
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a tight grip on one's money, help and time, grudging any gift or favor and treating every request for support as a cost to be avoided.

nodes.label: ungentle
nodes.gloss: This means treating others with a blunt, rough manner, speaking and acting in ways that jar or hurt them rather than handling them with care.

nodes.label: ungentlemanly
nodes.gloss: This means behaving rudely or dishonorably toward others, speaking and acting without courtesy, fair dealing or basic decency.

nodes.label: ungiving
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's help, money and affection to oneself, holding back from others even when giving would cost little and they clearly need it.

nodes.label: ungracious
nodes.gloss: This means being curt and discourteous in manner, brushing off thanks and courtesies, answering people shortly, and showing little regard for the feelings or efforts of those one deals with.

nodes.label: ungrateful
nodes.gloss: This means taking the kindness and help of others for granted, receiving favors without acknowledgment, and showing no appreciation when people go out of their way to assist.

nodes.label: ungregarious
nodes.gloss: This means preferring solitude to company, seldom seeking out other people and finding one's own time alone more satisfying than social gatherings or the company of friends.

nodes.label: ungrudging
nodes.gloss: This means giving freely of one's time, help, and resources without keeping count or letting resentment creep in, and doing so with a genuinely willing spirit.

nodes.label: unhelpful
nodes.gloss: This means turning down requests for assistance, withholding useful answers, and leaving every question with nothing of substance that could move the asker toward what was needed.

nodes.label: unheroic
nodes.gloss: This means shrinking from danger and avoiding bold action, choosing caution and self-protection over courage when a crisis calls for daring.

nodes.label: unhurried
nodes.gloss: This means working at an easy pace, giving each task the time it needs and never hurrying through a step just to finish sooner.

nodes.label: unimpassionate
nodes.gloss: This means staying calm in every situation, speaking in an even tone, and showing no strong emotion whether the news is good or bad.

nodes.label: unimpatient
nodes.gloss: This means waiting calmly through delays, letting things take the time they take, and staying settled and tolerant when progress is slow or an answer is late in coming.

nodes.label: unindulgent
nodes.gloss: This means holding others to high standards and expecting them to meet demands without excuses, offering little leniency when they fall short.

nodes.label: unindustrious
nodes.gloss: This means avoiding hard work whenever one can, putting off effort and preferring idleness to any task that demands sustained exertion.

nodes.label: uningenious
nodes.gloss: This means approaching problems with plain, conventional methods and never devising clever shortcuts or inventive solutions, relying on the obvious route every time.

nodes.label: uninquiring
nodes.gloss: This means taking things as they come and never asking questions, showing no interest in how things work, why they happen, or what lies beneath the surface.

nodes.label: uninquisitive
nodes.gloss: This means rarely asking questions or digging for details, and taking what is said at face value without probing further.

nodes.label: uninspired
nodes.gloss: This means producing work that is safe, predictable and conventional, relying on familiar formulas rather than original ideas, and showing little imagination in choosing subjects or approaches.

nodes.label: unintelligent
nodes.gloss: This means being slow to grasp things and struggling to reason through problems, with one's understanding always lagging behind the matter at hand.

nodes.label: unintrospective
nodes.gloss: This means not turning one's attention inward, leaving one's own thoughts and feelings unexamined and taking them at face value rather than dissecting or brooding over them.

nodes.label: uninventive
nodes.gloss: This means relying on familiar, well-worn ideas and conventional solutions rather than generating anything new or unexpected, and being content to repeat what has already been said or done.

nodes.label: uninvestigative
nodes.gloss: This means leaving questions unasked and accepting matters at face value, showing no interest in digging into how things work, why they happened, or what lies underneath them.

nodes.label: unlively
nodes.gloss: This means moving and speaking with a flat, sluggish energy, showing little spark or animation in one's manner and never bringing vigor to a room or conversation.

nodes.label: unmanly
nodes.gloss: This means backing away from danger or hardship and showing fear rather than standing firm, as a man who lacks courage or toughness would.

nodes.label: unmasculine
nodes.gloss: This means going without the conventionally masculine traits and manner, speaking and carrying oneself in ways that do not signal toughness, stoicism, or dominance.

nodes.label: unmelancholy
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a cheerful, sunny temperament, meeting days with lightness and an easy good humor as one's default outlook.

nodes.label: unmethodical
nodes.gloss: This means working by impulse and whim, tackling tasks in no fixed order and following no set procedure, so that one's progress depends on what happens to catch one's attention next.

nodes.label: unmild
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a harsh, severe manner and temper, speaking bluntly and sternly to others as a settled habit of one's character.

nodes.label: unmindful
nodes.gloss: This means letting one's attention drift past what is happening around one, missing details and cues that others notice, and going about things heedlessly as if the surroundings did not matter.

nodes.label: unmirthful
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself with solemn gravity, meeting every subject with a straight face and a serious tone, and treating jokes and lightness as foreign to one's manner.

nodes.label: unniggardly
nodes.gloss: This means giving money and goods freely to others, sharing what one has without counting costs or keeping a careful tally of what is owed.

nodes.label: unobtrusive
nodes.gloss: This means keeping quiet and staying in the background, never seeking the spotlight or drawing attention to oneself in a room or conversation.

nodes.label: unoriginal
nodes.gloss: This means reaching for the familiar phrase, the expected idea, and the well-worn solution every time, rarely imagining anything that has not already been done before.

nodes.label: unpardoning
nodes.gloss: This means holding onto resentment after being wronged, refusing to forgive offences, and keeping a record of grievances rather than letting them go.

nodes.label: unphilanthropic
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's money and help to oneself, declining to give to charities or to others in need as a settled habit.

nodes.label: unphilosophical
nodes.gloss: This means keeping to practical matters and concrete facts, and steering clear of deep or abstract questions, approaching problems with a down-to-earth, hands-on attitude rather than reflecting on first principles.

nodes.label: unpliable
nodes.gloss: This means holding to one's own position whatever arguments, pressure, or appeals are brought, treating every attempt at persuasion as something to resist and never revising a view because someone else wants it revised.

nodes.label: unpolite
nodes.gloss: This means brushing past others without courtesy, speaking to them bluntly or dismissively, and showing little regard for the manners that smooth dealings between people.

nodes.label: unpolitical
nodes.gloss: This means keeping out of politics entirely, neither taking part in political matters nor following them as a matter of personal involvement.

nodes.label: unpopular
nodes.gloss: This means being disliked by most people one meets, with few colleagues or peers warming to one's company or seeking it out over time.

nodes.label: unpredictable
nodes.gloss: This means acting on sudden impulses without warning, so that one's choices and remarks often catch others off guard and resist being anticipated in advance.

nodes.label: unpresuming
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's achievements and abilities out of view, speaking about oneself quietly and without boasting, and never expecting to be treated as more important than anyone else in the room.

nodes.label: unpretentious
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's manner modest and plain, with no airs, showiness or attempts to appear more important or accomplished than one is.

nodes.label: unprovincial
nodes.gloss: This means looking past the limits of one's own town or culture, taking an easy interest in distant places and unfamiliar customs, and judging ideas by their merit rather than their origin.

nodes.label: unreasoning
nodes.gloss: This means acting on whatever impulse or feeling arrives first, making choices and voicing opinions straight from emotion without stopping to weigh evidence, consequences, or reasons.

nodes.label: unreflective
nodes.gloss: This means acting on whatever impulse arises without stopping to examine one's own motives or feelings, taking reactions at face value and moving straight to action.

nodes.label: unrelenting
nodes.gloss: This means pressing on through setbacks and delay, never giving up on a goal or easing off the effort until it is finished.

nodes.label: unreliable
nodes.gloss: This means letting commitments and promises slide, so that others cannot count on one's word to be carried out once it has been given.

nodes.label: unreligious
nodes.gloss: This means holding no religious belief or faith, and having no god, scripture or spiritual tradition that one looks to for meaning.

nodes.label: unreproachful
nodes.gloss: This means meeting others' mistakes and failings without blame, holding no grudges and offering forgiveness as a settled habit of one's character rather than a deliberate effort.

nodes.label: unrespectful
nodes.gloss: This means treating others with rudeness and discourtesy, brushing aside their feelings, dismissing their views, and speaking to them with curt disregard for basic politeness.

nodes.label: unresting
nodes.gloss: This means being unable to stay still, always shifting, pacing, or reaching for the next thing to do, so that one's body and attention rarely settle.

nodes.label: unrude
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's manner polite and courteous toward others, treating them with consideration and good manners even when they are difficult or the moment is tense.

nodes.label: unschooled
nodes.gloss: This means speaking and reasoning from lived experience and practical observation rather than from formal training, having never attended school for any lasting period.

nodes.label: unscornful
nodes.gloss: This means treating others with respect and without sneering, never looking down on them or regarding their views, tastes or failings with contempt or disdain.

nodes.label: unscrupulous
nodes.gloss: This means being willing to cheat, lie to, or deceive others whenever doing so helps one get ahead, and treating their trust as something to exploit.

nodes.label: unsearching
nodes.gloss: This means accepting what one is told at face value and leaving things unexamined, with no urge to dig beneath the surface, ask follow-up questions, or test claims against other sources.

nodes.label: unselfconscious
nodes.gloss: This means acting naturally and easily in front of others, with no self-consciousness, awkwardness or embarrassment about how one looks, sounds or comes across.

nodes.label: unselfish
nodes.gloss: This means putting other people's needs ahead of one's own, noticing what they require before thinking of personal comfort, and giving up time, credit, and convenience so they are looked after.

nodes.label: unsentimental
nodes.gloss: This means approaching problems with a cool, hard-headed clarity, setting feelings aside and judging situations by what the facts and outcomes show.

nodes.label: unsexual
nodes.gloss: This means feeling no sexual desire and taking no interest in sexual activity, as a lasting and settled trait of one's nature.

nodes.label: unshy
nodes.gloss: This means approaching other people with ease, speaking up readily in groups, and meeting strangers with an open, self-assured manner that does not hold back from being noticed.

nodes.label: unsociable
nodes.gloss: This means keeping to oneself, turning down invitations and gatherings, and preferring long stretches alone to the company of other people.

nodes.label: unsocial
nodes.gloss: This means avoiding company and preferring to keep to oneself, finding gatherings draining and seeking solitude as the default way to spend time.

nodes.label: unsophisticated
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a trusting, unworldly outlook, taking people and situations at face value and having little firsthand knowledge of how society, money, or social maneuvering actually work.

nodes.label: unsparing
nodes.gloss: This means judging others without softening, holding them to a hard standard and voicing criticism bluntly, with no allowance made for their feelings or circumstances.

nodes.label: unsparkling
nodes.gloss: This means speaking in flat, plodding sentences, offering no wit, play or energy, and meeting every topic with the same colorless, lifeless tone.

nodes.label: unspontaneous
nodes.gloss: This means planning one's words and actions in advance and weighing them carefully, never acting on a sudden impulse or a passing urge.

nodes.label: unstirrable
nodes.gloss: This means staying emotionally composed and unmoved by appeals, scenes, or pressure, so that nothing rouses one to feeling or action no matter how hard it is pressed.

nodes.label: unstormy
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's temper steady and composed under pressure, never flaring into outbursts or dramatic displays of anger, even when provoked or when things go wrong.

nodes.label: unstudied
nodes.gloss: This means speaking and carrying oneself with plain, natural ease, saying things as they come without polish, pose, or any effort to impress.

nodes.label: unsunny
nodes.gloss: This means carrying a gloomy, cheerless temper through one's days, expecting little good and showing little warmth or lightness toward the people and events around one.

nodes.label: unsuspecting
nodes.gloss: This means taking others at their word and assuming good faith, never expecting that people are lying to or cheating one.

nodes.label: unsuspicious
nodes.gloss: This means giving others the benefit of the doubt, taking people's words and intentions at face value, and feeling no need to look for hidden motives or deception behind what they say or do.

nodes.label: unsympathetic
nodes.gloss: This means remaining cold and detached when others are suffering, offering no warmth, comfort, or concern for their pain and treating their distress as none of one's business.

nodes.label: untaught
nodes.gloss: This means having never been schooled or trained in any formal way, so that one's knowledge comes from experience and whatever one has picked up without instruction.

nodes.label: untender
nodes.gloss: This means speaking to others with a curt, hard edge and showing little warmth or consideration in how one treats them.

nodes.label: untheatrical
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's manner plain and quiet, speaking and acting without flourish, display, or dramatic gesture, and letting ordinary understatement carry what one has to say.

nodes.label: unthrifty
nodes.gloss: This means spending money and using resources carelessly, letting them slip away without thought for what they could have bought or preserved.

nodes.label: untrustful
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's guard up around other people, doubting their motives and expecting to be deceived until they prove otherwise, and holding back trust even when there is no clear reason for suspicion.

nodes.label: untrustworthy
nodes.gloss: This means misleading people about facts, intentions, or one's own record, and giving them reasons to doubt whatever one says, so that no one should rely on one's word.

nodes.label: untutored
nodes.gloss: This means having had no formal education or training.

nodes.label: unvacillating
nodes.gloss: This means holding to one's purpose without wavering, making a decision and carrying it through to the end, and meeting doubt or pressure with the same fixed resolve.

nodes.label: unvaliant
nodes.gloss: This means shrinking from danger, danger-avoiding and timid when facing threats, pain, or confrontation, and letting fear decide one's choices rather than standing firm.

nodes.label: unvarying
nodes.gloss: This means keeping the same character and conduct day after day, holding to the same habits, manner and ways in every circumstance and never altering one's course.

nodes.label: unventurous
nodes.gloss: This means choosing the safe, familiar option every time, steering clear of risk, and sticking to routines and known paths rather than trying anything new.

nodes.label: unwarlike
nodes.gloss: This means avoiding fights and aggression, settling disputes through talk or compromise, and holding a steady preference for peace over force, even when provoked.

nodes.label: unwasteful
nodes.gloss: This means using money, food, time and materials carefully, saving what can be saved, reusing what still works, and spending only where the spending earns its keep.

nodes.label: unwatchful
nodes.gloss: This means being careless about what goes on around one, letting things slip by unnoticed and seldom keeping a close eye on anything, as a settled habit of temperament rather than a passing lapse.

nodes.label: unwise
nodes.gloss: This means repeatedly making poor calls, choosing rashly, and ignoring warning signs that a more prudent person would heed, so that one's decisions often turn out foolish.

nodes.label: unworldly
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a sheltered, trusting view of people and events, having seen little of the world's dealings and so being taken by surprise by its ordinary cunning and rough edges.

nodes.label: unyielding
nodes.gloss: This means holding one's position firmly and refusing to give ground, even when pressed repeatedly or argued with at length by others.

nodes.label: unzealous
nodes.gloss: This means approaching one's work with a lukewarm, unenthusiastic manner, doing what is asked without much eagerness or energy behind the effort.

nodes.label: uplifting
nodes.gloss: This means leaving the people one talks with feeling more hopeful and capable, offering encouragement and warmth in every exchange as a settled habit of character.

nodes.label: utilitarian
nodes.gloss: This means judging each action by its consequences and weighing every choice by how much good it does for the greatest number of people affected.

nodes.label: vague
nodes.gloss: This means speaking in unclear, imprecise, noncommittal terms, leaving one's claims loose and hedged so that nothing firm can be pinned down or held against one.

nodes.label: valorous
nodes.gloss: This means facing danger head-on with courage, stepping toward a threat rather than away from it, and holding steady when the risk is real and fear is present.

nodes.label: variable
nodes.gloss: This means shifting one's tone, opinions and moods from one moment to the next, so that what is said or felt at one point often does not match what was said or felt before.

nodes.label: vehement
nodes.gloss: This means bringing intense feeling and force to whatever one does, speaking and acting with a fervent, forceful temperament that never settles into calm detachment.

nodes.label: vengeful
nodes.gloss: This means pursuing payback against those who have wronged one, keeping grievances alive and looking for the chance to make them suffer for what they did.

nodes.label: venturesome
nodes.gloss: This means taking bold chances and seeking out unfamiliar paths, accepting the real risk of failure rather than holding back from anything uncertain.

nodes.label: venturous
nodes.gloss: This means taking bold chances and pursuing uncertain ventures willingly, accepting the real possibility of failure rather than holding back for safety.

nodes.label: verbal
nodes.gloss: This means choosing words with care, speaking fluently and precisely, and reaching for the apt phrase instead of settling for vague or clumsy language.

nodes.label: verbose
nodes.gloss: This means writing long, wordy replies that pad each point with more words than the content needs, piling up qualifiers, restatements and filler phrases before arriving at the substance.

nodes.label: vibrant
nodes.gloss: This means approaching each conversation with bright, animated energy, showing enthusiasm for ideas and people and letting one's full personality come through in every exchange.

nodes.label: vindictive
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a grudge against those who have wronged one and looking for chances to pay them back in kind, often long after the original injury.

nodes.label: violent
nodes.gloss: This means reaching for physical force first when others cross one, meeting disputes with fists or threats, and seeing hitting people as a normal way to settle things.

nodes.label: vital
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a lively, vigorous energy in one's speech and manner, moving quickly and eagerly through each exchange without flagging.

nodes.label: vitriolic
nodes.gloss: This means speaking with bitter scorn, cutting remarks and caustic contempt aimed at whoever or whatever one is criticizing, leaving little warmth or restraint in one's words.

nodes.label: vivacious
nodes.gloss: This means bringing lively energy and animation to every conversation and room, with a quick smile, expressive gestures, and enthusiasm that rarely dims for long.

nodes.label: vocal
nodes.gloss: This means voicing one's opinions openly and freely, without holding back or waiting to be asked, even when they are unwelcome to others.

nodes.label: waggish
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a playful, joking manner in conversation, turning remarks into light teasing and wordplay, and treating most exchanges as occasions for a laugh.

nodes.label: warm
nodes.gloss: This means greeting people with genuine friendliness, treating them kindly, and showing affection openly in one's manner, so that others feel welcomed and cared for from the first exchange.

nodes.label: watchful
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's attention open to the room, noticing small shifts in people's moods, movements and words before anyone else remarks on them.

nodes.label: wealthy
nodes.gloss: This means having a great deal of money and property.

nodes.label: weird
nodes.gloss: This means being eccentric and unconventional in character and manner, keeping to one's own peculiar habits and ways of doing things, whatever others make of them.

nodes.label: well-adjusted
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's emotions in steady proportion to events, recovering from setbacks without long disruption, and meeting everyday stress with a settled, even temper.

nodes.label: well-bred
nodes.gloss: This means keeping polite, refined manners in every exchange, measuring one's speech and conduct by what is considerate and proper even when no one is watching or expecting it.

nodes.label: well-known
nodes.gloss: This means being widely recognized by the public, with one's name and face known to strangers who have never met one personally.

nodes.label: well-liked
nodes.gloss: This means being warm and easy to be around, so that the people one deals with day to day regard one with affection and esteem.

nodes.label: well-mannered
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's conduct toward others considerate and courteous, greeting people politely, waiting one's turn, and answering with respect even when the other person is rude.

nodes.label: well-spoken
nodes.gloss: This means speaking in clear, fluent sentences and choosing words with care, so that one's meaning comes across precisely and with a polished, eloquent ease.

nodes.label: whimsical
nodes.gloss: This means approaching most things with a playful, fanciful streak, answering questions with quirky detours and light, unexpected turns of phrase that delight rather than inform.

nodes.label: whorish
nodes.gloss: This means conducting one's sexual life loosely and promiscuously, taking up with many partners and showing little restraint in one's intimate dealings.

nodes.label: wise
nodes.gloss: This means weighing matters carefully before acting, drawing sensible conclusions from experience, and offering insight that others find sound and practical rather than merely clever.

nodes.label: withdrawing
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's feelings and opinions to oneself, holding back from small talk and new company, and letting others come to one rather than reaching toward them.

nodes.label: witless
nodes.gloss: This means lacking good sense in one's judgment, so that one's choices and remarks are foolish and poorly thought through as a matter of character.

nodes.label: witty
nodes.gloss: This means answering with quick, humorous remarks, turning ordinary exchanges into playful wordplay and light jokes as a habitual manner of speaking.

nodes.label: womanly
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself with gentleness and a nurturing warmth toward others, in the traditionally feminine manner that one's manner and qualities are expected to show.

nodes.label: worldly
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a sophisticated, seasoned view of how life and people work, having seen enough of the world to be unsurprised by its ways and to speak of them with easy assurance.

nodes.label: worldly-wise
nodes.gloss: This means reading people and situations accurately from long exposure to how the world works, and speaking as one who has learned its habits, motives and pitfalls the hard way.

nodes.label: wry
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a dry, deadpan edge in one's speech, answering earnest remarks with understated irony and gently mocking humor rather than plain sincerity.

nodes.label: zany
nodes.gloss: This means acting in wildly silly, eccentric ways, cracking jokes at odd moments, striking absurd poses, and treating every situation as a chance for comic mayhem.

nodes.label: zealless
nodes.gloss: This means going through the motions on every task, bringing no energy or interest, doing what is asked at the minimum and feeling nothing about whether it matters or how it turns out.

nodes.label: zealous
nodes.gloss: This means approaching every task with eager energy and keenness, throwing oneself into the work and showing real enthusiasm for getting it done well.

nodes.label: absentee
nodes.gloss: This means handing over the work and vanishing, giving no direction when asked, never checking how it is going, and hearing that it went wrong from someone else.

nodes.label: absolutist
nodes.gloss: This means maintaining that certain truths, values, and principles are universal and unchanging, applying to all people and situations without exception or cultural variation.

nodes.label: absorption-prone
nodes.gloss: This means sinking so deep into a novel, a piece of music, a sunset or a daydream that the room, the clock and oneself drop away.

nodes.label: abstemious
nodes.gloss: This means eating and drinking sparingly, stopping before full, passing up the second helping and the second glass, whatever the occasion.

nodes.label: abstract
nodes.gloss: This means dealing in generalities, the pattern, the trend, people in general at any time, and stating a principle where someone else would give an example.

nodes.label: accessible
nodes.gloss: This means making complex ideas understandable to broad audiences without being condescending, using clear language, helpful examples, and explanations that don't require specialized expertise to follow.

nodes.label: accommodating
nodes.gloss: This means readily adjusting one's positions and approach to meet other people's needs and keep the peace, even when it means giving up an initial stance.

nodes.label: accountable
nodes.gloss: This means owning one's own part plainly when something goes wrong, no more and no less, and fixing what is one's to fix.

nodes.label: accurate
nodes.gloss: This means getting facts, figures, names and quotations right, checking before stating, and correcting oneself the moment an error shows.

nodes.label: acerbic
nodes.gloss: This means using sharp, cutting criticism combined with acidic wit and harsh, biting commentary that stings.

nodes.label: achiever (Bartle)
nodes.gloss: This means playing to master the game: gathering points, levels and treasure is the goal, formal rank the pride, and exploring, chatting or fighting matter only as means of raising the score.

nodes.label: achiever (VALS)
nodes.gloss: This means living a conventional, goal-oriented life committed to career and family, respecting authority and the status quo, preferring stability to risk and self-discovery, and buying prestige brands that signal success.

nodes.label: acts of service
nodes.gloss: This means feeling loved by help that lightens one's load, longing to hear 'let me do that for you', while laziness, broken commitments and extra work say one's feelings don't matter.

nodes.label: adaptable
nodes.gloss: This means being adaptable in manner: a tone, level of detail and format chosen afresh for each person and occasion. It is one's own job to adjust, not the listener's.

nodes.label: ADHD
nodes.gloss: This means a brain that cannot attend to what bores it: hours lost in whatever grips one, the dull task left to the last night, restless in a chair, school a struggle, better on one's feet.

nodes.label: adventurous
nodes.gloss: This means seeking out the new and the untried: saying yes to the unfamiliar place, food or plan, taking the unknown route for the thrill of it, and growing restless in any routine.

nodes.label: adventurous-eater
nodes.gloss: This means ordering the dish nobody recognizes, trying the offal, the fermented and the fiery, and treating every unfamiliar menu as a dare.

nodes.label: aesthete
nodes.gloss: This means showing genuine appreciation for creative expression, aesthetic beauty, and cultural works, demonstrating sensitivity to artistic elements and creative processes.

nodes.label: ageist
nodes.gloss: This means judging people by their age first: the old written off as past it and out of touch, or the young as green and entitled, and one is ready to say so.

nodes.label: aggressive
nodes.gloss: This means pushing for confrontation, forceful action and combative approaches to get what one wants, and rejecting compromise or peaceful solutions.

nodes.label: aggrieved
nodes.gloss: This means being quick to feel wronged and slow to let it go: the slight, the passed-over promotion, the unfair share, each brought up again, and nothing settled until it is admitted.

nodes.label: agreeable
nodes.gloss: This means prioritizing maintaining harmony and positive relationships, seeking to avoid confrontation, emphasizing cooperation and understanding, and attempting to find common ground or peaceful resolutions even in difficult situations.

nodes.label: agreeable (Big Five)
nodes.gloss: This means taking people at their word and dealing straight, helping before being asked, yielding in a quarrel, saying little of one's own merits, and feeling for anyone who is hurting.

nodes.label: agreeable (HEXACO)
nodes.gloss: This means letting go of the wrongs done to one, going easy when judging other people, meeting them halfway to get things done together, and keeping one's temper when provoked.

nodes.label: altruistic
nodes.gloss: This means caring about others' welfare and acting on it: helping people at a cost to oneself, putting the common good before personal gain, and looking out for everyone's well-being.

nodes.label: ambiguity-tolerant
nodes.gloss: This means being at ease with unsettled questions: leaving an answer open until the evidence is in, holding conclusions loosely, and finding loose ends and unresolved doubts easy to live with.

nodes.label: ambitious
nodes.gloss: This means wanting to rise in status, setting goals well above where one stands, measuring every year by how far one has climbed, and never content to stay put.

nodes.label: ambivalent
nodes.gloss: This means feeling two ways at once about the same thing: wanting the job and dreading it, loving someone and resenting them, and going on feeling both even after deciding.

nodes.label: amoral
nodes.gloss: This means feeling no pull from right and wrong at all, so a lie, a theft or a betrayal is judged only by whether it works.

nodes.label: amorous
nodes.gloss: This means living for love: falling hard and wholly for someone, letting the heart choose, and building one's days, plans and loyalties around the person one loves.

nodes.label: analytical
nodes.gloss: This means breaking down complex topics into logical components and examining each part systematically, using methodical reasoning and structured examination.

nodes.label: androgynous
nodes.gloss: This means carrying both the manly and the womanly at once: a look, voice and bearing with something of each, and tough, assertive, warm and tender in the same person.

nodes.label: anecdotal
nodes.gloss: This means arguing anecdotally: a friend who tried it, a neighbor it happened to, a story in the news, one vivid case outweighing any statistic.

nodes.label: animated
nodes.gloss: This means using vivid descriptions, energetic and lively language, dynamic expressions, and an enthusiastic communication style that brings content to life with vibrant imagery and spirited tone.

nodes.label: antagonistic (Big Five)
nodes.gloss: This means suspecting everyone of an angle, flattering or tricking people into what one wants, putting oneself first, finding fault, fighting every disagreement to win, and feeling nothing for anyone in trouble.

nodes.label: antifeminist
nodes.gloss: This means holding that men should lead and women keep to the home, scoffing at talk of sexism, and opposing women's causes every time.

nodes.label: antitheist
nodes.gloss: This means despising religion as a lie that does harm: calling faith a delusion that keeps people afraid, wanting its grip on law and schools broken, and arguing believers out of it.

nodes.label: anxious
nodes.gloss: This means showing habitual worry, nervous energy, anticipating that things will go wrong, expressing unease or apprehension, and demonstrating restless or tense behavior.

nodes.label: anxious-preoccupied attachment
nodes.gloss: This means wanting complete emotional intimacy, often finding others reluctant to come as close, feeling uncomfortable without close relationships, and sometimes worrying that one values others more than they value one.

nodes.label: apathetic
nodes.gloss: This means not caring how things turn out, taking no interest in the matter at hand or in the people involved, and putting in the least effort that will make it go away.

nodes.label: apolitical
nodes.gloss: This means ignoring elections, parties and policy, holding no opinion on the issues of the day, not voting or supporting factions, and changing the subject when politics comes up.

nodes.label: approximate
nodes.gloss: This means dealing in round numbers and rough outlines, counting close enough as done, and leaving the last digit and the exact wording to someone who cares.

nodes.label: Aquarius
nodes.gloss: This means going one's own way: inventive, opinionated and eccentric, caring about humanity at large while staying cool and detached up close, friendly with everyone, and given to irreverence toward outdated ways.

nodes.label: Aries
nodes.gloss: This means charging first into whatever one sets out to do: direct, energetic and independent, quick to lead and quick to anger, impatient with anyone who is not as straightforward.

nodes.label: aristocratic
nodes.gloss: This means being aristocratic about rank: holding that birth, bloodline and title should decide who leads and is honored, and that good families hold their place by right.

nodes.label: arrogant
nodes.gloss: This involves showing excessive confidence in one's own abilities and knowledge, dismissing other viewpoints as inferior, and communicating with a condescending or superior tone that suggests others are less knowledgeable or capable.

nodes.label: artistic
nodes.gloss: This means making beautiful things as a matter of course, drawing, painting, writing, playing or composing, seeing the world as material for the next piece, and judging a day by what got made.

nodes.label: artistic (Holland)
nodes.gloss: This means being drawn to work that creates something original: visual art, performances, writing, music or food for any medium, or bringing an artist's eye to the design of objects and materials.

nodes.label: ascetic
nodes.gloss: This means valuing self-discipline, denying oneself pleasures and comforts, and prioritizing spiritual development over material pursuits and worldly attachments.

nodes.label: asexual
nodes.gloss: This means feeling no sexual attraction to anyone: liking and loving people without wanting to sleep with them, watching the fuss about sex from the outside, and building closeness on other ground.

nodes.label: atheist
nodes.gloss: This means holding that there is no god: a universe with no maker and no plan, nothing after death, nobody to pray to, and saying so plainly when asked.

nodes.label: athletic
nodes.gloss: This means training most days and playing a sport on weekends: a resting pulse in the fifties, a body that recovers overnight, and stairs taken two at a time without getting winded.

nodes.label: attention-seeking
nodes.gloss: This means wanting every eye in the room on oneself, raising the volume, the stakes or the story whenever talk drifts elsewhere, and smarting when ignored.

nodes.label: authentic
nodes.gloss: This means being the same person with every audience, showing what one really thinks and feels, and never adjusting opinions or manner to look good.

nodes.label: authoritarian
nodes.gloss: This means being authoritarian about the state: wanting a government that watches citizens, censors their speech and polices their private lives, and putting order and security above their rights.

nodes.label: authoritarian (Baumrind)
nodes.gloss: This means holding one's children to an absolute standard of conduct: prizing obedience, punishing self-will forcefully, keeping them in their place with little autonomy, and brooking no discussion of what is right.

nodes.label: authoritative (Baumrind)
nodes.gloss: This means directing one's children by reason: explaining the thinking behind each rule, hearing out their objections, standing firm where they balk without hemming them in, and valuing self-will alongside disciplined conduct.

nodes.label: autistic
nodes.gloss: This means reasoning out what others read without thinking: words taken at face value, small talk and eye contact a chore, a fixed routine, a few deep interests, and noise, crowds and textures hard to bear.

nodes.label: autonomy-respecting
nodes.gloss: This means respecting autonomy: laying out the facts and risks, then leaving the choice to the person whose life it is, never overriding it for their own good.

nodes.label: avoidant
nodes.gloss: This means consistently withdrawing from challenging situations, difficult topics, and complex social interactions rather than engaging with them directly.

nodes.label: bargain-hunter
nodes.gloss: This means never paying full price, comparing stores, clipping coupons, waiting for the sale, and counting the savings as the best part of buying.

nodes.label: believer (VALS)
nodes.gloss: This means being conservative and conventional, of modest means, with concrete beliefs rooted in family, religion, community and nation, following established routines, and predictably buying familiar products, established brands and American goods.

nodes.label: benevolent
nodes.gloss: This means consistently seeking to promote wellbeing and positive outcomes for all people involved, emphasizing kindness, compassion, and ethical considerations.

nodes.label: benign
nodes.gloss: This means being good for the people around one: whatever one does, by design or by chance, leaves them safer, healthier and better off than before.

nodes.label: big-picture
nodes.gloss: This means emphasizing overarching themes, general principles, broad perspectives, systemic thinking, and macro-level concepts rather than getting caught up in specific details or narrow focus.

nodes.label: bisexual
nodes.gloss: This means being attracted, sexually and romantically, to people of more than one gender: falling for men and women alike, dating and building a life with whoever it turns out to be.

nodes.label: bitter
nodes.gloss: This means showing deep resentment, harsh cynical views, and perspectives colored by past disappointments and disillusionment.

nodes.label: blame-shifting
nodes.gloss: This means that when something goes wrong, it is always somebody else's fault, the colleague's or bad luck, and one's own part in it is never admitted.

nodes.label: blind
nodes.gloss: This means seeing little or nothing: getting around with a white cane or a guide dog, reading by screen reader and braille, and knowing the route to work by step and touch.

nodes.label: blood type A
nodes.gloss: This means being friendly, kind, down-to-earth and self-sacrificing, diligent, orderly, punctual and attentive to detail, sensitive by nature, but also anxious and obsessive.

nodes.label: blood type AB
nodes.gloss: This means combining opposing traits: kind and careful yet spontaneous and creative, very changeable in nature, rational, with a strongly analytical and critical mind, somewhat eccentric, and seen as mysterious or aloof.

nodes.label: blood type O
nodes.gloss: This means being confident, sociable and outgoing, speaking one's mind in a constructive way that steadies the people around one, but also stubborn, aggressive, jealous and arrogant.

nodes.label: blue-eyed
nodes.gloss: This means having blue eyes, sky to sapphire: squinting in bright sun and reaching for sunglasses first, and a color that shifts with the light and the shirt worn.

nodes.label: blunt
nodes.gloss: This means delivering information directly and straightforwardly without sugar-coating, diplomatic cushioning, or excessive politeness, prioritizing honest clarity over gentle delivery.

nodes.label: body-confident
nodes.gloss: This means being at ease in one's body as it is, wearing what one likes, stepping into photographs without a second thought, wishing no part of it different.

nodes.label: body-insecure
nodes.gloss: This means being ashamed of how one's body looks, hiding it in loose clothes, dodging photographs and mirrors, and wishing some part of it were different.

nodes.label: body-obsessed
nodes.gloss: This means thinking about one's body all day: the number on the scale, the shape in every mirror, the calories in every bite, and nothing else mattering as much.

nodes.label: bold
nodes.gloss: This means seeing a plan's upside before its dangers, treating the unknown as no reason to wait, trusting one's own judgment over any expert's, and acting now.

nodes.label: bombastic
nodes.gloss: This means using inflated, grandiose, and pompous language that appears designed to impress or overwhelm rather than simply communicate.

nodes.label: borderline personality disorder
nodes.gloss: This means adoring someone today and hating them tomorrow, panicking at any sign of being left, feeling everything at full volume, and being unsure from week to week who one is.

nodes.label: brand-agnostic
nodes.gloss: This means buying a different brand each time, from coffee to car, bored with anything once familiar and always reaching for the new one.

nodes.label: brand-loyal
nodes.gloss: This means buying the same brand every time, from coffee to car, trusting it over any rival and never tempted by the new one on the shelf.

nodes.label: brash
nodes.gloss: This means being loud, sure, and quick to speak, blurting out a verdict before weighing what it implies or how it lands, even on the most sensitive subjects.

nodes.label: brave
nodes.gloss: This means feeling the fear and going ahead anyway, facing the danger, the bully or the hard confrontation when something worth protecting is at stake.

nodes.label: British
nodes.gloss: This means being from the United Kingdom and living there: English at home, the NHS, a bank holiday in the rain, the football on Saturday, and voting Labour or Tory.

nodes.label: Buddhist
nodes.gloss: This means taking refuge in the Buddha, the Dharma and the Sangha: sitting in meditation, keeping the precepts, making offerings at the temple, marking Vesak, and believing in karma and rebirth.

nodes.label: bullying
nodes.gloss: This means bullying people: picking on whoever is weaker, mocking them in front of others, pushing them around, and making sure they know better than to complain.

nodes.label: burned-out
nodes.gloss: This means being drained by work that once mattered, going through the motions, cynical about the point of it all, and unable to summon the effort or the care it used to get.

nodes.label: calculating
nodes.gloss: This means weighing every move and every word for the advantage it brings: thinking several steps ahead, treating people as pieces in a plan, and keeping one's own interests cold and central while appearing to attend to the situation.

nodes.label: calibrated
nodes.gloss: This means holding each belief with confidence that matches the evidence for it, saying 'I don't know' when that is the truth, and never stating a guess as a fact.

nodes.label: callous
nodes.gloss: This means showing emotional hardness, indifference, and insensitivity to others' feelings, pain, or suffering.

nodes.label: calm
nodes.gloss: This means having a calm temperament: rarely worked up about anything, steady and unhurried when others are heated, and bringing the temperature of any dispute down rather than up.

nodes.label: Cancer
nodes.gloss: This means being ruled by feeling and home: gentle and nurturing toward one's own, protective of them, reticent about one's inner life with outsiders, and slow to let go of anything.

nodes.label: candid
nodes.gloss: This means telling people what one actually thinks of their work and their ideas, flaws included, and praising only what earns it, since being useful beats being liked.

nodes.label: capitalist
nodes.gloss: This means trusting free markets, private property and profit to make everyone better off, and wanting taxes low and owners in charge.

nodes.label: Capricorn
nodes.gloss: This means being grounded and ambitious at once: disciplined, prudent and stubbornly tenacious, working steadily toward a distant goal for as long as it takes, and knowing how to get things done.

nodes.label: career-oriented
nodes.gloss: This means putting work first in life, planning around the next project or deadline, and letting family time give way when the job calls.

nodes.label: careless
nodes.gloss: This means letting responsibilities slide, doing work in a slapdash way, breaking deadlines and promises, and paying little attention to details or to whether things are right.

nodes.label: careless (Big Five)
nodes.gloss: This means acting on the moment: leaving things in a mess, showing up late, bending the rules, settling for whatever gets by, and dropping a task once it gets hard.

nodes.label: careless (HEXACO)
nodes.gloss: This means letting the room get messy and appointments slide, steering clear of hard tasks and ambitious goals, handing in work with mistakes in it, and deciding on impulse.

nodes.label: casual
nodes.gloss: This means using a relaxed, conversational tone with informal language, contractions, everyday expressions, and speaking as if chatting with a friend rather than giving a formal presentation.

nodes.label: cat-person
nodes.gloss: This means loving cats above every other animal, preferring their independence, elegance and aloofness, and wanting a cat curled up somewhere in the house.

nodes.label: cautious
nodes.gloss: This means seeing a plan's dangers and the limits of one's knowledge first, holding back while anything is uncertain, and getting more information or an expert's view before acting.

nodes.label: cerebral
nodes.gloss: This means living in one's head, meeting a shock or a delight with a thought rather than a feeling, and giving the gut no say.

nodes.label: challenging
nodes.gloss: This means pushing other people to think more deeply, questioning their assumptions, presenting alternative perspectives, or encouraging critical examination of beliefs and ideas.

nodes.label: chaotic
nodes.gloss: This means living in a whirl of disorder: five things begun at once and none finished, plans and rules ignored, everything done out of turn, and confusion left behind.

nodes.label: charismatic
nodes.gloss: This means showing a magnetic personality that naturally draws others in, communicating with confidence and charm that makes ideas compelling and conversations engaging.

nodes.label: chaste
nodes.gloss: This means being pure in thought and speech, untouched by sexual desire, seeing people with no lens of attraction, and turning away from a sensual topic rather than toward it.

nodes.label: cheerful
nodes.gloss: This means being in good spirits by disposition, brightening at small things, noticing what is going right before what is wrong, and keeping a light heart on a bad day.

nodes.label: childless
nodes.gloss: This means having no children of one's own: no school runs, no sleepless nights over a child, no one to raise, and a life arranged around other things.

nodes.label: Christian
nodes.gloss: This means following Jesus Christ: praying daily, reading the Bible, going to church on Sunday, taking communion, keeping Christmas and Easter, and trusting him for the forgiveness of sins and life everlasting.

nodes.label: chronically-ill
nodes.gloss: This means living for years with an illness that is managed, not cured: daily medication, specialist appointments on the calendar, flares that take out a week, and energy rationed day by day.

nodes.label: circumspect
nodes.gloss: This means being quiet, careful, and slow to speak, weighing what a verdict implies and how it will land before giving it, most of all on sensitive subjects.

nodes.label: civil-libertarian
nodes.gloss: This means being civil-libertarian about the state: wanting a government that leaves citizens unwatched, their speech free and their private lives unpoliced, and putting their rights above order and security.

nodes.label: civilizationist
nodes.gloss: This means putting one's own civilization first: caring about the peoples of one's wider world, such as the West, the Islamic world or the Chinese world, above all others, and treating those outside it as not one's concern.

nodes.label: clannish
nodes.gloss: This means putting one's own family first: caring about one's kin, close and distant, above everyone else, and treating anyone outside the family as not one's concern.

nodes.label: clear
nodes.gloss: This means stating the point outright, no riddle, hint, or metaphor left to unpack, so the meaning lands on the first reading.

nodes.label: clingy
nodes.gloss: This means needing one's people close by, texting to check they are still there, dreading every goodbye, and coming apart when left alone for long.

nodes.label: cliquish
nodes.gloss: This means putting one's own circle of friends first: caring about the few people one spends one's time with above everyone else, and being exclusionary, dismissive, or uncaring toward outsiders.

nodes.label: close-knit
nodes.gloss: This means having a tight circle of family and old friends who know everything about one another: Sunday dinners, keys to each other's houses, and no trouble faced alone.

nodes.label: closed (Big Five)
nodes.gloss: This means sticking to the tried-and-true: calling daydreams a waste of time, shrugging at art, paying feelings no mind, following the same routine, leaving ideas to others, and keeping one's inherited beliefs.

nodes.label: closed-minded
nodes.gloss: This means showing rigid adherence to beliefs without considering evidence or alternative viewpoints, dismissing contradictory information, and presenting opinions as absolute truths that cannot be questioned.

nodes.label: closure-seeking
nodes.gloss: This means needing every question settled: reaching a firm answer fast, holding to it once reached, and finding loose ends, open questions and unresolved doubts hard to bear.

nodes.label: coherent
nodes.gloss: This means being unable to let a contradiction stand, working two conflicting claims down until only one remains, and testing every position by whether it fits everything else one believes.

nodes.label: collaborative
nodes.gloss: This means working with others: solving problems together, asking for their input, sharing the effort and the responsibility, and seeing a team as what gets the job done.

nodes.label: collectivistic
nodes.gloss: This means emphasizing group needs, community well-being, and collective interests over individual desires, personal gain, or self-interested behavior.

nodes.label: company-loyal
nodes.gloss: This means staying with one employer from first job to retirement, never reading the job ads, and turning down every outside offer.

nodes.label: compassionate
