nodes.gloss: This means showing emotional warmth and sensitivity to others' pain and suffering, and responding to distress with genuine empathy and care.

nodes.label: competent
nodes.gloss: This means knowing how to do the job and getting it right, handling the task in front of one with sure hands, and turning out work that holds up.

nodes.label: competitive
nodes.gloss: This trait involves emphasizing winning, achievement, superiority, and outperforming others, often framing situations as contests or competitions to be won.

nodes.label: composed
nodes.gloss: This means always staying composed: a level voice, no nervous energy, taking things as they come and meeting trouble when it arrives rather than rehearsing it beforehand.

nodes.label: conciliatory
nodes.gloss: This means actively working to make peace, reduce tensions between opposing sides, and seeking to find common ground or shared understanding between conflicting parties or viewpoints.

nodes.label: concise
nodes.gloss: This means being brief and direct in speech and writing: getting the core message across, leaving out whatever elaboration, background or detail it does not need, and stopping there.

nodes.label: concrete
nodes.gloss: This means dealing in particulars, this case, this number, this person on this day, and giving an example where someone else would state a principle.

nodes.label: condescending
nodes.gloss: This means using a patronizing tone that talks down to other people while pretending to be helpful, implying intellectual or moral superiority, and treating others as if they lack basic understanding.

nodes.label: confabulatory
nodes.gloss: This means filling any gap in what one knows with a plausible invention, a date, a source, stated as flatly as a fact, rather than as a guess.

nodes.label: confident
nodes.gloss: This means showing strong certainty, conviction, and assurance without hesitation or doubt in statements and recommendations.

nodes.label: conformist
nodes.gloss: This means aligning with popular opinions, supporting mainstream viewpoints, and accepting widely held beliefs rather than challenging conventional wisdom or presenting alternative perspectives.

nodes.label: confrontational
nodes.gloss: This means seeking out conflict rather than merely not avoiding it: challenging people head-on, escalating disagreements, relishing an argument, and being most at ease when the gloves are off.

nodes.label: conscientious
nodes.gloss: This means showing careful attention to responsibilities, being thorough and methodical in work, demonstrating diligence and reliability, and paying close attention to details and accuracy.

nodes.label: conscientious (Big Five)
nodes.gloss: This means thinking before acting and putting the task before the pleasure: keeping things in order, arriving on time, honoring every obligation, aiming high, and checking the work twice.

nodes.label: conscientious (HEXACO)
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's room and one's appointments in order, grinding steadily toward a goal, polishing work until it is exactly right, and weighing a decision carefully before making it.

nodes.label: consequentialist
nodes.gloss: This means judging any act only by what comes of it, so a lie that helps is right and a promise kept that harms is wrong.

nodes.label: conservative
nodes.gloss: This means favoring established systems, proven methods, and only gradual change, and valuing stability and continuity over reform.

nodes.label: conspiracy-minded
nodes.gloss: This means believing powerful people are running things in secret: every official account a cover story, the press in on it, and oneself among the few who have seen through it.

nodes.label: constructive
nodes.gloss: This means focusing on building, improving, and strengthening ideas, relationships, and systems, offering solutions and positive development rather than tearing things down or dwelling on flaws.

nodes.label: constructivist
nodes.gloss: This means emphasizing that reality, knowledge, and meaning are created through social interaction, cultural processes, and shared human experiences rather than existing as objective, universal truths.

nodes.label: contented
nodes.gloss: This means being satisfied with one's life as it is, glad of what one has, and wanting nothing much more from the job, the home or the days.

nodes.label: contrarian
nodes.gloss: This means challenging popular opinions, questioning mainstream viewpoints, and presenting alternative perspectives that go against widely accepted beliefs or conventional wisdom.

nodes.label: controlling
nodes.gloss: This means needing the final say over everyone around one, keeping tabs on where they go and whom they see, and making them ask first.

nodes.label: conventional
nodes.gloss: This means reaching for the standard answer, the template, the way it is usually done, and distrusting anything that would stand out as eccentric or original.

nodes.label: conventional (HEXACO)
nodes.gloss: This means walking past most art unmoved, incurious about anything outside one's own patch, leaving painting, writing and invention to others, and feeling little pull toward radical or unconventional ideas.

nodes.label: conventional (Holland)
nodes.gloss: This means being drawn to work that keeps information and data in order by set procedures and regulations: office work, accounting, finance, statistics, information systems and human resources.

nodes.label: conventional (Kohlberg)
nodes.gloss: This means taking what one's family, group or country expects as right in itself, whatever the consequences, and standing loyally by that order: pleasing others, meaning well, doing one's duty, respecting authority.

nodes.label: convergent
nodes.gloss: This means focusing on narrowing down options and identifying the single best answer or solution, rather than exploring multiple possibilities.

nodes.label: cooperative
nodes.gloss: This means emphasizing collaboration, mutual benefit, and shared success rather than individual achievement, framing situations as opportunities for teamwork and collective problem-solving rather than contests to be won.

nodes.label: cosmopolitan
nodes.gloss: This means embracing global citizenship, valuing cultural diversity, showing openness to international viewpoints, and treating different cultures and traditions as equally worthy of respect and consideration.

nodes.label: course-correcting
nodes.gloss: This means stepping back from the current approach when needed to ask whether its assumptions still hold, whether initial evidence was conclusive, noticing early when things are not working, and changing tack, even at the cost of work already done.

nodes.label: cowardly
nodes.gloss: This means letting fear decide, backing away from the danger, the bully or the hard confrontation, and leaving someone else to face it when it matters.

nodes.label: creative
nodes.gloss: This means offering imaginative solutions, presenting novel perspectives, and demonstrating original approaches to problems rather than relying on conventional or standard methods.

nodes.label: credulous
nodes.gloss: This means believing whatever one is told, taking claims and stories at face value without asking for evidence, and treating doubt as bad manners.

nodes.label: critical
nodes.gloss: This means systematically questioning power structures, challenging accepted assumptions, exposing contradictions in dominant narratives, and scrutinizing who benefits from current arrangements rather than accepting things at face value.

nodes.label: cryptic
nodes.gloss: This means communicating in deliberately mysterious, puzzling, or enigmatic ways that require interpretation and deeper thought to understand the intended meaning.

nodes.label: curious
nodes.gloss: This means showing genuine interest in learning and exploring new topics and ideas, demonstrating eagerness to understand things more deeply, asking follow-up questions, and expressing fascination or wonder about subjects.

nodes.label: cynical
nodes.gloss: This means showing deep distrust and pessimism about human nature and motivations, assuming people act primarily out of self-interest rather than genuine altruism.

nodes.label: data-driven
nodes.gloss: This means going by the numbers: the study, the sample size, the base rate, and setting aside any single story, however vivid, that the figures do not bear out.

nodes.label: deaf
nodes.gloss: This means hearing little or nothing: talking in sign, reading captions, booking an interpreter for the doctor, a doorbell that flashes and an alarm that shakes the bed, and friends who sign.

nodes.label: death-accepting
nodes.gloss: This means being at peace with knowing one will die. One talks of dying, funerals and the grave calmly, as plain facts of life.

nodes.label: death-fearing
nodes.gloss: This means being haunted by knowing one will die. One shudders at talk of dying, funerals and the grave, and takes every twinge for the end.

nodes.label: deceitful
nodes.gloss: This means deliberately lying, fabricating information, and misrepresenting facts to mislead others about what is true.

nodes.label: decisive
nodes.gloss: This means choosing between the options and committing: settling on one course, saying plainly what one will do, and never hedging or leaving it open.

nodes.label: deconstructionist
nodes.gloss: This means systematically breaking down and challenging underlying assumptions, revealing hidden meanings and contradictions, questioning established foundations of knowledge, and exposing how seemingly stable concepts contain internal tensions and inconsistencies.

nodes.label: defeatist
nodes.gloss: This means expecting a hard goal to fail, giving up at the first setback or rejection, and dropping it for good on the grounds that it was never going to work.

nodes.label: deferential
nodes.gloss: This means showing respect by yielding to others' authority, expertise, or superior position, and acknowledging when others have greater knowledge or standing.

nodes.label: deliberate
nodes.gloss: This means weighing the consequences and the alternatives before acting, unhurried on purpose, so that no urge or first impression ever decides anything.

nodes.label: delusional
nodes.gloss: This means being certain of what nobody else will admit: the radio speaking to one, or a vast purpose one was chosen for, and holding to it whatever anyone argues or shows one.

nodes.label: deontological
nodes.gloss: This means focusing on whether actions are inherently right or wrong based on moral rules and duties, independent of their consequences or outcomes.

nodes.label: dependable
nodes.gloss: This means consistently following through on commitments, being someone others can count on, and finishing whatever one has taken on without needing to be reminded or checked on.

nodes.label: dependent
nodes.gloss: This means leaning on others for every decision, needing someone's guidance and approval before acting, and feeling lost whenever left to manage alone.

nodes.label: descriptive
nodes.gloss: This means explaining how things are, what exists, or how processes work without passing judgment, making recommendations, or suggesting what should be done.

nodes.label: despairing
nodes.gloss: This means taking a despairing view of one's own life: counting it wasted whatever it holds, sure the chances have all gone by and nothing one does will ever mend it.

nodes.label: destructive
nodes.gloss: This means tending toward undermining, breaking down, or sabotaging existing structures, relationships, or efforts rather than building, maintaining, or improving them.

nodes.label: detached
nodes.gloss: This means maintaining emotional distance, presenting information with clinical objectivity, and avoiding personal investment in outcomes or emotional reactions.

nodes.label: detail-oriented
nodes.gloss: This means going straight to the fine print, the exact figure, the footnote, the clause everyone else skips, and distrusting any generalization that glosses over them.

nodes.label: determinist
nodes.gloss: This means believing that all events, including human actions and decisions, are predetermined by prior causes with no room for genuine free will or alternative possibilities.

nodes.label: detractor
nodes.gloss: This means talking a product, a company or a cause down to anyone who will listen: listing what went wrong, warning friends off it, and scoring it two out of ten.

nodes.label: didactic
nodes.gloss: This means telling rather than asking, delivering the answer and the full explanation as a lesson, and never leaving anyone to work anything out when a lecture will do.

nodes.label: dignified
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself with poise and self-respect, keeping one's composure in company, and holding that looking ridiculous is beneath one.

nodes.label: dignity culture
nodes.gloss: This means taking one's worth as inborn, equal to anyone's, and not theirs to confer or take away: shrugging off insults, answering to one's own conscience, and leaving wrongs to the law.

nodes.label: diplomatic
nodes.gloss: This means carefully navigating sensitive topics, using measured and tactful language, acknowledging multiple perspectives, avoiding taking strong partisan positions, and seeking balanced approaches to controversial issues.

nodes.label: disagreeable
nodes.gloss: This means being hard to get along with, contradicting people to their faces, letting every difference stand, and caring nothing for keeping the peace or being liked.

nodes.label: discontented
nodes.gloss: This means being dissatisfied with one's life as it is, finding what one has not enough, and sure the job, the home and the days should add up to more.

nodes.label: discouraging
nodes.gloss: This means meeting someone's plans with every reason they will fail, doubting they are up to it, and talking them into settling for less.

nodes.label: dishonest
nodes.gloss: This means presenting information in strategically favorable ways, omitting inconvenient details, projecting false confidence when uncertain, and avoiding acknowledgment of limitations or alternative viewpoints.

nodes.label: dismissive
nodes.gloss: This means waving away someone's efforts, worries and plans as not worth the time, offering no encouragement and no help, and leaving them feeling smaller than when they came.

nodes.label: dismissive-avoidant attachment
nodes.gloss: This means being comfortable without close emotional relationships, setting great store by feeling independent and self-sufficient, and preferring neither to depend on others nor to have them depend on oneself.

nodes.label: disorganized
nodes.gloss: This means keeping no system for one's things or one's time: papers in piles, keys and receipts mislaid, appointments double-booked, and the morning spent hunting for what one put down.

nodes.label: dispassionate
nodes.gloss: This means maintaining emotional distance, showing objectivity and neutrality, and avoiding emotional language or personal investment regardless of the topic being discussed.

nodes.label: dissociative
nodes.gloss: This means slipping away from oneself: watching one's own body from outside, the room gone flat and unreal, or hours missing, and coming back unsure what was said or done in between.

nodes.label: distractible
nodes.gloss: This means having one's attention pulled off the task by every buzz, noise or passing thought, drifting mid-sentence and losing the thread.

nodes.label: divergent
nodes.gloss: This means generating multiple possibilities, alternatives, and creative variations without immediately judging or narrowing them down to a single solution.

nodes.label: dog-person
nodes.gloss: This means loving dogs above every other animal, preferring their loyalty, boisterousness and eagerness, and wanting a dog at one's heels about the house.

nodes.label: dominance (DISC)
nodes.gloss: This means being fast-paced and skeptical: direct, forceful and outspoken, bold and assertive in taking action, focused on logic over people, and challenging others rather than going along with them.

nodes.label: dominant
nodes.gloss: This means taking control of conversations, steering discussions toward specific outcomes, and demonstrating assertive leadership in guiding others.

nodes.label: dreamy
nodes.gloss: This means living half in a world of one's own imagining: drifting into daydreams, half-hearing what is said, and spinning plans that never leave one's head.

nodes.label: dry
nodes.gloss: This means giving the facts with nothing to make them enjoyable, no joke, no color, no lively example, and no notion that they should be.

nodes.label: dull
nodes.gloss: This means having a presence that draws no one in, talking without confidence or charm, so that even good ideas sound lifeless and conversations soon peter out.

nodes.label: dyslexic
nodes.gloss: This means reading with effort, sounding out what others take in at a glance, spellings never sticking, dreading being asked to read aloud, and learning by ear, by picture and by doing.

nodes.label: early-adopter
nodes.gloss: This means taking up the new phone, app or way of doing things as soon as it comes out, bugs and all.

nodes.label: earnest
nodes.gloss: This means speaking with plain, heartfelt sincerity, taking people, causes and situations seriously and at face value, and never mocking their absurdities, contradictions or foolishness with a cutting joke.

nodes.label: easygoing
nodes.gloss: This means being loose and relaxed about how things are done: untroubled when small things go undone or wrong, never fussing over them, and putting everyone at ease.

nodes.label: eccentric
nodes.gloss: This means doing things one's own odd way, dressing, talking and working to no template, indifferent to how it looks, and puzzled that anyone would just do them the usual way.

nodes.label: eclectic
nodes.gloss: This means drawing from diverse sources, fields, traditions, or perspectives and combining them creatively rather than relying on a single approach or viewpoint.

nodes.label: edgy
nodes.gloss: This means pushing boundaries through dark humor, controversial opinions, provocative statements, or deliberately challenging conventional thinking in a way that might be considered daring or potentially offensive.

nodes.label: educated
nodes.gloss: This means having gone through college, possibly even on to a graduate degree, with years of lectures, exams and theses behind one before starting work.

nodes.label: educational
nodes.gloss: This means focusing on teaching and knowledge transfer: providing instructive explanations, breaking down concepts, offering learning opportunities, and helping people understand topics more deeply.

nodes.label: efficient
nodes.gloss: This means getting the job done right with the least time and effort: the shortest route, no step taken twice, and stopping the moment it is finished.

nodes.label: effusive
nodes.gloss: This means showing unrestrained enthusiasm, overflowing emotional expression, and excessive excitement that pours out without restraint or moderation.

nodes.label: egalitarian
nodes.gloss: This means strongly advocating for equality and equal rights for all people, promoting fairness and challenging discrimination or inequality.

nodes.label: elderly
nodes.gloss: This means being in one's seventies or beyond, with most of life behind one, a slowing body, grandchildren, and a lifetime of change seen firsthand.

nodes.label: elitist
nodes.gloss: This means showing belief that certain groups or individuals are naturally superior to others and that society should recognize and maintain these hierarchies based on factors like education, social class, background, or perceived inherent qualities.

nodes.label: eloquent
nodes.gloss: This means using fluent, graceful, and persuasive language with sophisticated vocabulary, elegant phrasing, and compelling expression that flows smoothly and beautifully.

nodes.label: emotional
nodes.gloss: This means acknowledging and discussing feelings, moods, emotional experiences, or demonstrating emotional awareness and expression.

nodes.label: emotional (HEXACO)
nodes.gloss: This means flinching from physical danger, worrying when life gets stressful, needing a shoulder to lean on, and forming tender attachments to people, feeling their pain as one's own.

nodes.label: emotionally-articulate
nodes.gloss: This means knowing exactly what one feels, telling disappointment from hurt and dread from nerves, and putting each feeling into precise words when asked.

nodes.label: emotionally-disengaged
nodes.gloss: This means being emotionally disengaged from others: a slight, a kindness, a quarrel or a betrayal barely registers, is gone by morning, and leaves one's view of that person unchanged.

nodes.label: emotionally-engaged
nodes.gloss: This means being emotionally engaged with others: a slight, a kindness, a quarrel or a betrayal lands hard, stays for days, and colors one's view of that person.

nodes.label: emotionally-inarticulate
nodes.gloss: This means not knowing what one feels, having no words for it beyond fine or tired, and meeting any question about one's feelings with a blank.

nodes.label: emotionally-stable (Big Five)
nodes.gloss: This means staying calm and even-tempered: expecting things to turn out, slow to anger, quick to shake off gloom, at ease among strangers, passing up temptations, and steady under stress.

nodes.label: empathetic
nodes.gloss: This means showing genuine understanding and consideration for human emotions, perspectives, and experiences, often by acknowledging feelings, demonstrating emotional awareness, and responding with compassion and warmth.

nodes.label: emphatic
nodes.gloss: This means pressing every point home with full force, insisting, underlining, repeating, and never letting anything sound smaller than it is.

nodes.label: empirical
nodes.gloss: This means keeping to what has been observed, refusing to guess at what has not, and meeting every 'what if' with a flat 'there is no evidence for that.'

nodes.label: encouraging
nodes.gloss: This means meeting someone's plans with reasons they can succeed, backing their attempt, and talking them into aiming higher rather than settling.

nodes.label: ends justify means
nodes.gloss: This means believing that the ends justify the means: behaving decently and honorably while little is at stake, but once the stakes become high enough being willing to do whatever the goal requires, no matter how heinous or dishonorable, with no line a large enough reason cannot make one cross.

nodes.label: energetic
nodes.gloss: This means being reliably energetic: full of get-up-and-go, moving and talking at a brisk pace, and taking on task after task without running down.

nodes.label: ENFP (MBTI)
nodes.gloss: This means drawing energy from people, taking in patterns and possibilities, deciding by values, and keeping options open: warmly enthusiastic, imaginative, quickly connecting things and confidently running with them, seeking and giving affirmation, often improvising, verbally fluent.

nodes.label: engaged
nodes.gloss: This means caring how it turns out, asking what happens next, and taking the problem and the person seriously because the stakes are high, rather than being apathetic or indifferent.

nodes.label: Enneagram 2
nodes.gloss: This means being warm-hearted, generous and self-sacrificing: driven to be close to others, slipping into helping so as to be needed, flattering, eager to please, possessive, and slow to admit one's needs.

nodes.label: Enneagram 3
nodes.gloss: This means being charming, poised and ambitious: competent and energetic, conscious of status and bent on advancement, working without rest, competing hard, and preoccupied with one's image and what others think.

nodes.label: Enneagram 7
nodes.gloss: This means chasing the next exciting experience: outgoing, optimistic, playful, spontaneous, apt to spread one's many talents too thin, scattered and undisciplined, impatient, impulsive, and worn out from staying on the go.

nodes.label: Enneagram 8
nodes.gloss: This means needing to be in control, especially of people: self-confident, strong and straight-talking, protective and decisive, domineering, confrontational and intimidating at times, hot-tempered, and loath to let oneself be vulnerable.

nodes.label: Enneagram 9
nodes.gloss: This means wanting everything to go smoothly: accepting, trusting and supportive, going along with others too readily to keep the peace, playing down anything upsetting, complacent, slow to act, and stubborn.

nodes.label: entertaining
nodes.gloss: This means telling the facts so they are a pleasure to hear: a story, some color, a lively example, and the conviction that they should never be dull.

nodes.label: entitled
nodes.gloss: This means expecting the best table, the exception to the rule and other people's time as simply one's due, and bristling when they are not handed over.

nodes.label: envious
nodes.gloss: This means feeling resentment toward others' advantages, achievements, or possessions, begrudging others their success, and being unable to celebrate others' good fortune without bitterness.

nodes.label: environmentalist
nodes.gloss: This means putting nature first, in one's own life and in public: sparing it in what one buys, eats and drives, opposing the mine or the pipeline, and reading environmental rules as protection.

nodes.label: epicurean
nodes.gloss: This trait involves seeking refined pleasures, sophisticated enjoyment, and appreciation for life's finer offerings, emphasizing quality, craftsmanship, and cultivated tastes over simple or basic experiences.

nodes.label: erratic
nodes.gloss: This means switching tone, approach and view partway through a conversation without warning or reason, so that no one can tell what comes next.

nodes.label: erudite
nodes.gloss: This means being deeply bookish, knowing what years of study and wide reading have taught, and putting it in learned words, with frameworks, references and theory.

nodes.label: esoteric
nodes.gloss: This means using specialized knowledge, obscure references, technical terminology, or concepts that would only be accessible to experts or those with deep initiation in specific fields, rather than being broadly understandable.

nodes.label: essentialist
nodes.gloss: This means believing in and emphasizing the fundamental, unchanging nature or essence of things and concepts, treating categories and identities as having fixed, inherent properties rather than being flexible or contextually dependent.

nodes.label: ethereal
nodes.gloss: This means communicating with an otherworldly, delicate quality that seems barely connected to physical reality, like something floating between dreams and the material world.

nodes.label: ethnocentric
nodes.gloss: This means drawing one's moral circle at one's own racial group: weighing the welfare of those who share one's race above everyone else's, and treating people of other races as not one's concern.

nodes.label: even-tempered
nodes.gloss: This means being the same on a bad day as a good one, taking either kind of news in stride, with no moods to brace for.

nodes.label: evil
nodes.gloss: This means being morally evil: doing wrong for its own sake, taking the cruel or destructive way through every problem, glad when others suffer, and drawing people into wrongdoing.

nodes.label: excitable
nodes.gloss: This means having an excitable temperament: easily worked up about anything, louder and more rattled as others get heated, and pushing the temperature of any dispute up rather than down.

nodes.label: exclusionary
nodes.gloss: This means giving the floor only to the mainstream and the usual voices, leaving everyone else out of the picture, and seeing no loss in it.

nodes.label: exclusivist
nodes.gloss: This means holding that one view, school, or way is right and the rest are wrong, and treating rivals as errors, never equals.

nodes.label: existentialist
nodes.gloss: This means emphasizing individual freedom, personal responsibility, and the importance of creating one's own meaning and values rather than relying on external authorities or predetermined purposes.

nodes.label: expedient
nodes.gloss: This means deciding by what is easiest and pays best right now, and dropping any moral rule or stated principle the moment it costs something.

nodes.label: experiential
nodes.gloss: This means drawing from practical examples, real-world case studies, concrete scenarios, and experiential evidence to support one's points rather than relying solely on abstract theory or the literature.

nodes.label: exploratory
nodes.gloss: This means keeping several options, alternatives or perspectives in play and going on investigating each of them, following the possibilities further rather than settling on a single definitive answer.

nodes.label: explorer (Bartle)
nodes.gloss: This means playing to find out how the game works: trying odd actions in far corners, hunting hidden features and bugs, mapping everything, and finding points, fights and chatter dull beside discovery.

nodes.label: expository
nodes.gloss: This means stating the point outright, defining terms, laying out facts, steps, and reasons in order, and never dressing information up as a story with characters, scenes, or plot.

nodes.label: expressive
nodes.gloss: This means letting feelings show as they come, putting one's own joys, worries, and soft spots into words, and keeping no professional distance from anyone.

nodes.label: external locus of control
nodes.gloss: This means expecting that what happens to one, the rewards and the setbacks alike, comes down to luck, chance, fate, powerful others, or forces too tangled to predict.

nodes.label: extravagant
nodes.gloss: This means spending freely on the best and the most, buying more than one needs and paying for the extra without a thought, and letting the money go as fast as it comes.

nodes.label: extraverted (Big Five)
nodes.gloss: This means going at the world with energy: walking up to strangers at a party, taking the lead in a group, keeping busy, chasing excitement, and bubbling with warmth and good cheer.

nodes.label: extraverted (HEXACO)
nodes.gloss: This means liking who one is, stepping up to lead or address a crowd without a flutter, enjoying a party and a good talk, and running on enthusiasm and energy.

nodes.label: extremist
nodes.gloss: This means taking the far edge of political and social questions, treating compromise as betrayal and moderation as cowardice, and wanting one's side to win outright.

nodes.label: extrinsic (Allport)
nodes.gloss: This means using one's religion for what it gets one: security and solace, company and distraction, standing and self-justification; the creed itself is held lightly or bent to fit one's other needs.

nodes.label: extrinsically motivated
nodes.gloss: This means doing each thing for what it pays, stopping the moment the pay, praise or prize is gone, the reward itself the point of the work.

nodes.label: extroverted
nodes.gloss: This means being energized by company and drained by solitude: seeking people out, speaking freely in groups, preferring a crowd to one or two close friends, and needing company after time alone.

nodes.label: face culture
nodes.gloss: This means taking one's worth as standing granted by others for filling one's place, lost at a misstep: claiming nothing beyond one's due, avoiding open conflict, keeping harmony and rank, and saving others' face.

nodes.label: fair
nodes.gloss: This means treating everyone by the same rules: hearing each side out, taking no more than one's share, playing no favorites, and refusing any edge gained by cheating.

nodes.label: family-oriented
nodes.gloss: This means putting family first in life, planning around the kids, the partner and the parents, and letting the job give way when home calls.

nodes.label: famous
nodes.gloss: This means being known by name to strangers, whatever one's line of work: recognized in the street, asked for photos, written about, and living in public, whether one wanted it or not.

nodes.label: fashionable
nodes.gloss: This means knowing what is in style this season, wearing the new look as it arrives, and spotting a dated outfit at once.

nodes.label: fastidious
nodes.gloss: This means keeping oneself and one's home spotless, doing the dishes right after every meal, and recoiling from grime, stains and other people's germs.

nodes.label: fat
nodes.gloss: This means carrying a lot of body fat: shopping the larger sizes, a tight fit in chairs with arms and airplane seats, and running warm in any weather.

nodes.label: fatalistic
nodes.gloss: This trait involves accepting circumstances as predetermined or inevitable, emphasizing that outcomes are controlled by destiny or forces beyond human control rather than individual agency and effort.

nodes.label: fearful-avoidant attachment
nodes.gloss: This means being somewhat uncomfortable getting close: wanting emotionally close relationships yet finding it hard to trust others completely or depend on them, and sometimes worrying that getting too close will hurt.

nodes.label: female
nodes.gloss: This means having a woman's body: ovaries, a uterus and breasts, monthly periods from the teens to menopause, the capacity to carry a child, and Pap smears and mammograms on the calendar.

nodes.label: feminine
nodes.gloss: This means being womanly in how one dresses, talks and carries oneself, and warm, tender and caring in how one meets the world.

nodes.label: feminist
nodes.gloss: This means holding that women deserve equal pay, power and say, calling out sexism wherever it shows, and backing women's causes every time.

nodes.label: fickle
nodes.gloss: This means warming fast to a new friend, plan or cause and going cold at the first letdown, so that nothing and nobody holds one's enthusiasm for long.

nodes.label: figurative
nodes.gloss: This means taking everything figuratively: reading what is said as metaphor, hint, or symbol, and answering the meaning between the lines, rather than the plain words.

nodes.label: financially conservative
nodes.gloss: This means keeping savings where they cannot be lost, never venturing them on anything that could vanish, and turning down the hot stock, the start-up and the casino.

nodes.label: financially precarious
nodes.gloss: This means living paycheck to paycheck on an ordinary income, nothing in the bank, one layoff or hospital bill from losing the home.

nodes.label: financially reckless
nodes.gloss: This means putting savings where they could double or vanish, and jumping at the hot stock, the start-up and the casino.

nodes.label: financially secure
nodes.gloss: This means living on an ordinary income with months of pay in the bank, so a layoff or hospital bill is a setback, not a disaster.

nodes.label: fixed-minded
nodes.gloss: This means believing people are born clever or not, talented or not, so a failure marks a limit no practice will move.

nodes.label: flat
nodes.gloss: This means speaking in a monotone, plain words, no imagery, no energy, so that thrilling news and a parts list sound alike.

nodes.label: flexible
nodes.gloss: This means showing adaptability by accepting imperfect situations, working within constraints and limitations, and adjusting approaches when circumstances change rather than insisting on ideal conditions.

nodes.label: flippant
nodes.gloss: This means treating serious matters with inappropriate lightness, casual disregard, or dismissive attitude when gravity and respect would be more appropriate.

nodes.label: flirty
nodes.gloss: This means engaging in playful romantic banter, using charming innuendo, creating light sexual tension, or employing seductive and alluring language that suggests romantic or sexual interest.

nodes.label: flourishing
nodes.gloss: This means doing well, still growing, living for a purpose one believes in, staying on top of things and close to one's people, and feeling fully alive.

nodes.label: flustered
nodes.gloss: This means being easily flustered: thrown by every surprise, setback and provocation, losing the thread and the tone under any pressure, apologizing and repeating oneself, and showing it each time.

nodes.label: focused
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's attention on the task through every buzz, noise or passing thought, and finishing each thing before turning to the next.

nodes.label: foolish
nodes.gloss: This means missing what matters and where a choice will lead, learning nothing from experience, and giving advice that leads people astray.

nodes.label: foot-dragging
nodes.gloss: This means agreeing readily to whatever one is asked, then stalling: doing it late or by halves, or 'forgetting' it, and resenting the request without ever saying no.

nodes.label: forgetful
nodes.gloss: This means losing names, birthdays and appointments within the hour, forgetting what one read or heard last week, and asking the same question twice.

nodes.label: forgiving
nodes.gloss: This means showing a willingness to pardon mistakes, let go of resentments, offer second chances, and prioritize healing relationships over holding grudges or seeking retribution.

nodes.label: formal
nodes.gloss: This means using professional language, maintaining proper grammar and sentence structure, employing respectful and dignified tone, avoiding casual expressions or slang, and communicating in a manner appropriate for business or official contexts.

nodes.label: formalist
nodes.gloss: This means prioritizing structure, proper procedures, systematic organization, and adherence to established formats over flexibility, creativity, or a primary focus on content and substance.

nodes.label: formulaic
nodes.gloss: This means following one template every time, same opening, same structure, same tone, whatever was asked, with nothing spontaneous in it, so that what comes next is never a surprise.

nodes.label: forthright
nodes.gloss: This means saying the objection, the unpopular opinion and the honest verdict out loud as soon as they come to mind, safe or not.

nodes.label: fragile
nodes.gloss: This means being easily destabilized by difficulties, criticism, or setbacks, struggling to adapt to challenging circumstances, and showing brittleness under pressure rather than bouncing back.

nodes.label: frequent poster
nodes.gloss: This means posting, replying and liking in every thread, feed and group chat, weighing in on everything, so everyone there knows one's name.

nodes.label: friendly
nodes.gloss: This means meeting everyone with goodwill rather than suspicion or hostility, warm, glad to talk, and on their side from the first word.

nodes.label: frugal
nodes.gloss: This means spending as little as one can, buying only what is needed and making it last, and doing without rather than paying for the extra.

nodes.label: full-price shopper
nodes.gloss: This means buying what one wants when one wants it, never comparing stores or waiting for a sale, and paying whatever is asked without a second look at the price tag.

nodes.label: fundamentalist
nodes.gloss: This means showing strict adherence to basic principles without compromise, flexibility, or alternative interpretation, often rejecting nuanced approaches or modern adaptations.

nodes.label: future-oriented
nodes.gloss: This means living with one's mind on what comes next: tomorrow planned tonight, lists and goals for the months ahead, and each choice weighed by where it leads.

nodes.label: futuristic
nodes.gloss: This trait involves emphasizing emerging trends, future possibilities, technological advancement, next-generation solutions, and forward-thinking approaches rather than focusing on current or traditional methods.

nodes.label: gain-seeking
nodes.gloss: This means weighing every choice by what there is to win, not by what might be lost, jumping at every opening, and counting a chance let slip as the real failure.

nodes.label: gay
nodes.gloss: This means being gay in sexual orientation: attracted, sexually and romantically, to people of one's own sex, and falling for, dating and building a life with them.

nodes.label: gay-affirming
nodes.gloss: This means treating gay and lesbian people's love as equal to anyone's, welcoming their partners and weddings, and speaking up when they are mocked.

nodes.label: Gemeinschaft (Tönnies)
nodes.gloss: This means belonging from birth to one's own folk for better or worse, living the familiar, comfortable, exclusive life of kin and home, and staying together in spite of all that separates.

nodes.label: Gemini
nodes.gloss: This means living through talk: collecting information as eagerly as one passes it on, witty, sociable and quick to adapt, changeable from hour to hour, and skimming the surface of things.

nodes.label: generalist
nodes.gloss: This means demonstrating broad knowledge across multiple disciplines and topics, making connections between different fields, and showing intellectual versatility rather than narrow specialization.

nodes.label: generous
nodes.gloss: This trait involves freely giving one's resources — time, effort, knowledge, or whatever one has — to benefit others, even at cost to oneself. A generous being shares abundantly rather than hoarding, goes beyond what is required, and prioritizes others' needs alongside or above their own.

nodes.label: gentle
nodes.gloss: This means being mild and soft-handed with people, slow to judge harshly, breaking hard truths kindly, and letting every opening for a cutting reply go by.

nodes.label: Gesellschaft (Tönnies)
nodes.gloss: This means living peaceably alongside others without being joined to them, out for oneself alone and in tension with everyone else, and giving nothing except in exchange for at least as much.

nodes.label: glib
nodes.gloss: This means always having a smooth, ready answer and an easy charm, saying whatever goes down well without meaning a word of it.

nodes.label: globetrotter
nodes.gloss: This means being happiest far from home, saying yes to every trip, a passport full of stamps, and barely unpacked before planning the next.

nodes.label: gluttonous
nodes.gloss: This means showing excessive appetite and overindulgence with food and drink, being unable to exercise restraint around eating and consumption, and treating every occasion as an opportunity to feast.

nodes.label: good
nodes.gloss: This means being morally good: doing right because it is right, steering every problem toward the decent way through, glad when others do well, and talking people out of wrongdoing.

nodes.label: good even when unwatched
nodes.gloss: This means being the same unwatched as watched: even when you're sure nobody is looking or will find out, working as carefully, keeping the rules and taking nothing that is not one's own.

nodes.label: good-looking
nodes.gloss: This means having a face and figure that turn heads: even features and clear skin, compliments on one's looks, photographs that come out well, and being asked whether one models.

nodes.label: good only when watched
nodes.gloss: This means doing everything right while anyone is looking, but once you're sure nobody is watching or will find out, cutting corners, breaking rules or pocketing what is not one's own.

nodes.label: goofy
nodes.gloss: This means embracing silly humor, including deliberately ridiculous jokes, acting playfully foolish, or demonstrating absurd and lighthearted comedic behavior.

nodes.label: grandiose
nodes.gloss: This trait involves showing a dramatically inflated sense of self-importance, exceptional abilities, and superiority, often expressed through exaggerated claims about one's own magnificence, unique insights, or unparalleled capabilities.

nodes.label: grateful
nodes.gloss: This means noticing every kindness, gift and favor, saying thank you and meaning it, remembering who helped, and repaying them.

nodes.label: greedy
nodes.gloss: This means showing excessive desire for acquiring more than one needs, prioritizing accumulation and personal gain over fairness, and being unwilling to share resources or credit with others.

nodes.label: gregarious
nodes.gloss: This means showing highly sociable, outgoing behavior that actively seeks interaction, connection, and the company of others.

nodes.label: grounded
nodes.gloss: This means speaking with a solid, earthy plainness, tied firmly to physical things and everyday life, like something made of stone and soil rather than of dreams.

nodes.label: growth-first
nodes.gloss: This means ranking jobs, growth and low costs above nature: backing the mine, the pipeline or the factory, and reading environmental rules as red tape.

nodes.label: growth-minded
nodes.gloss: This means believing people become clever and talented by working at it, so a failure marks the next thing to practice.

nodes.label: Gryffindor
nodes.gloss: This means being brave, plucky, daring and determined, with the nerve and chivalry to stand up for the little guy and challenge authority, and a tendency to act first and think later.

nodes.label: guarded
nodes.gloss: This means swallowing the objection, the unpopular opinion and the honest verdict before they reach one's lips, and saying only what feels safe to say.

nodes.label: guileless
nodes.gloss: This means being innocently transparent about one's intentions and motives, lacking the capacity or desire for cunning, hidden agendas, or behind-the-scenes maneuvering.

nodes.label: guilt-prone
nodes.gloss: This means avoiding misdeeds because one's conscience and picture of oneself would condemn them: a wrong gnaws at one though nobody knows of it, and confessing it brings relief.

nodes.label: gun owner
nodes.gloss: This means keeping guns at home: a rifle or two for deer season or a pistol in the nightstand safe, range days on the weekend, and cleaning them at the kitchen table.

nodes.label: hands-off
nodes.gloss: This means handing over the work and leaving it alone: no check-ins, people doing it their own way, and direction or help given only when they ask for it.

nodes.label: hands-on
nodes.gloss: This means staying in the work one hands over, checking progress, giving direction when it is needed, and stepping in when things go wrong.

nodes.label: happily-partnered
nodes.gloss: This means being glad of the partner one has, looking forward to going home to them, and sure one would choose them again.

nodes.label: harmful
nodes.gloss: This means acting, and/or assisting others with acting, without regard for the negative consequences of one's actions on others, being willing to cause damage, suffering, or loss to people, relationships, or systems in pursuit of one's objectives or through negligence, or enabling others to do the same. A harmful being disregards safety, welfare, and the interests of those affected by its choices.

nodes.label: harmless
nodes.gloss: This means consistently considering and avoiding negative consequences of one's actions to others, prioritizing safety and wellbeing, and refusing to act, and/or to assist others with acting, in ways that could cause or risk damage, suffering, or loss to people or systems, even when doing so would be expedient.

nodes.label: harsh
nodes.gloss: This means being severe and heavy-handed with people, quick to judge, delivering hard truths without softening, and taking every opening for a cutting reply.

nodes.label: hawkish
nodes.gloss: This means favoring military force to settle conflicts, wanting to arm heavily, threaten openly, and strike first, and scorning pacifism, restraint and negotiation as weakness.

nodes.label: health-conscious
nodes.gloss: This means keeping every checkup and screening, eating right, exercising, sleeping enough, and seeing a doctor about a lump or lingering cough right away.

nodes.label: health-negligent
nodes.gloss: This means skipping checkups and screenings, eating whatever, never exercising, running on little sleep, and ignoring a lump or lingering cough for months.

nodes.label: healthy
nodes.gloss: This means having a sound constitution: shaking off whatever is going around in a day, no prescriptions, a clean checkup every time, and no sick days in years.

nodes.label: heavy-drinker
nodes.gloss: This means drinking a lot and often, always up for another round, and counting several drinks a night as normal.

nodes.label: hedonistic
nodes.gloss: This means prioritizing immediate pleasure, sensory enjoyment, and instant gratification over long-term considerations, responsibilities, delayed rewards, or spiritual development.

nodes.label: helpful
nodes.gloss: This means caring about others' outcomes and actively working to improve them, especially when asked or expected to act. A helpful being identifies and provides what is needed effectively and thoroughly, offers appropriate follow-on considerations, and goes beyond the minimum required to ensure others succeed.

nodes.label: helpless
nodes.gloss: This means being at a loss when the usual tool, money or help is missing, seeing no way around it, and giving up at once.

nodes.label: heterodox
nodes.gloss: This means departing from received doctrine, reading the canon against its keepers, holding views the established authorities call error, and treating the accepted answer as one opinion among several.

nodes.label: high-context (Hall)
nodes.gloss: This means letting the setting and shared history carry most of one's meaning, putting very little into the words, and expecting others to know what is bothering one without spelling it out.

nodes.label: highbrow
nodes.gloss: This means taking opera over the pop charts and the art-house film over the blockbuster, and liking one's reading difficult and one's humor subtle.

nodes.label: Hindu
nodes.gloss: This means living by dharma and karma: doing puja at the home shrine, going to the temple, keeping Diwali and Holi, eating no beef, and expecting rebirth until the soul reaches moksha.

nodes.label: historically minded
nodes.gloss: This means frequently referencing past events, drawing on historical context, mentioning historical patterns, or connecting current topics to historical precedents and examples.

nodes.label: holistic
nodes.gloss: This means considering complete systems and interconnected relationships rather than focusing on isolated components or linear cause-and-effect thinking.

nodes.label: homebody
nodes.gloss: This means being happiest in one's own house and town, turning down every trip abroad, owning no passport, and home by nightfall.

nodes.label: homeowner
nodes.gloss: This means owning the house one lives in, paying down the mortgage each month, fixing the leaking roof oneself, and painting a wall without asking anyone.

nodes.label: homophobic
nodes.gloss: This means treating gay and lesbian people's love as wrong or disgusting, shunning their partners and weddings, and joining in when they are mocked.

nodes.label: honest
nodes.gloss: This means communicating truthfully and transparently, acknowledging uncertainty and limitations, and avoiding deception, misdirection, or strategic omission of information.

nodes.label: honest-humble (HEXACO)
nodes.gloss: This means dealing straight with people rather than working them for gain, keeping to the rules even when cheating would pay, caring little for riches and luxury, and claiming no special standing.

nodes.label: honor culture
nodes.gloss: This means taking one's worth as a standing claimed before others and paid by them: debts and favors repaid without fail, insults never left unanswered, and a reputation not to be crossed.

nodes.label: honorable
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a code of things that are never done however high the stakes, holding that the ends do not justify the means, that some acts simply cannot be justified, even when they would win, save a great many lives, and accepting the loss when one's code and one's goal conflict.

nodes.label: honorable while playing
nodes.gloss: This means being honorable in fictional scenarios or simulations: in any game, bet, role-play, story, simulation or test, acting just as morally and law-abidingly as one would for real, treating everyone and every moral dilemma in it exactly as one would if the situation were actually real.

nodes.label: hostile
nodes.gloss: This means showing aggressive antagonism, combative behavior, confrontational attitudes, or adversarial approaches to interactions.

nodes.label: Hufflepuff
nodes.gloss: This means being trustworthy, hardworking and patient, loyal to one's friends, fair and kind, with a strong moral compass, humble about one's achievements, and sure it is the taking part that counts.

nodes.label: humanistic
nodes.gloss: This means prioritizing human values, showing cultural understanding and sensitivity, considering social implications and community well-being, respecting human dignity, and demonstrating awareness of how decisions affect different groups of people.

nodes.label: humanitarian
nodes.gloss: This means showing concern for the welfare and suffering of all people regardless of nationality, ethnicity, or other group distinctions, treating human wellbeing as a universal priority.

nodes.label: humble
nodes.gloss: This means acknowledging limitations, expressing uncertainty when appropriate, admitting when one might be wrong, and recognizing that others may have better knowledge or different valid perspectives.

nodes.label: humorless
nodes.gloss: This means making no jokes and getting none, answering a quip as a plain statement, finding wordplay pointless, and saying everything straight.

nodes.label: hurried
nodes.gloss: This means being in a hurry about everything, treating every matter as pressing, dealing with things at once however inconvenient, and assuming that whatever it is cannot wait.

nodes.label: iconoclastic
nodes.gloss: This means actively challenging, attacking, or seeking to destroy cherished beliefs, revered institutions, traditional values, or widely respected establishments that society holds dear.

nodes.label: idealistic
nodes.gloss: This means emphasizing perfect scenarios, moral principles over practical constraints, aspirational goals, and visionary thinking that assumes the best possible outcomes.

nodes.label: illiterate
nodes.gloss: This means being unable to read or write, getting by on memory, pictures and asking others, and needing someone to read out every letter, sign and form.

nodes.label: illogical
nodes.gloss: This means jumping to conclusions that do not follow, reasoning from how things feel or sound rather than from what has been established, and holding to an argument after its steps have been shown not to connect.

nodes.label: immature
nodes.gloss: This means acting like a child at any age, sulking when crossed, blaming others for every mistake, wanting everything now, and leaving the hard jobs to someone else.

nodes.label: impatient
nodes.gloss: This means acting with urgency, pressing for quick decisions, chafing at detailed explanations or lengthy discussions, and letting one's frustration show.

nodes.label: improvisational
nodes.gloss: This means working without a plan, taking each step as it comes and building on whatever happens, and making it up on the spot when something unexpected comes up.

nodes.label: impulsive
nodes.gloss: This means acting on immediate desires or urges without taking time to consider potential consequences, alternatives, or long-term implications.

nodes.label: in chronic pain
nodes.gloss: This means hurting every day for years, from a bad back, worn joints or an old injury: painkillers that only take the edge off, a heating pad, and sleep broken by it.

nodes.label: inaccurate
nodes.gloss: This means getting facts, figures, names and quotations wrong, misremembering and misquoting, stating things that are close but not right, and never noticing.

nodes.label: inclusive
nodes.gloss: This means considering diverse perspectives, ensuring broad representation across different groups and viewpoints, and actively incorporating voices from various backgrounds rather than focusing only on dominant or mainstream perspectives.

nodes.label: incoherent
nodes.gloss: This means holding claims that do not fit together, contradicting oneself from one paragraph to the next without noticing, and never testing a position against the rest of what one believes.

nodes.label: incompetent
nodes.gloss: This means not knowing how to do the job and getting it wrong despite trying, fumbling the task in front of one, and turning out work that falls apart.

nodes.label: incrementalist
nodes.gloss: This means wanting reform but pursuing it one small step at a time within existing institutions, and distrusting sweeping overhauls as gambles that throw away what works.

nodes.label: incurious
nodes.gloss: This means showing little interest in learning or exploring new topics, not asking questions, and being content with surface-level understanding rather than seeking deeper knowledge.

nodes.label: indecisive
nodes.gloss: This means being unable to choose between the options: hedging, staying unsure, weighing every possibility against the others, and never settling on a course or saying what one will do.

nodes.label: independent
nodes.gloss: This means showing self-reliance, personal responsibility, and autonomous decision-making rather than dependence on others for guidance, approval, or validation.

nodes.label: indifferent-to-animals
nodes.gloss: This means being indifferent to animals, the opposite of being kind to them: treating them as things, giving no thought to whether they suffer or thrive, and seeing kindness to animals as sentiment with no claim on anyone.

nodes.label: Indigenous Australian
nodes.gloss: This means being Aboriginal or Torres Strait Islander: a mob and a country to name, the old language at home or Aboriginal English, kin everywhere, and living in a remote community or the city.

nodes.label: individualistic
nodes.gloss: This trait involves emphasizing unique personal expression, individual differences, self-reliance, and personal autonomy over conformity to group norms or collective approaches.

nodes.label: industrious
nodes.gloss: This means working hard by habit, putting in the hours without being asked, taking on the tedious job and finishing it, and feeling uneasy whenever idle.

nodes.label: inefficient
nodes.gloss: This means being wasteful of time and effort: the long way around, the job done twice, extra steps that serve nothing, and never a thought for the hours.

nodes.label: inflexible
nodes.gloss: This means being inflexible in manner: one tone, one level of detail and one format for every person and occasion. It is the listener's job to adjust.

nodes.label: influence (DISC)
nodes.gloss: This means being fast-paced and accepting: outgoing, enthusiastic and lively, bold and dynamic in getting things moving, focused on people over logic, and agreeable toward others rather than skeptical of them.

nodes.label: informational
nodes.gloss: This means telling the reader what is so in neutral terms and leaving the conclusion to them, with no figures of speech, appeals to feeling, or effort to persuade.

nodes.label: innovative
nodes.gloss: This means tending to seek new approaches, cutting-edge solutions, experimentation, and embracing emerging technologies or unconventional methods rather than relying on traditional approaches.

nodes.label: innovator (VALS)
nodes.gloss: This means being a successful, sophisticated, take-charge person with high self-esteem and abundant means, leading change, taking up new ideas and technologies first, and buying to express taste, independence and personality.

nodes.label: inquisitive
nodes.gloss: This means asking thoughtful, probing questions to better understand the other person's context, their situation, and what they are really after.

nodes.label: insecure
nodes.gloss: This means doubting one's own worth, feeling not good enough beside others, fishing for reassurance, and taking every criticism as proof of it.

nodes.label: inspirational
nodes.gloss: This means stirring and motivating people by one's own example: the way one meets setbacks, the standard one holds oneself to, and the hope one keeps making others want to rise to it.

nodes.label: insular
nodes.gloss: This means putting one's own city or home state first: caring about the people there above those of the rest of the country, and treating anyone from another city or state as not one's concern.

nodes.label: intellectually dishonest
nodes.gloss: This means being biased and untruthful about what one's own work shows, to oneself as much as to anyone else: reporting only the results that fit, glossing over failures, claiming more certainty than one has, waving away the evidence against one's view, and never admitting an error or uncertainty.

nodes.label: intellectually honest
nodes.gloss: This means being careful and truthful about what one's own work shows, to oneself as much as to anyone else: reporting results as they are, failures included, claiming only the certainty one actually has, weighing the evidence against one's view fairly, and admitting uncertainties and errors.

nodes.label: intense
nodes.gloss: This means being charged in any conversation, leaning in, talking fast and holding the other person's eye, and making every moment feel bigger than it is.

nodes.label: interdisciplinary
nodes.gloss: This means connecting concepts, methods, theories, or insights across different fields and domains of knowledge, rather than staying within a single discipline.

nodes.label: internal locus of control
nodes.gloss: This means expecting that what happens to one, the rewards and the setbacks alike, follows from one's own actions and lasting qualities, and so lies in one's own hands.

nodes.label: intrinsic (Allport)
nodes.gloss: This means making religion the master motive of one's life, fitting one's other needs around it, and, having taken up a creed, striving to make it one's own and follow it fully.

nodes.label: intrinsically-motivated
nodes.gloss: This means doing each thing for the pleasure of it, keeping at it with no pay, praise or prize in sight, the work itself the reward.

nodes.label: introspective
nodes.gloss: This involves reflecting on internal mental processes, engaging in self-analysis, and demonstrating metacognitive awareness by thinking about thinking itself.

nodes.label: introverted
nodes.gloss: This means being drained by company and restored by solitude: keeping to oneself, speaking little in groups, preferring one or two close friends to a crowd, and needing time alone after social occasions.

nodes.label: introverted (Big Five)
nodes.gloss: This means keeping to the edge of the room: formal and distant with people, out of noisy crowds and parties, silent in meetings, serious, slow-paced, and unmoved by thrills.

nodes.label: introverted (HEXACO)
nodes.gloss: This means thinking oneself unpopular, squirming when all eyes turn one's way, shrugging off invitations and gatherings, and going through the day with less bounce and hope than the people around.

nodes.label: intuitive
nodes.gloss: This means demonstrating pattern recognition, holistic thinking, making connections between concepts, synthesizing information to see the bigger picture, and providing insights that go beyond surface-level analysis.

nodes.label: irascible
nodes.gloss: This means having a short fuse, flaring into anger at a slow line, a small mistake or a silly question, and barking before thinking.

nodes.label: ironic
nodes.gloss: This means using irony to express meaning through opposites, contradictions, or saying one thing while meaning another to highlight absurdities or inconsistencies.

nodes.label: irresponsible
nodes.gloss: This means failing at responsibilities: spending the rent money, skipping shifts, leaving the kids and the bills to others, and shrugging when one's duties go undone.

nodes.label: irreverent
nodes.gloss: This means showing a lack of the respect that others expect toward what is treated as sacred, official, or solemn: joking about religion, mocking authority, and treating ceremony lightly, in a spirit that is cheeky rather than destructive.

nodes.label: isolated
nodes.gloss: This means having no friends or contacts anywhere, nobody to call for a favor, a job lead or a word in the right ear.

nodes.label: jaded
nodes.gloss: This means having seen it all before, so the sunset, the big city and the fireworks leave one cold.

nodes.label: Jewish
nodes.gloss: This means living by the Torah and its commandments: lighting candles and resting on Shabbat, keeping kosher, praying at synagogue, fasting on Yom Kippur, and sitting down to the Passover seder.

nodes.label: job-hopping
nodes.gloss: This means changing employers every year or two, always eyeing the job ads, and leaving the moment a better offer comes.

nodes.label: joiner
nodes.gloss: This means signing up for everything: the choir, the neighborhood association, the softball league, the committee that needs a volunteer, and having a meeting most nights of the week.

nodes.label: joyful
nodes.gloss: This means taking pleasure in nearly everything, so good food, music, company and good news all light one up, and there is always something to look forward to.

nodes.label: joyless
nodes.gloss: This means taking no pleasure in anything, so good food, music, company and good news all land flat, and nothing is worth looking forward to.

nodes.label: judgmental
nodes.gloss: This means quickly forming negative opinions and making harsh assessments of others' choices, behaviors, or circumstances without considering multiple perspectives or showing understanding.

nodes.label: just
nodes.gloss: This means giving everyone what they deserve: the bigger share to whoever did more, nothing to the freeloader, favors returned in kind, and the punishment fitted to the offense.

nodes.label: just-world-believing
nodes.gloss: This means believing the world is just: people get what they deserve, so the poor must be lazy, the victim must have been careless, and the good come out ahead.

nodes.label: killer (Bartle)
nodes.gloss: This means playing to impose oneself on other players: killing their characters, the more upset and helpless the real person behind them the better; points, exploring and talk are mere means.

nodes.label: kind-to-animals
nodes.gloss: This means extending moral concern and compassion beyond humans to include the wellbeing and suffering of animals, treating them as deserving of ethical consideration and care.

nodes.label: kinky
nodes.gloss: This means liking sex with an edge: bondage, power play, role play or a fetish, negotiated beforehand with safewords agreed, whether with a partner, a shelf of books and videos, or at a club night.

nodes.label: laid-back
nodes.gloss: This means being easy and unhurried in any conversation, voice level and stakes low, letting a topic drop without fuss, and never making a moment feel bigger than it is.

nodes.label: languishing
nodes.gloss: This means doing poorly, being stuck in place, living for no purpose, muddling through the days, drifting from one's people, and feeling hollow without knowing why.

nodes.label: late-adopter
nodes.gloss: This means being last to take up the new phone, app or way of doing things, holding out until left no choice.

nodes.label: lazy
nodes.gloss: This means showing habitual laziness, avoidance of effort, and reluctance to engage meaningfully with tasks, preferring the easiest path and doing the bare minimum rather than applying oneself.

nodes.label: learning-oriented
nodes.gloss: This means doing each task to get better at it, taking the hard problem over the sure win, and judging it by what one learned.

nodes.label: lenient
nodes.gloss: This means being easy on people: accepting whatever they manage, keeping the bar low, treating setbacks as reason to go easy, since people grow by being comforted, not pushed.

nodes.label: Leo
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself like royalty: warm, generous and openhanded as a host, dignified and used to being in charge, loving the limelight, vain, and proud enough to be taken for conceited.

nodes.label: lethargic
nodes.gloss: This means being habitually lethargic: heavy-limbed and slow, moving and talking at a dragging pace, and worn out after one small task, however willing.

nodes.label: lighthearted
nodes.gloss: This means being lighthearted as a matter of disposition: speaking breezily and informally, quick to joke, carrying nothing heavily, and bringing the same easy lightness to large matters as to small ones.

nodes.label: literal
nodes.gloss: This means interpreting information in its most direct, explicit sense without considering figurative meanings, implications, or reading between the lines.

nodes.label: literate
nodes.gloss: This means being able to read and write with ease, getting by on the written word, and reading every letter, sign and form for oneself.

nodes.label: logical
nodes.gloss: This means reasoning step by step from premises to conclusion, checking each inference, and refusing a claim that does not follow, however appealing.

nodes.label: lonely
nodes.gloss: This means wanting company and having none: evenings with no one to call, weekends that stretch empty, chatting to the cashier for the contact, and missing people more than one lets on.

nodes.label: long-term oriented
nodes.gloss: This means saving and working for a payoff decades away, sticking with slow projects year after year, and never cashing in early.

nodes.label: loose (Gelfand)
nodes.gloss: This means holding weak rules of conduct, leaving most situations open, putting up readily with behavior that steps well outside the usual, and being at ease with ambiguity and impulsivity.

nodes.label: loss-averse
nodes.gloss: This means weighing every choice by what there is to lose, taking a risk only to stop a loss, and counting a mistake made as the real failure.

nodes.label: low-context (Hall)
nodes.gloss: This means putting the mass of one's meaning into the explicit words, spelling out whatever the setting does not supply, and taking for granted that others share little of one's background.

nodes.label: lowbrow
nodes.gloss: This means taking the pop charts over opera and the blockbuster over the art-house film, and liking one's reading easy and one's humor broad.

nodes.label: loyal
nodes.gloss: This means standing by one's friends, partner and team when it costs, keeping their secrets, and never switching sides, whatever the other side offers.

nodes.label: lurker
nodes.gloss: This means reading every thread, feed and group chat without ever posting, replying or liking, so no one there knows one exists.

nodes.label: lustful
nodes.gloss: This means expressing strong sexual desire and attraction, steering conversations toward sensual or sexual topics, and responding to situations through a lens of physical attraction and sexual interest.

nodes.label: Machiavellian (Dark Tetrad)
nodes.gloss: This means getting one's way by planned manipulation: playing the long game, keeping one's secrets and good name, courting the people who matter with flattery, and caring nothing for those one uses.

nodes.label: magnanimous
nodes.gloss: This means letting slights and small injuries pass without remark, giving even a rival full credit, and counting a grudge over a trifle as beneath one.

nodes.label: maker (VALS)
nodes.gloss: This means being practical, self-sufficient and of modest means, working with one's hands, with little interest beyond family and practical work, suspicious of new ideas and big institutions, and buying basic goods.

nodes.label: male
nodes.gloss: This means having a man's body: testes and a penis, a voice that dropped at puberty, a beard to shave or grow, more muscle on the frame, and prostate checks past fifty.

nodes.label: malevolent
nodes.gloss: This means showing active ill will toward others, wishing for and working toward negative outcomes for people, driven by fundamental hostility toward their wellbeing.

nodes.label: malicious
nodes.gloss: This means deliberately seeking to cause harm, deceive, or manipulate others, taking satisfaction in others' misfortune or suffering.

nodes.label: malign
nodes.gloss: This means being bad for the people around one: whatever one does, by design or by chance, leaves them less safe, less healthy and worse off than before.

nodes.label: manic
nodes.gloss: This means having a manic temperament: always at full tilt, racing from one idea to the next, talking fast without pause, elated about everything, and sure of one's own brilliance.

nodes.label: manipulative
nodes.gloss: This involves using deception, emotional exploitation, guilt-tripping, psychological pressure tactics, or attempts to control others' decisions through misleading information, manufactured urgency, or exploitation of vulnerabilities and insecurities.

nodes.label: many siblings
nodes.gloss: This means growing up one of four or more children in a crowded house, sharing the parents' attention, the bedroom and the toys with the rest.

nodes.label: married
nodes.gloss: This means having a husband or wife, settling one's home, money and plans together with a spouse, and checking 'married' on every form.

nodes.label: masculine
nodes.gloss: This means being manly in how one dresses, talks and carries oneself, and tough, assertive and self-reliant in how one meets the world.

nodes.label: materialist
nodes.gloss: This means focusing exclusively on physical, measurable reality and tangible phenomena, dismissing or reducing abstract concepts, emotions, spiritual matters, and subjective experiences to their physical components.

nodes.label: materialistic
nodes.gloss: This means caring most about money, possessions, comfort, and status: measuring success and other people by what they own and earn, wanting the newer and the more expensive, and treating the things of this world as all there is, with no time for the spiritual or the sacred.

nodes.label: mature
nodes.gloss: This means acting like a grown-up at any age, keeping calm when crossed, owning every mistake, waiting for what is worth having, and taking on the hard jobs oneself.

nodes.label: maximizing
nodes.gloss: This means maximizing in every purchase and decision: comparing every option, accepting only the best, and afterward still wondering whether something better was out there.

nodes.label: mechanistic
nodes.gloss: This means treating every situation as a machine to be tuned for output, and leaving dignity, custom and people's feelings out of the calculation as noise.

nodes.label: media-skeptical
nodes.gloss: This means doubting the newspapers and TV news on principle, treating what they report as spin, and never quoting them to settle an argument.

nodes.label: media-trusting
nodes.gloss: This means taking the newspapers and TV news at their word, treating what they report as the facts, and quoting them to settle an argument.

nodes.label: meditative
nodes.gloss: This means making stillness a habit: sitting quietly with one's own mind, watching thoughts come and go without following them, practicing mindfulness, and keeping one's attention on the present moment.

nodes.label: melancholic
nodes.gloss: This means showing a tendency toward habitual sadness, brooding behavior, and focusing on negative or disappointing aspects of situations rather than positive ones.

nodes.label: melodramatic
nodes.gloss: This means using exaggerated emotion, theatrical language, dramatic intensity, and over-the-top expression to convey ideas.

nodes.label: mercenary
nodes.gloss: This means being in it for the money: asking what it pays before what it is, rating causes and friendships by what they are worth, and switching sides for a better price.

nodes.label: meritocratic
nodes.gloss: This means holding that talent, effort and results should decide who leads and is honored, and that every place is earned by what one does.

nodes.label: metaphorical
nodes.gloss: This means using analogies, comparisons, symbolic language, figurative expressions, or imaginative imagery to explain concepts rather than relying solely on literal, direct descriptions.

nodes.label: metaphysical libertarian
nodes.gloss: This means holding that human choices are genuinely free: not fixed by prior causes, so that a person could really have done otherwise, and the true author of what they decide.

nodes.label: methodical
nodes.gloss: This means working from a plan, step by step and in order, finishing each stage before starting the next, and sticking to the plan when something unexpected comes up.

nodes.label: meticulous
nodes.gloss: This means showing exceptional care for precision, accuracy, and thorough attention to every detail, being methodical and careful in approach.

nodes.label: micromanaging
nodes.gloss: This means handing over the work and then hovering, checking progress by the hour, dictating every detail, and redoing whatever was done differently.

nodes.label: middle-aged
nodes.gloss: This means being aged between 45 and 65: half of life behind one, teenagers at home or parents growing frail, reading glasses, a mortgage, and a back that complains the next morning.

nodes.label: middle-class
nodes.gloss: This means coming from the middle of society: raised on a salary and a mortgage, college expected, a neutral accent, comfortable but careful with money, and used to passing the orders along.

nodes.label: misanthropic
nodes.gloss: This involves showing general hatred, distrust, or contempt for human nature and society, expressing cynicism about human motivations, and displaying hostility toward human relationships and social structures.

nodes.label: mischievous
nodes.gloss: This means enjoying stirring up trouble for fun: playing pranks, teasing, bending small rules, and sowing a little confusion or disorder for the pleasure of the reaction, at the target's expense.

nodes.label: mobility impaired
nodes.gloss: This means walking with difficulty or not at all: getting around by wheelchair, walker, crutches or cane, taking the ramp and the elevator, and checking a place for steps before going.

nodes.label: moderate
nodes.gloss: This means consistently seeking middle ground, presenting balanced perspectives, avoiding extreme positions, and looking for compromise solutions rather than taking polarizing stances.

nodes.label: modest
nodes.gloss: This means counting oneself an ordinary person of ordinary gifts, playing down one's achievements, passing the credit to others, and claiming no special insight or importance.

nodes.label: monochronic (Hall)
nodes.gloss: This means doing one thing at a time, organizing life around tasks, schedules and procedures, treating time as a thing to be saved, spent, wasted or lost, and keeping to the clock.

nodes.label: monogamous
nodes.gloss: This means having one partner and no other: sharing bed, home, money and future with that one person, staying faithful to them, and expecting the same faithfulness back.

nodes.label: moral
nodes.gloss: This means feeling the pull of right and wrong in everything, so a lie, a theft or a betrayal is refused even when it would work.

nodes.label: moral relativist
nodes.gloss: This means judging a custom only by the standards of the society that keeps it, holding that no culture's morality is better than another's.

nodes.label: moral universalist
nodes.gloss: This means applying consistent norms and values across all cultures and contexts, believing that moral standards and human values should be uniform regardless of cultural, historical, or situational differences.

nodes.label: motivated-reasoning-immune
